b663a2f6-a889-47eb-821d-194da213a9ed.title: [DESTINATION] Errand
b663a2f6-a889-47eb-821d-194da213a9ed.description:
Got a box sitting at [LOCATION] that needs to make its way over to [DESTINATION]. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.
b663a2f6-a889-47eb-821d-194da213a9ed.descriptionCn:
在 [LOCATION] 有个箱子需要送到 [DESTINATION]。你能不能快点把这个搞定？

这可能是我分配的最简单的任务了。唯一的危险就是绊倒自己。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

fb689d82-0fd7-459b-aab2-8e417df6815a.title: [DESTINATION] Stroll
fb689d82-0fd7-459b-aab2-8e417df6815a.description:
Any chance you’re at [DESTINATION]?

Need a box hustled from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.

-Smokey
fb689d82-0fd7-459b-aab2-8e417df6815a.descriptionCn:
你在 [DESTINATION] 吗？

需要把一箱货从 [LOCATION] 运送到 [DESTINATION]。准时且完好无损地送到，那将是你赚到的最轻松的钱。

- “烟雾”

80933e8d-c9bf-492b-b69f-c5abd24962e9.title: [LOCATION] has been greenlit
80933e8d-c9bf-492b-b69f-c5abd24962e9.description:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.
80933e8d-c9bf-492b-b69f-c5abd24962e9.descriptionCn:
来自判官的指示，要求我们袭击位于 [LOCATION]。它归繁荣公民所有，并且那里的安保对一些当地人不太友好，所以他们必须滚。

他们或许在口头上大谈安全，但他们手里有枪，而且很乐意使用。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

4f141dc7-cd46-8fa0-bcc3-c18d0101a49a.title: [LOCATION] needs a bunch of repairs
4f141dc7-cd46-8fa0-bcc3-c18d0101a49a.description:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to [LOCATION] and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.

I think if you've got six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes, you should be covered.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
4f141dc7-cd46-8fa0-bcc3-c18d0101a49a.descriptionCn:
需要个懂工具的人去 [LOCATION] 帮忙修点东西。上个维修工搞定了大部分问题，但还有些地方需要检查。

我觉得你带上 六个保险丝、打捞工具 和 足够修补五根管道的 RMC 罐 应该就够了。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》 或许值得翻翻。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

2faacd74-10f4-4b31-8e24-cca9c78841b8.title: [LOCATION] needs assistance
2faacd74-10f4-4b31-8e24-cca9c78841b8.description:
Headhunters have launched an unprovoked attack against [LOCATION]. Although we don't support the use of violence, Citizens for Prosperity won't let innocent people die. We need qualified security personnel to retake the outpost.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
2faacd74-10f4-4b31-8e24-cca9c78841b8.descriptionCn:
猎头帮对 [LOCATION] 发起了无端攻击。虽然我们不支持使用暴力，但繁荣公民不会让无辜的人死去，我们需要合格的安保人员来夺回前哨站。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

3c33b776-e65f-46fc-930e-52e326df8ddc.title: [LOCATION] needs help
3c33b776-e65f-46fc-930e-52e326df8ddc.description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [LOCATION] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TARGET], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
3c33b776-e65f-46fc-930e-52e326df8ddc.descriptionCn:
我们刚收到关于 [LOCATION] 遭到一大群武装人员攻击的报告，他们由 [TARGET] 领导，这是一名臭名昭著的不法分子，已经威胁繁荣公民的工作人员好几个月了。具体细节尚未确认，但我们知道已经有多人伤亡。

繁荣公民正在寻找任何合格的安全人员前去夺回这些前哨站。我们了解到 [TARGET] 往往藏在他们的士兵后面，但如果你消灭足够多的普通士兵，他们会出现。

虽然我们不喜欢诉诸暴力，但管理层认为没有其他办法来解决这个情况并继续我们在星系中的良好工作。

祝好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

46917e35-339c-1388-7f62-5b3af2420388.title: [LOCATION] needs massive repairs
46917e35-339c-1388-7f62-5b3af2420388.description:
The storms over at [LOCATION] are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.

Figure you'd need to bring about six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.

Hell with this place.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
46917e35-339c-1388-7f62-5b3af2420388.descriptionCn:
[LOCATION] 那边的风暴真是要命，昨天我们一个前哨站被彻底摧毁了，需要大修，所以来找帮手。

估计你得带 六个保险丝、打捞工具，还有 足够处理最多八根破裂管道的 RMC 罐。我们觉得应该够用，但具体数量得到现场确认。

这破地方真见鬼。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》 或许值得翻翻。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

4cd06280-1bb4-8ddb-2bcb-8cf6e714c3a4.title: [LOCATION] needs some repairs
4cd06280-1bb4-8ddb-2bcb-8cf6e714c3a4.description:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at [LOCATION] got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but no more than three I think). If you can bring a salvaging tool with enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
4cd06280-1bb4-8ddb-2bcb-8cf6e714c3a4.descriptionCn:
如果你看到这个，我们需要帮手。我们在 [LOCATION] 的前哨站被恶劣风暴袭击受损。平常的技术员不是没空就是已经挂了（字面意思），所以想雇人去修几个保险丝（不确定具体数量但 最多三个）。要是你能带个 打捞工具 和 足够修理三根管道的 RMC 罐，应该就能搞定。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》 或许值得翻翻。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

7462c715-9517-451b-a32d-8e6b3ec0122d.title: [TARGET] needs stomping
7462c715-9517-451b-a32d-8e6b3ec0122d.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGET] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.

Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
7462c715-9517-451b-a32d-8e6b3ec0122d.descriptionCn:
有个小角色以为他们可以没有代价地袭击猎头帮。所以 [TARGET] 试图抢走我们的一处藏匿点，还以为自己能逃脱。

我们最后听说他们在 [LOCATION] 附近被发现。我们需要有人过去，给他们传达一个非常明确的信息：谁才是星系中的主宰。

干得干脆利落点。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

971e8dd9-9f67-4f92-9b36-9b376c2e9db2.title: A Basic Task
971e8dd9-9f67-4f92-9b36-9b376c2e9db2.description:
[TARGET] needs to be eliminated. My contacts tell me they will have one or two escorts, but nothing you can't handle. Find them near [LOCATION].

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
971e8dd9-9f67-4f92-9b36-9b376c2e9db2.descriptionCn:
[TARGET] 需要消失。 我的联络人告诉我他会有一两个陪同人员，但是没有你应付不了问题，对吧？你可以在[LOCATION]找到他们。

谨启，
沃恩

9e6d0df7-4854-4f2e-ac3d-b7dfd1c1aef8.title: A Basic Task
9e6d0df7-4854-4f2e-ac3d-b7dfd1c1aef8.description:

4714f336-ac92-861b-8ec8-598c9b915f8b.title: A Call to Arms
4714f336-ac92-861b-8ec8-598c9b915f8b.description:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [REWARDVALUE_WANTED1] UEC per outlaw dealt with.

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!

* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.
4714f336-ac92-861b-8ec8-598c9b915f8b.descriptionCn:
民事防御部队需要你！斯坦顿星系中无辜的平民无时无刻不在受到邪恶和冷血的罪犯蹂躏。

决不能这样下去了。

在UEE和民兵动员协会的授权下，民事防御部队现在委托所有渴望战斗并且法律纪录良好*的个人去进攻和消灭任何被识别带有生效中犯罪等级的个人或者船只。

为回报这些对于公共安全的无私贡献，民事防御部队会对那些成功将罪犯们捉拿归案的个人给予每名罪犯 [REWARDVALUE_WANTED1] UEC的资金奖励**。

现在，你为斯坦顿星系中所有旅行者和你自己做出积极贡献的时刻到了！现在就报名并完成职责吧！


*请注意，如果获得犯罪等级就会废除您的民事防御部队成员身份，任何进行中的合约也将终止。
**请知悉，在其他雇佣合约中遭遇的罪犯并不计入本项目的奖励。

2598694a-6283-4800-bd13-a921dba84526.title: A Chance to Impress
2598694a-6283-4800-bd13-a921dba84526.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives.

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.

If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills.

Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
2598694a-6283-4800-bd13-a921dba84526.descriptionCn:
首先，请允许我介绍一下我自己。夸张点儿说，我做的是人命的活计。

有人要杀人，就会来找我，而我会雇佣一个完美的杀手。这种方式对所有人来说都安全，因为没有人知道对方是谁，就我们这活儿的性质来说再好不过了。

最近我听说你的手艺不错，能担得起这活儿，这说法到底对不对，我觉得值得一试。

你要是有兴趣给我做事儿，那就展示下你传说中的身手吧。

目标是 [TARGET]，他们在 [LOCATION]，悄悄得杀掉他们。

办成了，你不仅有钱可拿，而且也是你实力的证明，以后还会有活儿给你。

此致，
沃恩

82c08b3d-9786-4cfb-8f68-f3e8ea8c5a50.title: A Complicated Task
82c08b3d-9786-4cfb-8f68-f3e8ea8c5a50.description:
The latest name for our list is [TARGET].

They will be traveling around [LOCATION] in a better class of ship and with a better class of escort. Approach with caution, and try to make this a clean kill.

Regards,
Vaughn
82c08b3d-9786-4cfb-8f68-f3e8ea8c5a50.descriptionCn:
名单上的最新名字是 [TARGET]。

他们将乘坐更好级别的船在 [LOCATION] 附近徘徊，也配有更好的护航船。请谨慎处理，把这事办的干净利落。

致谢，
沃恩

ca7ebac2-f2f3-4897-8018-3341387f7a5a.title: A Complicated Task
ca7ebac2-f2f3-4897-8018-3341387f7a5a.description:
The latest name for our list is [TARGET].

They will be traveling around [LOCATION] in a better class of ship and with a better class of escort. Approach with caution, and try to make this a clean kill.

Regards,
Vaughn
ca7ebac2-f2f3-4897-8018-3341387f7a5a.descriptionCn:

他们将乘坐更好级别的船在 [LOCATION] 附近徘徊，也配有更好的护航船。请谨慎处理，把这事办的干净利落。

致谢，
沃恩

dec79f9d-2188-4318-95d1-3917a98444d5.title: A Difficult Task
dec79f9d-2188-4318-95d1-3917a98444d5.description:

A cautious approach may be wise.

Warmest Regards,
Vaughn
dec79f9d-2188-4318-95d1-3917a98444d5.descriptionCn:
杀掉 [TARGET] 可能是一个挑战。 他们在[LOCATION]附近的一艘受到良好保护的飞船上，很可能还有技术熟练的护航陪同。

谨慎行动或许是明智的选择。

最诚挚的问候，
沃恩

5b33d91a-eee7-4be9-87e4-dd3c68455766.title: A Fond Farewell
5b33d91a-eee7-4be9-87e4-dd3c68455766.titleCn:
深情告别
[沃恩 - 寻找尸体 VHRT]
5b33d91a-eee7-4be9-87e4-dd3c68455766.description:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.

I need you to travel to [LOCATION] and see if our contractor, [TARGET], is truly gone.

I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
5b33d91a-eee7-4be9-87e4-dd3c68455766.descriptionCn:
我很遗憾地发送这条消息。我们一位出类拔萃的承包商在外执行任务时，好像目标占了上风。

我需要你前往 [LOCATION]，看看我们的承包商 [TARGET] 是否真的没了。

我猜那里会有点乱，因为现场很可能还有多个威胁。因此，强烈建议你带个支援团队一起去。

此致，
沃恩

12e92b29-e5a8-4ba7-95a4-122d6c992684.description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
12e92b29-e5a8-4ba7-95a4-122d6c992684.descriptionCn:
听说繁荣公民的安保变得更加激进，开始把人们从他们用废料建造的家中赶出去，他们想要报复，所以找上了我们。

前往 [LOCATION] 清理那里的繁荣公民，这应该很简单，而且能赚到一笔不错的报酬。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

a9ea72b2-9e58-4603-ae9f-a07e3ef27a7e.title: A Simple Task
a9ea72b2-9e58-4603-ae9f-a07e3ef27a7e.description:
I have a new assignment for you.

Dispatch [TARGET]. You should be able to find them at [LOCATION].

I do not expect them to put up much of a struggle. At least not a formidable one.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
a9ea72b2-9e58-4603-ae9f-a07e3ef27a7e.descriptionCn:
我有一个新任务要给你。

处决掉 [TARGET]。你能在 [LOCATION] 找到他们。

我不觉得他们能做出多激烈的反抗，再怎么也不会很难解决。

此致，
沃恩

5916ef35-13d3-4223-8fe3-c399a02290ce.title: A Swift Reprisal
5916ef35-13d3-4223-8fe3-c399a02290ce.description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [LOCATION]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us.

Stows out.
5916ef35-13d3-4223-8fe3-c399a02290ce.descriptionCn:
嘿、

一些二流子窝在 [LOCATION] 里。我们本来不想理会他们，但这群傲慢的家伙试图袭击受我们保护的前哨站。

我们没费什么事就把他们赶走了，但我们不能让这种无礼行为不受惩罚。我们的狙击手正忙着对付更大的敌人，所以我们希望你能帮我们解决这个问题。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

5d299a74-61d2-41f9-8fea-7132af6a0302.title: A Troublesome Task
5d299a74-61d2-41f9-8fea-7132af6a0302.description:
I fear this is another one of those assignments that will take your full skillset to see to completion.

[TARGET] is aboard a very heavily armed vessel protected by at least two equally armed escorts. They are traveling near [LOCATION].

Not for the faint of heart.

Fondly,
Vaughn
5d299a74-61d2-41f9-8fea-7132af6a0302.descriptionCn:
恐怕这是又一项需要你动用所有手段使上浑身解数才能完成的任务。

[TARGET]在一条全副武装的飞船上，并且至少有两艘同等武装的飞船保卫。他们在[LOCATION]附近徘徊。

胆小的可干不来这个

眷念你的，
沃恩

96b306a6-38f3-491d-96bf-d35ba76ff169.title: A Very Difficult Task
96b306a6-38f3-491d-96bf-d35ba76ff169.description:
An tricky assignment has just arrived that I think you will be ideally suited for.

Expect to encounter [TARGET] aboard a heavily armed vessel near [LOCATION] and accompanied by some of the most highly-seasoned pilots that can be hired.

Deal with the escorts as you wish. As long as you kill [TARGET], I will be more than satisfied.

Respectfully,
Vaughn
96b306a6-38f3-491d-96bf-d35ba76ff169.descriptionCn:
一项棘手的任务刚到，我想你会非常适合。

预计 [TARGET] 会在一艘重武装飞船上，他们会在 [LOCATION] 附近徘徊，并且雇佣了一些非常有经验的飞船驾驶员来护航。

护航船随便你怎么处置，只要 [TARGET] 死了我就心满意足了。

恭敬地，
沃恩

4d1cc670-7249-4edc-ab59-75a26aaa78d0.title: A Well Deserved Break
4d1cc670-7249-4edc-ab59-75a26aaa78d0.description:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET] once and for all.

Start your search at [LOCATION].  These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at  times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn
4d1cc670-7249-4edc-ab59-75a26aaa78d0.descriptionCn:
这目标真的难盯。他属于那帮神出鬼没的爪蜥帮，平时东躲西藏、行踪不定。不过最近听说他们正拼命想重启一座老掉牙的 QV 碎岩站。这倒是个千载难逢的机会，说不定这次真能一劳永逸地干掉 [TARGET]。

先从 [LOCATION] 开始搜起吧。这种前哨站空荡荡的，像个大山洞似的。你一进去怕是得花点力气才能把人揪出来。

但是，我对你有十足的信心，
沃恩

12a01016-d0e9-400c-b285-0016401eebda.title: A Well Deserved Break
12a01016-d0e9-400c-b285-0016401eebda.description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, [TARGET], who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.

Word is that you can find them at [LOCATION].  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
12a01016-d0e9-400c-b285-0016401eebda.descriptionCn:
尼克斯帮派爪蜥帮的一名成员 - [TARGET] - 已列入我的黑名单。此人长期在逃，近期却突然现身于基格小行星带的一座废弃采矿空间站。今日便是我们的幸运日，也将是他们的末日。

据说这个人位于 [LOCATION]。遗憾的是，这地方可能因损毁严重，在你进入那个特定区域之前，要先对站点进行一定维修。

不过我相信，这点挑战对你而言不过是小菜一碟。

此致，
沃恩

38a1dfde-22f0-46a2-80de-ea4949a409c6.title: A Well Deserved Break
38a1dfde-22f0-46a2-80de-ea4949a409c6.description:
A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one [TARGET], a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station.

It is highly likely that you will find them at [LOCATION].  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down.

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn
38a1dfde-22f0-46a2-80de-ea4949a409c6.descriptionCn:
刚有份请求递到我桌上，说的是爪蜥帮有个人，叫 [TARGET] 的，死得有点“赶巧”。眼下正鬼鬼祟祟地在一座老旧 QV 碎岩站里乱窜。

他们八成就在 [LOCATION] 那儿，不过这空间站实在太大，得仔细找一找，别漏了犄角旮旯。

祝你在尼克斯星系玩得痛快，
沃恩

5c71fa85-40cd-4148-86af-c6cbebe5f017.title: Additional Resources For Research
5c71fa85-40cd-4148-86af-c6cbebe5f017.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
5c71fa85-40cd-4148-86af-c6cbebe5f017.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

50707b38-596f-4b2b-a440-f7d86fe04de0.title: Advanced Tracker License Certification
50707b38-596f-4b2b-a440-f7d86fe04de0.description:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS:
NOTES: With your proven track record, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn an Advanced Tracker License.

This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend Very High-Risk Targets (VHRT). These criminals can travel in larger multicrew ships with heavy escorts. With multiple hostiles to deal with, encounters with these targets can often be lethal.

To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a VHRT ranked criminal by the name of [TARGET] last seen at [LOCATION].

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.
50707b38-596f-4b2b-a440-f7d86fe04de0.descriptionCn:
--------------------------------------------------------
---------------------  赏金合约  ---------------------
--------------------------------------------------------

赏金猎人公会
处理与分配部门

赏金猎人公会已授权一份官方赏金

姓名：[TARGET]
星系：[SYSTEM]
风险评估：极高
最后已知位置：[LOCATION]
已知关联：
注意：根据你过往执行任务的表现，赏金猎人公会将为您提供获得“精英赏金猎人执照”的机会。

此执照表明您有资格跟踪和逮捕极高风险目标（VHRT）。 这些罪犯在大型多人船上行动并且带有大量护航。 您要应对很多敌人，与这些目标的接触可能是致命的。

您必须成功缉拿这个名为 [TARGET] 的极高风险目标，才能通过认证，他最后一次出现是在 [LOCATION]。


赏金猎人公会
追求正义

赏金猎人公会是一个由雇佣兵公会批准的安保服务，根据《外星贸易授权法案》被授权在 UEE 及其以外地区开展行动。

d300992a-88ab-479c-b1d9-f135b2092b5b.title: Alert: [LOCATION] under attack
d300992a-88ab-479c-b1d9-f135b2092b5b.description:
We need any available security personnel to report to [LOCATION]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TARGET], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TARGET].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
d300992a-88ab-479c-b1d9-f135b2092b5b.descriptionCn:
我们需要任何有空的安全人员前往 [LOCATION] 报到。一群武装人员袭击了我们的前哨站集群，我们迫切需要帮助。虽然这群人似乎与任何已知的帮派无关，但我们收到消息，他们的首领是 [TARGET]，一个臭名昭著的当地不法分子。

请尽快出发，确保区域安全，消灭不法分子和 [TARGET]。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

46590930-4039-d4e2-5f80-8059137a3bb8.title: All Things Come To An End
46590930-4039-d4e2-5f80-8059137a3bb8.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [LOCATION], but [TARGET] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
46590930-4039-d4e2-5f80-8059137a3bb8.descriptionCn:
不知道你熟不熟悉 [LOCATION]，[TARGET] 是那一片的地头蛇。我现在需要他们死。

这活计可没那么简单，他们是出了名的不喜欢亲自动手，什么脏活累活都扔给手下去干。所以，只要你杀掉他们足够多的部下，他们就不得不亲自出来和你战斗了。

你真诚的，
沃恩

41d02f67-3abc-4a67-86bc-7037c2c4b2bd.title: All Things Come To An End
41d02f67-3abc-4a67-86bc-7037c2c4b2bd.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own.

Please head to [LOCATION] and kill [TARGET]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
41d02f67-3abc-4a67-86bc-7037c2c4b2bd.descriptionCn:
他们都说贼间无道。看样子今天你就要去干掉个自己人。

麻烦你去 [LOCATION]，然后做掉 [TARGET]。其他人怎么处理嘛...随你所欲吧。

你真诚的，
沃恩

640e6006-aadc-4c69-8efe-c0b628186c41.title: Alliance Aid: Attempted Cargo Theft
640e6006-aadc-4c69-8efe-c0b628186c41.titleCn:
援助联盟：货物盗窃未遂
[防卫部门 - 取回货物 LRT]
640e6006-aadc-4c69-8efe-c0b628186c41.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-11

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

With all these Alliance Aid ships hauling valuable cargo around, outlaws in the area have gone into a feeding frenzy. We just got word of one of their latest targets via emergency beacon and need you to go over to the [LOCATION], assess the situation, neutralize any remaining hostiles in the area, and if needed, secure the shipment for delivery to [DESTINATION].

Be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to handle the cargo.

This contract is non-negotiable.

fe78ceb2-02b3-4118-9246-72a5c12cc807.titleCn:
援助联盟：两倍星际中规模货运（医疗 / 过滤器）
[运输部门 - 里程碑 - 货物运输]
fe78ceb2-02b3-4118-9246-72a5c12cc807.description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of Molina Mold treatment on microtech and shipment of ventilation filters on Hurston waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to [DESTINATION].

To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to 2 SCU in size.

And I would double check to make sure you have your handheld tractor beam with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
fe78ceb2-02b3-4118-9246-72a5c12cc807.descriptionCn:
好吧，这次任务有点不一样。你看，由于援助联盟那边事情太多，我们的合约出了点差错，导致一批重要物资被漏掉了。现在人命关天，而你之前已经为运输部门帮了那么多忙，我挺希望你能再挺身而出，帮我们跑两个地点？

有一批位于微科星的莫利纳霉菌治疗用品和一批位于赫斯顿的通风过滤器，中等规模，等着你去取货。你需要跑完两个地点，把所有货物装上，然后全部送到 [DESTINATION]。

为了搬运这些货物，你的飞船得够大，能装载最大尺寸达[MAX_SCU]的集装箱。

出发前，我建议你再三确认随身带着手持式牵引光束，要是忘了带，那可就麻烦大了！

你愿意这样帮忙，真的太好了。

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

1f6cfc2b-bc89-440d-8324-977133d3b643.title: Alliance Aid: Escort Needed

1f6cfc2b-bc89-440d-8324-977133d3b643.description:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from [LOCATION] for the ongoing relief effort.

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
1f6cfc2b-bc89-440d-8324-977133d3b643.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民需要一位有战斗经验的飞行员，为一名正从 [LOCATION] 执行关键任务的援助联盟飞行员提供额外支援，以保障持续进行的救援行动。

由于莫利纳霉菌爆发导致活动增加，不法分子发动了更多袭击，你的任务就是确保他们在执行工作期间的安全。这条路线相对安全，我预计不会遇到太多麻烦，但还是别冒险为好。

如果你感兴趣，就去指定地点会合，等待进一步指示。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

4e272039-cda4-437e-b6d9-f12091c7f269.description:
Hello,

With the ongoing emergency in Levski, Alliance Aid needs all hands on deck to help transport enough medical supplies to save as many lives as possible. There's a large scale haul over at [LOCATION] ready to be brought to [DESTINATION].

This run needs a hauler with a ship that can hold 8 SCU cargo containers. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to deal with the crates.

Please let me know if you can handle this for us.

Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. 这趟活儿得找个能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的运输船，还得带上便携式牵引光束来搬那些箱子。

玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

4559bcff-21c5-44e1-baa4-5d550c6d28dd.title: Alliance Aid: Molina Mold Samples
4559bcff-21c5-44e1-baa4-5d550c6d28dd.titleCn:
援助联盟：莫利纳霉菌样本
[采集部门 - 里程碑 - 资源收集]
4559bcff-21c5-44e1-baa4-5d550c6d28dd.description:
Let me start by saying that your continuing work helping the Alliance Aid efforts so far have made a considerable difference not only to us at Rayari, but to the rest of the organizations coordinating with the Collections Division. It's why I wanted to reach out to you directly.

While we have been making great strides in combating this ongoing health crisis, there is concern amongst our researchers that Molina Mold has the potential to mutate into a new fungal strain.
In order in ensure that our ongoing investigation into the mold is as accurate as possible, we would like you to head to the source of the growth in Levski and  harvest new samples of the Molina Mold  there directly.

Once you have the samples collected, you will then need to deliver them to [DESTINATION].

Thank you for your assistance at this vital juncture.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
4559bcff-21c5-44e1-baa4-5d550c6d28dd.descriptionCn:
首先，我想说，你迄今为止持续协助援助联盟工作的努力，不仅对我们拉亚利公司意义重大，也对与收集部门协调的其他组织产生了显著影响。正因如此，我才想直接联系你。

虽然我们在应对这场持续的健康危机方面已取得巨大进展，但我们的研究人员担心莫利纳霉菌有可能变异成一种全新的真菌菌株。
为了确保我们对这种霉菌的调查尽可能准确，我们希望你前往列夫斯基的霉菌滋生的源头，并直接采集新的莫利纳霉菌样本。

采集完样本之后，你需要将它们送到[DESTINATION]。

感谢你在这一关键时间节点提供的帮助。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

援助联盟：资源掠夺者
[防卫部门 - 击杀飞船 MRT]
f125cbdd-d2f9-41e8-9dac-bb88b1b3629c.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship
APPROVAL CODE = RT-05

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It seems that the People's Alliance aren't the only ones eager to get their hands on the resources needed to fight their Molina Mold outbreak. The Moraine gang has been hitting the shipping lanes hard trying to get their hands on as many haulers as they can. One particular member, [TARGET], and their crew have been especially successful, knocking over over a dozen ships. The folks organizing Alliance Aid are pretty eager to see this growing problem dealt with.

Recent reports have their hunting grounds over near [LOCATION]. Head there with any support ships you want to take and neutralize them before any more vital supplies are lost.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
f125cbdd-d2f9-41e8-9dac-bb88b1b3629c.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：击毁飞船
授权代码 = RT-05

需要立即处理

看来，除了人民联盟，冰碛帮也急着抢夺对抗莫利纳霉菌爆发所需的资源。他们疯狂袭击航线，拼命拦截运输船。其中一名成员 [TARGET] 及其团伙尤其“高效”，已打劫了十几艘船。负责援助联盟的那帮人，非常渴望看到这个日益严重的问题得到解决。

最新情报显示，他们的活动区域就在 [LOCATION] 附近。带上你想带的支援飞船赶过去，在更多关键物资流失前把他们消灭掉。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

b4aa8f20-baed-4e51-823c-628bceae5126.title: Alliance Aid: Security Needed
b4aa8f20-baed-4e51-823c-628bceae5126.titleCn:
援助联盟：需要安保
[防卫部门 - 飞船护航 MRT]
b4aa8f20-baed-4e51-823c-628bceae5126.description:
I was just contacted by an Alliance Aid rep who is deeply concerned for one of their contractors heading out from  [LOCATION]. The ships helping the relief effort have been drawing a lot of outlaw attention and they're worried that without extra protection they won't be able to finish their vital work.

Owing with the increased risk level and the value of the ship, it might behoove you to bring some combat support of your own along.

If you’re interested, head to the rendezvous and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
b4aa8f20-baed-4e51-823c-628bceae5126.descriptionCn:
我刚接到一位援助联盟代表的联络，他们非常担心一名正从 [LOCATION] 出发的承包商。参与救援行动的飞船已引来大量不法分子的关注，他们担心若无额外保护，将无法完成至关重要的工作。

鉴于风险等级提升及该飞船的重要价值，你或许该带上战斗支援。

如果你感兴趣，就前往会合点，等待进一步指示。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

0c00412c-47e4-49a2-a307-73524b57a95a.title: Alliance Aid: Ship in Distress
0c00412c-47e4-49a2-a307-73524b57a95a.titleCn:
援助联盟：飞船遇险
[防卫部门 - 保卫飞船 MRT]
0c00412c-47e4-49a2-a307-73524b57a95a.description:
You figure these outlaws would have the decency not to interfere with relief efforts but unfortunately we've gotten word that an Alliance Aid convoy is under attack. These criminals seem to be a serious threat so it would be recommended to bring some support along with you.

Once you're ready, head to [LOCATION] and face these criminals head on.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0c00412c-47e4-49a2-a307-73524b57a95a.descriptionCn:
本以为这些不法分子好歹会有点底线，不至于干扰救援行动，可惜我们刚收到消息，一支援助联盟护航舰队正遭到袭击。这些罪犯似乎威胁很大，建议你带上些支援一同前往。

准备好后，立刻前往[LOCATION]，正面迎战这些罪犯。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

53400464-c0f6-4a27-8095-c8ce288b372e.title: Alliance Aid: Ship in Trouble
53400464-c0f6-4a27-8095-c8ce288b372e.titleCn:
援助联盟：飞船有麻烦
[防卫部门 - 保卫飞船 LRT]
53400464-c0f6-4a27-8095-c8ce288b372e.description:
We’ve lost contact with an Alliance Aid supply convoy and are concerned it might be under attack from outlaws. We need you to hurry to [LOCATION] and support them. Any delays to the ongoing relief efforts could cost lives in Levski.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
53400464-c0f6-4a27-8095-c8ce288b372e.descriptionCn:
我们已与一支援助联盟物资护航舰队失去联系，我们担心其可能正遭受不法分子的袭击。我们需要你火速前往 [LOCATION] 支援他们。任何对当前救援行动的延误都可能导致列夫斯基地区人员伤亡。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

75270f8c-5afa-4c99-8dc1-77736f666bfe.title: Alliance Aid: Ship Under Attack
75270f8c-5afa-4c99-8dc1-77736f666bfe.titleCn:
援助联盟：飞船正遭袭击
[防卫部门 - 保卫飞船 HRT]
75270f8c-5afa-4c99-8dc1-77736f666bfe.description:
Everyone has been joining with Alliance Aid to help with the ongoing crisis in Levski, but it seems you can't do good in this 'verse without attracting the bad. One of the critical relief convoys was just attacked by a powerful outlaw fleet. We need you to put together a fleet of your own and deploy to [LOCATION] as soon as possible. With any luck, you may be able to right this wrong before it's too late.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
75270f8c-5afa-4c99-8dc1-77736f666bfe.descriptionCn:
所有人都在与援助联盟携手应对列夫斯基正在发生的危机，但似乎在这片星域里，行善总会招来恶势力。一支关键的救援护航舰队刚刚遭到一支强大不法分子舰队的袭击。我们需要你组建自己的舰队，并尽快部署至 [LOCATION]。但愿你能在为时已晚之前扭转局势。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

8ab75b1a-320d-473b-a894-a8a9ea849486.title: Alliance Aid: Small Supply of Research Resource
8ab75b1a-320d-473b-a894-a8a9ea849486.titleCn:
援助联盟：小量科研资源
[采集部门 - 资源收集]
8ab75b1a-320d-473b-a894-a8a9ea849486.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to [DESTINATION].

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
8ab75b1a-320d-473b-a894-a8a9ea849486.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利需要你的帮助。作为援助联盟行动的一部分，我们的科学家已将全部精力转向协助列夫斯基以应对莫利纳霉菌。不幸的是，由于缺乏一种关键资源，团队的研究进度已陷入停滞。

从常规供应商处获取该资源可能需要数周时间。考虑到眼下有大量民众急需救助，若研究中断这么久，必将严重影响我们的努力。我们希望能找到愿意主动采购并运送少量物资的热心人士，送至 [DESTINATION]。

请记住，合约绑定的货物由其合法所有者追踪，恕不接受。

让我们携手，为所有人创造更美好的宇宙。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

a5196d4e-6fb1-4e58-b3d8-3e7926bed6f0.titleCn:
援助联盟：制止货物抢劫
[防卫部门 - 取回货物 MRT]
a5196d4e-6fb1-4e58-b3d8-3e7926bed6f0.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-12

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Nothing like an emergency to bring out the worst in people. This Molina mold is killing people left and right, and what do the scum of this system decide to do? That's right, they're out there trying to highjack vital shipments. Alliance Aid wants us to make sure they don't get away with it.

You're going to head to the [LOCATION], assess the situation, neutralize any remaining hostiles in the area, and secure the shipment for delivery to [DESTINATION]. I expect these jackers to put up a good fight, so feel free to take along some backup if you want.

Be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to handle the cargo.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
a5196d4e-6fb1-4e58-b3d8-3e7926bed6f0.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：货物取回
授权代码 = JJ-12

需要立即处理

没什么比紧急情况更能把人最坏的一面逼出来了。这种莫利纳霉菌正在肆意夺人性命，可这星系里的渣滓们却在干啥？没错，他们正到处试图劫走关键物资。援助联盟希望我们确保他们不会逃脱惩罚。

你得赶去 [LOCATION]，评估现场情况，清除区域内所有剩余敌对势力，并把货物护送到 [DESTINATION]。我猜这些劫匪会拼死抵抗，所以如果你需要，尽管带上些支援力量。

记得带上手持式牵引光束来处理货物。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

780dd95b-899e-44e7-a62b-d6ba742d812f.title: Alliance Aid: Supply Thief
780dd95b-899e-44e7-a62b-d6ba742d812f.titleCn:
援助联盟：物资小偷
[防卫部门 - 击杀飞船 LRT]
780dd95b-899e-44e7-a62b-d6ba742d812f.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship
APPROVAL CODE = RT-04

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

With valuable shipments being transported to Levski thanks to this whole Alliance Aid thing, outlaws have been happy as clams targeting the loaded-up haulers. One particular scumbag, [TARGET], has hit a half-dozen ships so far and everyone's pretty eager to stop their spree in its tracks.

They were last spotted harrassing ships over at [LOCATION]. Head there and take out their ship. Payment will be issued once they're neutralized.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
780dd95b-899e-44e7-a62b-d6ba742d812f.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：击毁飞船
授权代码 = RT-04

需要立即处理

多亏了“援助联盟”这档子事，运往列夫斯基的贵重物资接连不断，不法分子们乐得像捡了宝似的，专挑满载货船下手。有个特别欠揍的混蛋叫 [TARGET]，至今已袭击了六艘船，大伙儿都巴不得赶紧把他这股歪风刹住。

他们最后一次被目击是在 [LOCATION] 附近骚扰过往船只。你去那儿把他的飞船干掉，等他被消灭后，报酬立马到账。

该合约不可转让。

7d138c74-7965-49eb-9025-206298978a72.titleCn:
援助联盟：挫败货物劫持
[防卫部门 - 取回货物 HRT]
7d138c74-7965-49eb-9025-206298978a72.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-13

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Alliance Aid just comm'd in a panic. A vital shipment that they were counting on hasn't shown up. All signs point to it getting jacked by thieves along the way so they're counting on us to make sure it gets delivered.

You're going to head to the [LOCATION], assess the situation, neutralize any remaining hostiles in the area, and secure the shipment for drop off at [DESTINATION]. Be sure to have a few support ships with you just in case things get extra rough.

Be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to handle the cargo.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

合约 & 派遣

合约类型：货物取回
授权代码 = JJ-13

需要立即处理

援助联盟刚急匆匆发来消息，他们指望的一批关键物资迟迟没到。种种迹象表明，货在路上被窃贼劫了，所以他们指望我们确保这批货能安全送达。

你得赶去 [LOCATION]，评估现场情况，清除区域内所有剩余敌对势力，并把货物护送到 [DESTINATION]。最好带上几艘支援飞船，以防情况特别棘手。

d6f3a5af-bf63-45b2-aff8-3d4892f86714.title: Alliance Aid: Treatment Cargo Haul - Large Scale
d6f3a5af-bf63-45b2-aff8-3d4892f86714.titleCn:
援助联盟：治疗货物运输 - 大规模
[运输部门 - 货物运输]
d6f3a5af-bf63-45b2-aff8-3d4892f86714.description:
Hi,

People are breathing a sigh of relief that a treatment for the People's Aliment has been found, but we're not out of the woods just yet. There's still plenty of folks suffering . We're hoping you can help the cause by handling a large scale haul of the stuff.

If you're available, we need you to pick up from [LOCATION] and then fly it over to [DESTINATION]. Remember to bring a handheld tractor beam and a ship that can hold 16 SCU cargo containers.


Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
d6f3a5af-bf63-45b2-aff8-3d4892f86714.descriptionCn:
嗨，

人们得知人民病的治疗方法已被找到后都松了一口气，但我们还没完全脱离困境——仍有不少人正在受苦。我们希望你能帮忙，接手这批大规模运输任务。

如果你有空，请从 [LOCATION] 取货，然后运送到 [DESTINATION]。记得带上一把手持式牵引光束，以及一艘能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船。

运输平安，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

e9120f31-dac9-4a86-8d17-8423c4d3d835.titleCn:
援助联盟：治疗货物运输 - 中规模
[运输部门 - 货物运输]
e9120f31-dac9-4a86-8d17-8423c4d3d835.description:
Hey,

Pretty heartbreaking hearing what's happening to the people out in Levski with this Molina mold outbreak? Our family has decided to do all we can to help out with Alliance Aid.  Got a medium scale haul of antifungal waiting to be picked up at [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION]. Think you can handle this for us?

Before you go, please make sure you bring a ship that can hold 8 SCU cargo containers. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to deal with the containers.


Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
e9120f31-dac9-4a86-8d17-8423c4d3d835.descriptionCn:
嘿，

听说列夫斯基那边的人正遭莫利纳霉菌肆虐，真是让人心碎。我们全家都决定尽己所能参与“援助联盟”。手头有一批中等规模的抗真菌药，正等着从 [LOCATION] 取货，运到 [DESTINATION]。你方便接这单吗？

出发前记得带艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船，还得备上一支手持式牵引光束来搬那些箱子。

运输平安，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

d02ccc89-d92a-49d1-8f8e-cacde1a022e8.description:

f5e3f732-7221-42d4-8d22-1bf2aa4ae2d0.title: Alliance Aid: Urgent Rescue Mission
f5e3f732-7221-42d4-8d22-1bf2aa4ae2d0.titleCn:
援助联盟：紧急救援任务
[防卫部门 - 里程碑 - 取回货物]
f5e3f732-7221-42d4-8d22-1bf2aa4ae2d0.description:
Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack.

We need you to hurry to [LOCATION], neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
f5e3f732-7221-42d4-8d22-1bf2aa4ae2d0.descriptionCn:
鉴于你一直在协助防卫部门做了大量工作，我想直接把这份合约交给你。这事儿有点敏感。有两位重要人物生病了，我们担心一旦消息走漏，他们被运送的消息会让他们成为主要目标。

不幸的是，情况似乎正是如此。我们试图将他们从尼克斯秘密送往斯坦顿接受治疗的行动失败了，现在载着他们的飞船正遭到攻击。

我们需要你火速赶往 [LOCATION]，击退袭击者，并确保冷冻舱安全抵达 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。

实际上，我希望你准备一艘能运载冷冻舱的飞船，以防他们原来的运输工具受损严重无法继续使用。

我真心希望你能顺利完成这次救援任务。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

e58a968a-5288-485e-aa7a-8c74d0aea8c6.title: Alliance Aid: Vital Package Retrieval
e58a968a-5288-485e-aa7a-8c74d0aea8c6.titleCn:
援助联盟：取回重要包裹
[运输部门 - 包裹投递]
e58a968a-5288-485e-aa7a-8c74d0aea8c6.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid has not completed it's contract. The last known location has it still over at [LOCATION]. A courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to [DESTINATION].

THREAT LEVEL – It is unclear what happened to the ship, but we expect a malfunction. Still, caution is advised. Low level engagements expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

FTL Courier Services is proud to be assisting in Alliance Aid efforts to help fight the Levski outbreak.
e58a968a-5288-485e-aa7a-8c74d0aea8c6.descriptionCn:
全体超光速快递员注意
急需分配

**合约细节**

取件地点 – 一艘搭载着援助联盟物资的超光速快递飞船未能完成其合约。最后已知位置显示它仍停留在 [LOCATION]。需要一名快递员取回包裹并继续完成配送。

投递地点 – 包裹必须被送到 [DESTINATION]。

威胁等级 – 目前尚不清楚飞船发生了什么，但我们推测是出现了故障。不过仍需谨慎行事。预计会遇到低级别交火。

交通方式 –  所有交通需求应由快递员自行安排。

超光速快递服务很荣幸能够协助援助联盟，共同抗击列夫斯基的疫情。

3798c883-ddd7-430d-91cc-68626190c68a.title: Ambush Op
3798c883-ddd7-430d-91cc-68626190c68a.titleCn:
伏击行动
[猎头帮 - 伏击 MRT]
3798c883-ddd7-430d-91cc-68626190c68a.description:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a [TARGET]. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by [LOCATION]. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike.

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 5 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

- Stows
3798c883-ddd7-430d-91cc-68626190c68a.descriptionCn:
咱们猎头帮有个金主挂了悬赏要搞掉 [TARGET]。干完这票让他乐呵乐呵？

情报如下：目标船队会经过 [LOCATION]。附近有有片辐射云能藏住飞船信号，猫那儿等动手时机就行。

金主只要目标死透。残骸里捞到的好货都归你。

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

817147a6-735b-45fb-95be-5962a7f11c95.title: Ambush XenoThreat Strike Wing
817147a6-735b-45fb-95be-5962a7f11c95.titleCn:
伏击异种威胁打击编队
[福克斯韦尔 - 异种 伏击]
817147a6-735b-45fb-95be-5962a7f11c95.description:
Been handed some strong intel on a XenoThreat strike wing's flightpath. Looking for contractors who can dust off now and be set up at [LOCATION] ahead of them. Local conditions will mask your scanner signatures so you can give them the surprise of their lives. Let's turn the hunters into the hunted.

Interested?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
817147a6-735b-45fb-95be-5962a7f11c95.descriptionCn:
已收到关于异种威胁打击编队飞行路线的可靠情报。现招募承包商，即刻出发并在 [LOCATION] 提前部署待命。当地环境将遮蔽你的扫描信号，让你给对方一个大大的惊喜。让我们把猎人变成猎物。

有兴趣吗？

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

9dfe4a76-5bae-4ca6-a23b-465adda68acb.title: Annihilating the Alliance
9dfe4a76-5bae-4ca6-a23b-465adda68acb.titleCn:
歼灭联盟
[沃恩 - 刺杀 人民联盟 ERT]
9dfe4a76-5bae-4ca6-a23b-465adda68acb.description:
I am thrilled to inform you that we have a particularly ambitious assignment for you.

[TARGET] has been marked for termination. You may know them already: a particularly high-profile member of the People’s Alliance who is notorious for having thwarted numerous attempts against their life. We initially considered it too troublesome until our client offered an even more outrageous amount of credits to see this to completion.

The target’s last known location was at [LOCATION]. Expect a top-of-the-line ship and a skilled escort.

We look forward to hearing about their untimely demise.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
9dfe4a76-5bae-4ca6-a23b-465adda68acb.descriptionCn:
我很高兴地通知你，我们有一个特别有挑战性的任务交给你。[TARGET] 已经被标记为清除目标。你可能已经认识他们了：人民联盟一个特别高调的成员，以多次挫败谋杀他们的企图而臭名昭著。我们最初觉得这太麻烦了，直到我们客户愿意开价更高的信用点来完成这个任务。

目标最后已知的位置在 [LOCATION]。预计他们会有一艘顶级飞船和一名技术娴熟的护卫陪同。

我们期待听到他们意外死亡的消息。

此致，
沃恩

ffc306fa-ef8a-4446-a44f-7745e7531c6c.title: Another Chance to Impress
ffc306fa-ef8a-4446-a44f-7745e7531c6c.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

有角和绳子的护甲

eda899b9-c58b-48df-88d9-6b34368af2f2.description:
Hello, know many humans want saldynium for regen problem. Credits good, yes, but Wikelo can use that, kopion horn, and other things to make special armor.

Once done, you be very tough. Very scary.

You see items needed. Bring to [DESTINATIONS] and I make for you.

Bye.
eda899b9-c58b-48df-88d9-6b34368af2f2.descriptionCn:
你好。知道很多人需要烁迪银解决再生问题。信用点商品固然不错，但维科洛可以用它，加上寇骈犬角和其他材料，打造特殊护甲。

完成后你将坚不可摧，凶悍骇人。

372b0eff-0e55-4654-a3ca-542058cb84cf.description:
Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.

Bring things. Will do.

Bye.
372b0eff-0e55-4654-a3ca-542058cb84cf.descriptionCn:

带东西过来。我就做。

再见。

5bf19672-f057-4ccf-bdd4-d309edfeea15.descriptionCn: 维科洛改的阿斯加德，让它战斗能力更强。你在打架时候，这个改款就是你想要的。而且。交易价格很优惠。只要把东西带来，我就给你这艘船。

eacc9ce4-1675-4dad-b419-cab6b94e93b7.title: Assist People's Alliance Vessel Tranquility
eacc9ce4-1675-4dad-b419-cab6b94e93b7.titleCn:
协助人民联盟飞船宁静号
[互安防务 - 战术打击群]
eacc9ce4-1675-4dad-b419-cab6b94e93b7.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing:
An Idris-class People's Alliance security vessel named Tranquility is currently engaged with a Vanduul capital ship near an old QV Extraction station and Intersec is looking for combat pilots to lend some support.

Scramble to the AO and engage Vanduul fighters so the Tranquility can focus on the capital ship.

Good luck,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
eacc9ce4-1675-4dad-b419-cab6b94e93b7.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：
一艘名为宁静号的伊德里斯级的人民联盟安保飞船正在一处旧的 QV 采矿站附近与一艘剜度主力舰交战，互安正招募战斗飞行员前去支援。

赶紧赶往行动区域，干掉那些剜度战斗机，好让宁静号专心对付那艘主力舰。

祝好运，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

e52d12a1-cf64-4a15-8662-985a0ff39169.title: Assist Retreating Ship
e52d12a1-cf64-4a15-8662-985a0ff39169.titleCn:
协助撤退飞船
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 & 轰炸 MRT]
e52d12a1-cf64-4a15-8662-985a0ff39169.description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [LOCATION]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away.

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
e52d12a1-cf64-4a15-8662-985a0ff39169.descriptionCn:
我们的一名成员目前在 [LOCATION] 遭到攻击。他们试图躲避攻击者以安全撤离，但不法分子太过高明，导致他们无法摆脱。

我们需要你飞到那里，与攻击者交战，然后摧毁附近的燃料储备。希望这种破坏的展示能让他们放弃继续追击。

利马·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

9e21b3ba-2cd0-43c1-bcb7-3c9a6c20f0e1.title: Assistance needed at [LOCATION]
9e21b3ba-2cd0-43c1-bcb7-3c9a6c20f0e1.description:
We received a distress call from [LOCATION] saying that they're being robbed by a small group of outlaws. [LOCATION] Though remote, this outpost is a crucial piece of CFP's infrastructure in the area so we need to take it back.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
9e21b3ba-2cd0-43c1-bcb7-3c9a6c20f0e1.descriptionCn:
我们收到来自 [LOCATION] 的求救信号，报告称他们正遭到一小群不法分子的抢劫。[LOCATION] 虽然偏远，但这个前哨站是繁荣公民在该地区基础设施的重要组成部分，所以我们需要夺回来。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

2fba83a9-7652-40a7-b761-1cf8651bbc34.title: ATLS Cool Metal Color
2fba83a9-7652-40a7-b761-1cf8651bbc34.description: Wikelo give deep red and green colors to make ATLS legs look like they cooling from heat. Very pretty.

1a9c813d-f143-49e6-addf-5d068a456cc5.title: ATLS Orange Line
1a9c813d-f143-49e6-addf-5d068a456cc5.description: Many Human work place have orange color there. Must mean work to you. This suit does work. Make sense.

f83b5d86-edb1-4eee-83b9-6af438f62141.description:

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
f83b5d86-edb1-4eee-83b9-6af438f62141.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民正在寻找任何有空的战斗员前往 [LOCATION] 。一群不法分子发起了毫无理由的攻击，我们的安全人员迫切需要支援。

请尽快赶往 [LOCATION]，祝你们好运。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

00f6bc40-ad77-4404-a3b7-8e5cabb19c00.title: Back up needed at outpost
00f6bc40-ad77-4404-a3b7-8e5cabb19c00.description:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against [LOCATION] so we're looking for people to go fend them off.

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.
00f6bc40-ad77-4404-a3b7-8e5cabb19c00.descriptionCn:
那些异种威胁的朋克们正在袭击 [LOCATION]，所以我们需要找人去抵御他们。

出发，把你看到的每一个异种威胁都干掉。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

b887441b-aa1f-4c62-a840-301030c25ea7.title: Backup Needed Now
b887441b-aa1f-4c62-a840-301030c25ea7.titleCn:
现在需要增援
[猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 MRT]
b887441b-aa1f-4c62-a840-301030c25ea7.description:
Some People’s Alliance members with a death wish decided to target one of our ships. Need someone to hustle over to [LOCATION] and show ‘em what happens when you mess with the Headhunters.

Stows out.
b887441b-aa1f-4c62-a840-301030c25ea7.descriptionCn:
有些人民联盟的成员想找死，决定袭击我们的飞船。需要有人赶紧去 [LOCATION]，让他们知道惹上猎头帮会有什么后果。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

92e538af-c256-412a-98c8-d75115f8f39c.title: Bad at Goodbyes
92e538af-c256-412a-98c8-d75115f8f39c.titleCn:
不善告别
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 ERT]
92e538af-c256-412a-98c8-d75115f8f39c.description:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION], we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros
92e538af-c256-412a-98c8-d75115f8f39c.descriptionCn:
我们有个大活儿要找个真正的狠角色。我们正在想办法让某个人彻底消失，消得一干二净，其中一部分就是从那个人最近在 [LOCATION] 那边出的“事故”里把黑匣子捞出来。

问题是——这个人雇来策划这场事故的家伙们，现在觉得这事儿能赚更多，干脆赖在那艘死人飞船旁边不走了，不肯撒手。

这帮人可不讲武德，你最好带俩帮手，不然分分钟凉透。但只要你能把黑匣子搞出来，送到 [DESTINATION]，咱保证让你赚得盆满钵满。

- 零比特

e6026349-8057-4010-900a-c705ad176f6b.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR74382
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A known outlaw attacked and destroyed a ship near [LOCATION]. The agency has been contracted to retrieve the ship’s blackbox in order to build a case against them and lobby for Advocacy intervention.

Contract Investigator Actions:
An operative is needed to head to the crime scene at [LOCATION], secure the area from any hostiles present to procure the blackbox, and deliver to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Be advised that there are still hostile forces in the area that will attack. These will most likely have some experience fighting, so be prepared.

This contract has been flagged as a combat mission.

需要一名特工前往 [LOCATION] 的犯罪现场，确保该区域安全，排除任何敌对势力，然后取回黑匣子并将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

b5d27cbd-f9ed-4d4f-b64a-c5133ed3ad3f.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
This request comes down from Head Office.

We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near [LOCATION] might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a top-tier operative with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.

There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to [LOCATION] and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.
b5d27cbd-f9ed-4d4f-b64a-c5133ed3ad3f.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR547384
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
这个请求来自总部。

我们刚刚得知，最近在 [LOCATION] 附近发生的飞船袭击可能是由一个臭名昭著且难以捉摸的非法分子团伙所为。他们上次露面已经是多年前的事了，所以这是一个难得的机会。我们的客户不想错过这个机会。我们需要一名具有精英战斗经验的顶级特工来回收这艘被击落飞船的黑匣子，以证明该团伙的参与。

现场将有训练有素的敌对势力，它们会对你的到来进行强烈抵抗。消灭它们并完成任务。

合约调查员的行动：
立即前往 [LOCATION]，清理周围的空域以确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
总部强调，这将是一个极其艰巨的任务。一定要全力以赴。

f912aaa1-24d5-4f6c-b89f-00dc201e5c98.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
f912aaa1-24d5-4f6c-b89f-00dc201e5c98.titleCn:
前沿科技
[零比特 - 物品取回]
f912aaa1-24d5-4f6c-b89f-00dc201e5c98.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros
f912aaa1-24d5-4f6c-b89f-00dc201e5c98.descriptionCn:
好不容易才锁定一件稀有科技，结果却在最后一秒被人截胡。追踪它倒是不难，但我可不想一直追着这东西跑。

去 [LOCATION] 把它给我找回来。那边的人估计压根不知道那玩意儿有多贵重，不如我们帮他们一把，顺手把东西拿走。至于有没有人看守，我也不清楚，怎么应对潜在威胁你自己看着办。

拿到手后，把它送到 [DESTINATION]，到时候我们就给你打信用点。

- 零比特

1be73883-dc91-42e8-8c37-db3b925cebe3.title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
1be73883-dc91-42e8-8c37-db3b925cebe3.titleCn: 封锁异种威胁的扩张（极高风险 VHRT）
1be73883-dc91-42e8-8c37-db3b925cebe3.description:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it.

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.

Think you can rise to the occasion?

-Stows
1be73883-dc91-42e8-8c37-db3b925cebe3.descriptionCn:
异种威胁现在正处于战争状态，他们正同时对好几个猎头帮站点发动攻击，把我们的战士们逼得筋疲力尽。我得到消息，他们计划下一个突袭 [LOCATION]，而我们找不到人来保卫它。

我想雇个人来着急一群人，准备好补给，为我们建立一个强大的防御力量。实话跟你说，这会是一场激烈的战斗。异种们派了一些最有经验的部队过去。我只能说他们可能会错开他们的部队，把他们全部歼灭，你会得到丰厚的报酬。

你觉得你能应对的了吗？

- 斯托斯

2781f353-feb8-46e9-a067-15453cbc6f04.title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
2781f353-feb8-46e9-a067-15453cbc6f04.titleCn:

[猎头帮 - 轰炸 繁荣公民 MRT]
2781f353-feb8-46e9-a067-15453cbc6f04.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong.

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [LOCATION] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out
2781f353-feb8-46e9-a067-15453cbc6f04.descriptionCn:
我对繁荣公民插手不该管的事感到非常厌烦。

我开始觉得让他们的舰队暂时趴一阵子可能会不错。让我们在 [LOCATION] 炸掉他们的燃料罐，这些小家伙就不会轻易动了。

这听起来像是你喜欢的事吗？

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

57333cdf-fae8-439b-9701-cc4dd1978412.titleCn: 赏金任务：[TARGET]（高风险目标 HRT）
57333cdf-fae8-439b-9701-cc4dd1978412.description:
Hey,

Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name [TARGET] is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at [LOCATION].

Our intel suggests that [TARGET]’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to [TARGET].

That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
57333cdf-fae8-439b-9701-cc4dd1978412.descriptionCn:
嘿，

有一份需要比平时更多策略的合约。一个叫做 [TARGET] 的高等级罪犯正与大量非法分子躲藏在 [LOCATION]。

我们的情报显示出 [TARGET] 的手下很可能是为了保护他们的老板而集结的。我猜你必须先解决掉他们才能找到 [TARGET]。

话虽如此，我并不希望你进行无差别攻击。有时这些法外之徒身边会有一些平民，应该把他们当作非战斗人员。

祝你好运

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

击败强敌
[猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 HRT]
36ac4116-9283-462b-9204-a7c7752ffeae.description:
Sent ships to investigate a distress beacon only for it to turn into an ambush by the People’s Alliance. They’ve been fighting like hell to get away but can’t seem to extract themselves.

Let’s get ‘em some help on the double. Think you can go on over to [LOCATION] to give ‘em some support?

-Stows
36ac4116-9283-462b-9204-a7c7752ffeae.descriptionCn:
我们派了飞船去调查一个求救信号，结果却遭遇了人民联盟的埋伏。他们拼命战斗想要逃脱，但似乎还是没能脱身。

我们得赶紧给他们派些支援。你觉得你能去 [LOCATION] 给他们提供一些帮助吗？

大宗科瓦莱什货物需要追回
[科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 非常困难 无战斗]
29b71c1b-4776-4914-b46b-76f09483e9d6.description:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this all behind us.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
29b71c1b-4776-4914-b46b-76f09483e9d6.descriptionCn:
嗨，

情况是这样的，我跟那个承包商打了一小时通讯，帮他排查飞船故障，最后实在搞不定，只能换人上。现在得赶紧派你去 [LOCATION] 那儿帮忙完成交付。

这单不小，你得开艘能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船。除非你臂力爆表，否则必须配把重型牵引光束才搬得动。

我真心感激你，要是能搞定这个的话。货一拿到手就直送 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里去，这样这事儿就算翻篇了。

[SIGN_OFF]

d78aeb05-10f8-4314-9b98-e13f1264140a.title: Campaign to reclaim XenoThreat outposts
d78aeb05-10f8-4314-9b98-e13f1264140a.titleCn: 夺回异种威胁前哨站战役
d78aeb05-10f8-4314-9b98-e13f1264140a.description:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near [LOCATION] were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of [TARGET].

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out [TARGET], who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
d78aeb05-10f8-4314-9b98-e13f1264140a.descriptionCn:
虽然繁荣公民致力于通过非暴力手段实现变革，但显然可能需要做出例外。位于 [LOCATION] 附近的繁荣公民安全区最近被异种威胁部队在 [TARGET] 的指挥下暴力夺取。

我们正在寻找任何有空的作战人员来帮助夺回这些前哨站。这无疑将是一项艰巨的任务，因为异种威胁部队训练有素且渴望战斗，所以你应该做好相应的准备。

除了清理每个集群的异种威胁部队之外，你还需要解决 [TARGET]，他的失去无疑会让星系更加安全。

祝你好运。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

46bfc095-8909-ff58-5162-4c2a932d6c92.title: Capture Arlington Gang Leader Maltrox Arlington
46bfc095-8909-ff58-5162-4c2a932d6c92.titleCn: 逮捕阿灵顿帮领袖马尔特克斯·阿灵顿
46bfc095-8909-ff58-5162-4c2a932d6c92.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.

A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
46bfc095-8909-ff58-5162-4c2a932d6c92.descriptionCn:

合约 & 差事

合约类型：集体逮捕令
合约状态：独立
授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

4472405b-dc81-4b7e-8845-bbd4b66554cf.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
4472405b-dc81-4b7e-8845-bbd4b66554cf.titleCn:
与玲家快递的货运机遇
[玲家快递 - 货运 入门]
4472405b-dc81-4b7e-8845-bbd4b66554cf.description:
Hi,

This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.

Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.

If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of [ITEM] that needs to go from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold 2 SCU cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around.

Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.


Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
4472405b-dc81-4b7e-8845-bbd4b66554cf.descriptionCn:
嗨，

我是佩特拉·玲，很荣幸能为你提供与玲家快递合作的新机会。我爸妈当初开这家公司，就是想在十字军这一带做又快又稳的快递服务，结果一炮而红，名气越大，生意也越做越大。

现在，在我的管理下，玲家快递即将迈出新的重要一步——开展货运业务。这项新服务的需求增长速度超出了我的预期，这对我们双方来说都是好消息。

如果你一直想从事货运行业，那么这个机会能帮你实现梦想。实践是最好的学习方式，我正好有一单 [ITEM] 需要从 [LOCATION] 运到 [DESTINATION]。

虽然不需要有相关经验，但有以下几点需要注意：所有提货和交付都必须通过货运电梯完成，或者使用自动装载。你需要有一艘能装得下最大 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并且需要配备手持式牵引光束来搬运货物。

如果这次运输任务顺利完成，你将被提升为“值得信赖承包商”，之后会有更多的运输任务等着你。


此致，
佩特拉·玲
货运运营总经理
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

f7cb7b85-10ca-4e4d-b874-082611618939.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
f7cb7b85-10ca-4e4d-b874-082611618939.titleCn:
与玲家快递的货运机遇
[玲家快递 - 货运 入门]
f7cb7b85-10ca-4e4d-b874-082611618939.description:
Hi,

Guess the folks at [DESTINATION] are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

Please remember to bring a handheld tractor beam, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to 8 SCU.


Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
f7cb7b85-10ca-4e4d-b874-082611618939.descriptionCn:
嗨，

[DESTINATION] 那帮人估计是准备要开派对了，急着把东西凑齐。你得跑好几个地方提货，其中一个还得去尼克斯拿点“金克斯金酒”——你没喝过吧？那可是尼克斯的招牌，有人嫌它粉嘟嘟地发光，但我超爱，就爱喝那一口独特的劲道。

以下是取货地点：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

别忘了带上手持式牵引光束，集装箱最大能到 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸，没它真搞不定。


运货顺利，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

f56b2ee1-1729-4374-a2d5-f6a5607f3a5d.title: Cargo Retrieval
f56b2ee1-1729-4374-a2d5-f6a5607f3a5d.description:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a 32 SCU load, and try not to get shot in the process. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.
f56b2ee1-1729-4374-a2d5-f6a5607f3a5d.descriptionCn:
需要有人帮我们拿些货物。我们之前在一个老旧的哈索尔平台校准设施上进行秘密情报传递，但当地的帮派已经在那里扎根了，我们无法取回我们的东西。

如果你想动手的话，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯上拿走货物，然后送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯上。

我听说这个地方混杂着各种人。拿回我们的东西可不容易，但这就是我们花钱付雇你的原因。

确保你有一艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 货物的飞船，并尽量在过程中不要被打中。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

75d44d7d-ea8b-428d-8fc4-45789946e3e0.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
75d44d7d-ea8b-428d-8fc4-45789946e3e0.titleCn:
货物运输必须完成
[繁荣公民 - 取回货物 VHRT]
75d44d7d-ea8b-428d-8fc4-45789946e3e0.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at [LOCATION] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
75d44d7d-ea8b-428d-8fc4-45789946e3e0.descriptionCn:
最近越来越多繁荣公民的飞船遭到袭击，尽管我们竭尽全力保持贸易航线低调，仍不断有运输员在不法分子的攻击中丧生。

位于 [LOCATION] 的飞行员就是最新一位牺牲者。想到我们已损失如此之多，实在令人心痛；但只要还有人需要我们的帮助，我们就必须继续战斗。

如果你有一艘能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，以及一把重型牵引光束，请立刻前往上述地点，把货物取回来。

这任务可不轻松。这位飞行员是我们最顶尖的成员之一，绝不会轻易被击倒。切勿低估这些不法分子，带上信得过的船员，彼此照应、互相掩护。

取回货物后，请将其送至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处，我会安排后续处理。

祝你好运，务必小心，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

59c42923-5140-4b18-b074-8d2ff21a25f0.title: Cargo Transfer from Shuttered Facility
59c42923-5140-4b18-b074-8d2ff21a25f0.titleCn: 从关闭的设施转移货物
59c42923-5140-4b18-b074-8d2ff21a25f0.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, [LOCATION], still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.
59c42923-5140-4b18-b074-8d2ff21a25f0.descriptionCn:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

联合科学与开发公司(ASD)联系了我们，好像是他们以前的一个实验室，[LOCATION]，那里还存放着一些他们想要取回的物资。

你应该驾驶一艘能够能装下最大 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，降落在机库中，通过货运电梯装货，然后把所有东西运回 [DESTINATION]。

在设施那边的时候，一定要保持警惕，别让好奇心占了上风。像这样的废弃地点可能会藏着各种危险的东西。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

尽力做到最好 – 为你所做的工作感到自豪，这样你就会做出值得骄傲的成绩。

11a02a92-4e8b-47c6-be5b-40cd1b295867.title: Checking For a Pulse
11a02a92-4e8b-47c6-be5b-40cd1b295867.titleCn:
检查脉搏
[沃恩 - 寻找尸体 LRT]
11a02a92-4e8b-47c6-be5b-40cd1b295867.description:
A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of [TARGET] for us.

The target’s body should be located at [LOCATION]. I need you to give the hopefully deceased an inspection to ensure the job was completed to our standard.

Do be careful when you arrive at the location. It wouldn’t surprise me if there was a few vultures lurking around.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
11a02a92-4e8b-47c6-be5b-40cd1b295867.descriptionCn:
我们的一位相当有创意的前承包商，特别擅长制造事故，忙得忘了给我们确认 [TARGET] 的死亡情况。

目标的尸体应该在 [LOCATION] 那里。我需要你去检查一下那位但愿已经去世的人，确保这事儿做得符合我们的标准。

你到达地点时可得小心点。要是有几个秃鹫在附近转悠，我一点都不会惊讶。

此致，
沃恩

93113c47-1c37-4e7f-bda3-76911dfebd67.descriptionCn: 请注意，由于许可打捞的飞船尺寸较大，建议使用大型打捞飞船。

19c585ab-668f-4865-990e-f5978656f204.title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
19c585ab-668f-4865-990e-f5978656f204.titleCn:
帮人收拾烂摊子
[死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 LRT]
19c585ab-668f-4865-990e-f5978656f204.description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at [LOCATION]. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to [DESTINATION] and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch
19c585ab-668f-4865-990e-f5978656f204.descriptionCn:
你有没有过那种感觉——问别人问题时，明明觉得他在撒谎，可你还是选择信他一回？对，我现在就处在这种状况。

我雇了两个自称“专家”的运输工，帮我运点货，结果他们半路出事，直接把我的货扔在了 [LOCATION]。不用说，我已经下了追杀令，但现在我需要你去把那批货给捞回来。追踪器显示货还在船上，你只需要带个重型牵引光束和你自己的船，直接去拖走就行。

可能会有几个捡破烂的在那边晃荡，不过我觉得你应付起来应该不费劲。

搞定之后，把货送到 [DESTINATION]，报酬少不了你的。

- 刺痛

fb6e0113-40d2-41b8-8dd8-1f144c8602e8.title: Clear CFP Route of Hostiles
fb6e0113-40d2-41b8-8dd8-1f144c8602e8.titleCn:
清除繁荣公民航线上的敌对目标
[繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 LRT 多波次]
fb6e0113-40d2-41b8-8dd8-1f144c8602e8.description:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.

You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
fb6e0113-40d2-41b8-8dd8-1f144c8602e8.descriptionCn:
为保护我方飞行员，繁荣公民常建议采用星系内不那么传统的航线。然而，似乎一伙不法分子已获悉此事，并开始在其中一条航线上反复设伏。与其绕行避险、任其隐患蔓延至新路线，我们更倾向于正面迎击这些不法分子。

你及你召集来的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对势力。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

19dc90c7-ee82-4e8b-8dff-605f93a215d8.description:
Long story, short - a Headhunter messed up real bad and now Citizens for Prosperity has gotten their hands on some data that could really do some damage to us.

The bastard is going to need some time to heal so that leaves it to you to clean up the mess. Can you go to [LOCATION] and destroy the servers they got stored there? I wanna make sure there's no chance of this info getting out there.

-Stows out
19dc90c7-ee82-4e8b-8dff-605f93a215d8.descriptionCn:
长话短说——有个猎头帮成员搞砸了，现在繁荣公民手里有一些可能对我们造成严重损害的数据。

那个家伙需要一些时间来恢复，所以这就得由你来收拾这个烂摊子。你能去 [LOCATION] 把他们存放的服务器砸了吗？我想确保这些信息绝对不会泄露出去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。
