504b3587-bd86-4ed4-9673-36f944537b33.title: Collect Irradiated Kopion Horns
504b3587-bd86-4ed4-9673-36f944537b33.titleCn: 采集受辐射的寇骈犬角
504b3587-bd86-4ed4-9673-36f944537b33.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver.

There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near [LOCATION]. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect irradiated kopion horns and deliver them to [DESTINATION]. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
504b3587-bd86-4ed4-9673-36f944537b33.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正在全力以赴阻止重生技术危机的进一步恶化，但我们的科学家要继续他们的研究，就需要一些公司供应商无法交付的资源。

在 [LOCATION] 附近有一大群暴露在辐射下的寇骈犬。拉亚利正在寻找承包商收集 受辐射的寇骈犬角 并将其送至 [DESTINATION]。由于这种资源的稀缺性，我们准备支付高额的服务费。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

55fbb3c8-589c-44ff-b7e4-fb969d7c7fdb.title: Collect Irradiated Valakkar Eggs
55fbb3c8-589c-44ff-b7e4-fb969d7c7fdb.titleCn: 采集受辐射的瓦拉卡蛋
55fbb3c8-589c-44ff-b7e4-fb969d7c7fdb.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are working day and night to solve the current regen crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need rare resources that the company's suppliers cannot deliver.

We are therefore seeking a contractor to secure an irradiated valakkar egg. Our scans have confirmed several radioactive storms with known a valakkar presence on Pyro I, you can find a shuttle near [LOCATION] that will take you inside the storm. One more thing, analysis indicates that these eggs will decay over time, the state of the egg shouldn't affect our research but sooner would be better.

Due to the health risks associated with radiation exposure that will be needed to deliver a viable sample, Rayari is ready to pay well for anyone who can safely secure and deliver this item.

Once attained, please take this valuable resource to [DESTINATION].

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
55fbb3c8-589c-44ff-b7e4-fb969d7c7fdb.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正在日夜不停地解决当前的再生危机，但我们的科学家需要一些公司供应商无法提供的稀有资源，以继续他们的研究工作。

因此，我们正在寻找一位承包商来获取一枚 受辐射的瓦拉卡蛋。我们的扫描确认了派罗 I 上存在几个带有瓦拉卡踪迹的放射性风暴，你可以在 [LOCATION] 附近找到一艘穿梭机，它将带你进入风暴。还有一点，分析表明这些蛋会随时间逐渐腐坏，蛋的状态应该不会影响到我们的研究，但越快越好。

由于获取可靠样本需要面对辐射暴露带来的健康风险，拉亚利准备为任何能够安全获取并运送该物品的人支付丰厚报酬。

一旦收集完成，请将这份珍贵资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

19af8557-23f9-424d-81ed-79090c74d202.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
19af8557-23f9-424d-81ed-79090c74d202.description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing.

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to [LOCATION] to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 1 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
19af8557-23f9-424d-81ed-79090c74d202.descriptionCn:
想获得与各种目标和情况作战的关键实战经验吗？那我的战斗挑战可能正适合你。

请理解，这个课程是为那些已经掌握飞行基础、准备将技能提升到更高水平的飞行员设计的。如果你刚开始，想学习基础知识，我建议你在竞技指挥官模拟舱中多练习几小时。但对于那些准备迎接真正挑战的人，我坚信学生通过实践学习效果最好。

这就是为什么我设计了这八个场景，尽量做到尽可能真实。我向你保证，这将是你在不参军的情况下，最接近海军战斗飞行员训练的体验，所以不要指望会有人过多照顾。您自身或您飞船受伤的风险应当被极其严肃地对待。

挑战场景：
1. 单一目标
2. 复数目标
3. 目标优先级
4. 目标隐身
5. 导弹与对策
6. 多船员目标
7. 带护航的护卫舰
8. 主力舰遭遇战

所以，如果你准备好挑战自己并证明你有成为优秀飞行员的能力，第一场景将专注于处理单一目标。前往 [LOCATION] 开始。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 情境意识 - 不要太专注于攻击目标以至于忽视了你的飞行路径。如果你一头撞上小行星，那就没什么意义了。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

3719aedc-23bf-4907-9bf8-ec566b674786.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #2
3719aedc-23bf-4907-9bf8-ec566b674786.description:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to [LOCATION] to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 3 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
3719aedc-23bf-4907-9bf8-ec566b674786.descriptionCn:
恭喜完成八节课程的第一部分。

场景 2 将重点训练同时应对多个目标的能力。本环节旨在帮助你更好地掌握攻防平衡技巧。

准备就绪后，驾驶战斗飞船前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 逐个击破 - 当遭遇多个威胁值相当的敌人时，最佳策略是集中火力逐个消灭，逐步减轻敌方火力压制。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

60b8879d-3aee-4dc3-af15-bac7ec406bc9.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #3
60b8879d-3aee-4dc3-af15-bac7ec406bc9.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.

Whenever you’re ready, head to [LOCATION] to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 5 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
60b8879d-3aee-4dc3-af15-bac7ec406bc9.descriptionCn:
恭喜完成八节课程的第二部分。

场景 3 将加入战术决策要素。本次来袭飞船分属不同舰种，战场职能各异。学会判断优先打击目标，是在混战中存活的关键。

准备就绪后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 擒贼先擒王 - 优先评估最具威胁的目标并集中消灭。
- 护盾管理 - 若持续遭受重创，不妨加速脱离战场等待护盾充能。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

d918a720-784c-4eea-891b-54aa1e60be11.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
d918a720-784c-4eea-891b-54aa1e60be11.description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.

Make your way to [LOCATION] whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 10 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
d918a720-784c-4eea-891b-54aa1e60be11.descriptionCn:
恭喜完成八节课程的第三部分。

优秀飞行员都明白：真正的威胁往往藏于暗处。场景 4 将重点训练如何应对隐形目标。课程结束时，你会深刻体会到雷达在识别敌情时的重要性——本次你将同时遭遇常规飞船和隐身飞船的围剿。

准备就绪后前往 [LOCATION] ，切记时刻关注雷达动向。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 反隐侦查 - 主动扫描周围空域可能发现隐藏目标，随时做好遭遇突发敌情的准备。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院

efa77508-3232-4191-b1d7-e1f8886dc330.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
efa77508-3232-4191-b1d7-e1f8886dc330.description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to [LOCATION] to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 12 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire.
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
efa77508-3232-4191-b1d7-e1f8886dc330.descriptionCn:
恭喜完成八节课程的第四部分。

场景 5 重点训练防御战术。学会在何时采取规避动作、释放诱饵弹或干扰弹是生存的关键。本次训练的敌舰将配备导弹武器。

请确保携带足量反导装备，随后前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 快速反应 - 将诱饵弹和干扰弹设置为快捷键，这对应对导弹袭击至关重要
- 稳住阵脚 - 不要试图用加力燃烧逃跑，这反而会增大信号特征让导弹更容易锁定你（反正导弹肯定比你快）。
- 近身战术 - 看似违反直觉，但贴近敌舰反而有利。导弹有最小射程限制，贴身时无法锁定你。


祝你好运，
教练吉利

1673d9f9-6688-4710-b7fc-33b50fb1394a.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
1673d9f9-6688-4710-b7fc-33b50fb1394a.description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.

Find your way to [LOCATION] whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 14 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1673d9f9-6688-4710-b7fc-33b50fb1394a.descriptionCn:
恭喜完成八节课程的第五部分。

场景 6 要动真格了——你将面对大型多船员飞船。这些巨兽带来全新挑战：不仅要应付凶猛火力，其多面护盾系统更要求你持续攻击同一面护盾才能造成有效伤害。在高速机动中保持精准攻击可不容易。

准备就绪后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 尺寸优势 - 对抗大型飞船时，尽量避开正前方，那里通常是主武器集中区域

祝你好运，
教练吉利

1d8e6993-9089-48e9-9ec6-14996f149861.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
1d8e6993-9089-48e9-9ec6-14996f149861.description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to [LOCATION] to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 16 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1d8e6993-9089-48e9-9ec6-14996f149861.descriptionCn:
恭喜完成八节课程的第六部分。

经过前六个场景训练，现在是检验成果的时候了。第七课将让你直面一艘护卫舰级飞船及其护航编队。这场持久战会把你逼到极限，全面考验所学技能。

现在只剩最后一项要领悟：个人能力的极限。说白了，单打独斗总有尽头。发展和维护与其他飞行员的关系，能在关键时刻呼叫支援，才是终极解决方案。当然独狼也能完成任务——但就连海军也从不让王牌飞行员单独出勤。

决定好单干还是呼叫支援后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始战斗。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 优势互补 - 慎重选择援军阵容，确保有人牵制护卫舰时，其他人能解决护航舰队。合理搭配各舰职能才能扬长避短。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

a602d2ee-8776-4037-aeb9-d5dbd5f392d6.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #8
a602d2ee-8776-4037-aeb9-d5dbd5f392d6.description:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to [LOCATION] to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 20 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
a602d2ee-8776-4037-aeb9-d5dbd5f392d6.descriptionCn:
欢迎来到战斗挑战的最终场景。

通过本课程，你已掌握在各种遭遇战中生存所需的进阶战斗与防御技巧。现在是将所学融会贯通的时刻——直面一艘主力舰及其护航编队的终极考验。

老规矩，当你和僚机准备就绪后，前往 [LOCATION] 看看当你被逼到极限时候的表现。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 耐心制胜 - 只要编队配置合理，胜利终将属于你。但要做好持久战准备，击沉巨舰从来不是速战速决的事。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

ca4f3b9d-d1ab-42d7-9790-2a05d7f22640.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Urgent request came in from Associated Science & Development to provide combat support at [LOCATION]. Apparently they have been attacked by outlaws and their security forces have been unable to handle it on their own.

You've been cleared to go on site and aide local security elements in taking out the outlaws, but ASD reserves the right to restrict you from certain areas.

This is a confirmed combat op, so prepare accordingly.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

合约 & 派遣

合约类型：清理地点
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

联合科学与开发公司发来紧急请求，要求在 [LOCATION] 提供战斗支援。显然，他们遭到了不法分子的袭击，其安全部队无法独自应对。

你已被授权前往现场，协助当地安全部队消灭不法分子，但联合科学与开发公司仍保留限制你进入某些区域的权利。

这是已经确认会战斗的行动，所以请做好相应准备。

该合约不可转让。

10834a2c-5280-4b31-a83a-a09d78b3e994.title: Come to Aid of Convoy
10834a2c-5280-4b31-a83a-a09d78b3e994.titleCn:
来支援运输舰队
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 ERT]
10834a2c-5280-4b31-a83a-a09d78b3e994.description:
I’m getting reports that a Citizens for Prosperity convoy carrying vital supplies is currently under attack at [LOCATION]. It’d be a big blow to our operations if we lost that cargo.

If you’ve got the combat skills to go up against highly aggressive hostiles, we’re more than willing to pay for your help.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
10834a2c-5280-4b31-a83a-a09d78b3e994.descriptionCn:
我收到报告说，繁荣公民组织的一支运送关键物资的运输舰队目前正在 [LOCATION] 遭到攻击。如果我们丢了这批货物，对我们的行动会是个沉重打击。

如果你有实力对抗那些超级凶猛的敌人，我们很乐意出钱请你帮忙。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

50b03003-0056-452d-872b-a670d5dfbb4b.title: Complete Stranded Ling Shipment
50b03003-0056-452d-872b-a670d5dfbb4b.titleCn:
完成玲家快递的滞留货运
[玲家快递 - 取回货物 困难 无战斗]
50b03003-0056-452d-872b-a670d5dfbb4b.description:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
50b03003-0056-452d-872b-a670d5dfbb4b.descriptionCn:
你好，

坏消息。我们的运输员途中遇险，被迫遗弃了本应送达的货物。至今杳无音信，我们只能做最坏打算。

我们正在联系他们的家人，也明白现在是特别敏感的时刻，但实在没法放着任务半途而废。我们的追踪器显示，那批货物还在 [LOCATION] 那儿，完好无损。

要是你能把这批货送完，我们真的非常感激。目前没探测到附近有别的飞船，应该挺安全的，你去取就行。记得带把重型牵引光束，再开一艘能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船。

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，剩下的交给我们来处理。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

7cecb648-085a-4fd6-9feb-d0c981f00227.titleCn:
说服新兴势力放弃该区域
[猎头帮 - 轰炸/击杀飞船 MRT]
7cecb648-085a-4fd6-9feb-d0c981f00227.description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named [TARGET] who is operating out of [LOCATION]. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters.

It's time to shut them down.

Head over, take out [TARGET] and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave.

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows
7cecb648-085a-4fd6-9feb-d0c981f00227.descriptionCn:
大家都在谈论一个名叫 [TARGET] 的新人，他在 [LOCATION] 活动。对猎头帮来说，他们已经成为了一个真正的威胁。

是时候让他们停下来。

去那边，干掉 [TARGET]，然后清理掉他们那里的任何燃料储备，这样能说服剩下的人离开。

我想在你完成这件事后，没人会记得他们的名字。

- 斯托斯

a8d4bf0d-3927-4bcb-a91f-f395b462f1c2.title: Convoy Caught in Brutal Attack
a8d4bf0d-3927-4bcb-a91f-f395b462f1c2.titleCn:
船队遭遇残酷袭击
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 HRT]
a8d4bf0d-3927-4bcb-a91f-f395b462f1c2.description:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance.

If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at [LOCATION] to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
a8d4bf0d-3927-4bcb-a91f-f395b462f1c2.descriptionCn:
我们刚收到消息，隶属于繁荣公民的船队遭到了不法分子的袭击，我们的人员急需支援。

如果你有空，我们需要战斗准备好的飞行员前往 [LOCATION] 保护我们的人员。请注意，在这个危急时刻，我们无法承受任何一艘飞船的损失，并希望在你的帮助下，所有人都能安全脱离。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

d5826808-8ea6-4460-ad11-16aeb3bf49b7.title: Convoy Under Attack
d5826808-8ea6-4460-ad11-16aeb3bf49b7.titleCn:
运输舰对遭遇袭击
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 碎刃帮 VHRT]
d5826808-8ea6-4460-ad11-16aeb3bf49b7.description:
We’ve lost contact with a supply convoy and are concerned it might be under attack. Last comm we received from them reported Shattered Blade ships were incoming, but haven’t heard anything since. Are you free to hurry to [LOCATION] and support our forces?

We’ve come to learn that the Shattered Blade are very protective of their hunting grounds. Our last few encounters with them were quite intense, so I’d recommend bringing some heavy firepower.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
d5826808-8ea6-4460-ad11-16aeb3bf49b7.descriptionCn:
我们与一支物资运输队失去了联系，担心他们可能正遭到攻击。我们最后收到的消息说，碎刃帮的飞船正在逼近，但从那以后就再没消息了。你现在有空的话，能赶紧赶到 [LOCATION] 支援我们的部队吗？

我们了解到，碎刃帮对他们狩猎地的保护非常严，最近几次和他们交手都挺激烈的，所以建议你带上足够的重火力。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

38ad4d2d-7444-40b7-8699-38fddde65cc0.title: Cracking the Alliance
38ad4d2d-7444-40b7-8699-38fddde65cc0.titleCn:
重击联盟
[沃恩 - 刺杀 人民联盟 HRT]
38ad4d2d-7444-40b7-8699-38fddde65cc0.description:
[TARGET] of the People’s Alliance, certainly seems to have a reputation about them, based on the importance our client has placed on this being handled in a timely and exacting manner.

But we’ll spare you the details. All you need to do is travel to [LOCATION] and put an end to their life. Expect a well-armed ship and highly competent backup to boot. They seem to take themselves quite seriously.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
38ad4d2d-7444-40b7-8699-38fddde65cc0.descriptionCn:
人民联盟的[TARGET]，看起来确实名声不小，从我们客户对这件事处理时效和精确度的高要求来看就能看出来。

不过我就不细说了。你只需要前往 [LOCATION]，结束他们的生命即可。预计他们会有一艘武装齐全的飞船，还有一群训练有素的援兵。他们似乎还挺把自己当回事儿的。

此致，
沃恩

16b275fb-710e-45b6-8a35-61943afb34c2.title: Crash some ships
16b275fb-710e-45b6-8a35-61943afb34c2.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
16b275fb-710e-45b6-8a35-61943afb34c2.descriptionCn:
多年来，许多想当帮派的人都试图挑战猎头帮，认为他们可以强行进入这个星系。现在我们还在这里，他们都不在了。但似乎这些团体的幸存者决定重新联合起来，再次尝试。看来有些人永远都学不会教训。

最近一群人袭击了我们的物资运输队，法官想要迅速消灭他们，这也不奇怪。我们得知他们位于 [LOCATION] 附近，可能正在重新武装准备再次攻击。

我们希望你去那里，让他们后悔没有和他们的老帮派一起死去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

1080d9fc-d511-4bda-a567-161797dac491.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
1080d9fc-d511-4bda-a567-161797dac491.titleCn:
特别紧急加油请求：[SHIP]
[旅者联合 - 燃料补给 HRT]
1080d9fc-d511-4bda-a567-161797dac491.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] with an empty tank at [LOCATION].  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and  [QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum , and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favour and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.
Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1080d9fc-d511-4bda-a567-161797dac491.descriptionCn:
嗨，

又是新的一天，又有一个信标。在 [LOCATION] 那边有一艘 [SHIP] 油箱见底了。客户飞船将按氢燃料每 SCU [FUELRATE] aUEC 和量子燃料每 SCU [QTFUELRATE] aUEC 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我也不骗你：那地方一旦被困住可不好受，要是被偷袭就更糟糕了。我们在那儿已经损失了不少人 - 哪怕是运气好活下来的，回家时也缺胳膊少腿的。

如果你决定接这活儿，帮我个忙，时刻提高警惕。如果你有个朋友正好有空，不妨叫上他搭把手做点支援。

也许是我多虑了，但这并不意味着他们不会找你麻烦，正如德洛特妈妈常说的那样。
其实她从来没说过这话 - 不过我敢打赌，如果她靠这个谋生，她肯定这么说。

把活儿干完，平安回家，好吗？

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

0fc33a7c-7954-4544-bb8e-1f792ef5838f.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
0fc33a7c-7954-4544-bb8e-1f792ef5838f.titleCn:
关键物资亟待回收
[繁荣公民 - 取回货物 HRT]
0fc33a7c-7954-4544-bb8e-1f792ef5838f.description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at [DESTINATION] when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION]. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0fc33a7c-7954-4544-bb8e-1f792ef5838f.descriptionCn:
我们正赶着把一批紧急物资运送到 [DESTINATION] 那的人们手中，结果飞行员途中遭遇一伙不法分子。他们试图逃跑，但为时已晚。

不过好消息是，追踪器显示货物目前仍完好无损，位置在 [LOCATION]。极有可能那些不法分子正守着货物，等找来足够大的飞船再转移全部物资。虽然我不愿再冒失去一名飞行员的风险，但这批物资的紧迫性实在太高，足以让我们决定派人前去回收。

这任务可不轻松。这群不法分子对我们的飞行员毫不留情。你得先干掉他们，才能取回货物。请务必驾驶一艘能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并配备一把 重型牵引光束 用于搬运。最后将货物送至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。让我们把这事办妥。

一路平安，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

61af9886-2117-45f8-9fd2-77e16fb12bcf.title: Cull Invasive Creatures
61af9886-2117-45f8-9fd2-77e16fb12bcf.titleCn:
剔除入侵生物
[高境荒野 - 击杀动物 MRT 多物种]
61af9886-2117-45f8-9fd2-77e16fb12bcf.description:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near [LOCATION]. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
61af9886-2117-45f8-9fd2-77e16fb12bcf.descriptionCn:
高境荒野专家致力于保持帝国脆弱生态系统的平衡。最近，一位客户雇佣我们评估 [LOCATION] 附近多种入侵生物对环境的影响。我们已确定，为了保护该地区的自然秩序，有必要对这些物种进行有意识的猎杀。

我们正在寻找能够并愿意参与这一努力的人。有关目标生物的更多信息，请在你的日志中参考《斯坦顿野生动物指南》。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

9d31564a-6d9e-45cf-a512-4f58266be4d3.title: Cull Irradiated Kopions
9d31564a-6d9e-45cf-a512-4f58266be4d3.titleCn:
捕杀受辐射的寇骈犬
[高境荒野 - 击杀动物 HRT]
9d31564a-6d9e-45cf-a512-4f58266be4d3.description:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in [LOCATION].

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around [LOCATION]. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment.

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
9d31564a-6d9e-45cf-a512-4f58266be4d3.descriptionCn:
由于派罗 I 上频繁的辐射风暴，一些入侵的寇骈犬已经受到辐射污染。这对当地野生动物的健康以及生活和工作在 [LOCATION] 的人们构成了威胁。

我们正在寻找一位熟练的承包商，能够在 [LOCATION] 及其周边地区捕杀任何受辐射污染的寇骈犬。除非你拥有能在放射性环境中可靠运作的武器和装备，否则请勿接受此合约。
你的报酬将根据与本合约相关的风险进行调整。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

9c4459ac-2527-4024-b8f1-a08081df252a.title: Curious Weapon
9c4459ac-2527-4024-b8f1-a08081df252a.titleCn:
稀奇武器
[兑换 - 爆破筒 “氏卫” 发射器]
9c4459ac-2527-4024-b8f1-a08081df252a.description:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.
9c4459ac-2527-4024-b8f1-a08081df252a.descriptionCn:
维科洛在你星系里闲逛的时候。发现了一把非常奇怪。但好用的武器。这玩意儿简单。但超级管用。如果你给我带点东西，我就给你看我怎么做的

非常有趣。

d679836e-feed-41f4-b0e0-73f3174fa29c.title: Cut Citizens For Prosperity Power
d679836e-feed-41f4-b0e0-73f3174fa29c.description:
We got big plans about to go down but unfortunately Citizens for Prosperity have people nearby at  [LOCATION].

Since I can't afford to have those bastards cockin' things up for us, I want you to go there and take out their power generators.

Should keep them sidelined until we're done with our business.

-Stows out
d679836e-feed-41f4-b0e0-73f3174fa29c.descriptionCn:
我们有大计划要实施，但不幸的是繁荣公民在 [LOCATION] 附近有他们的人。

因为我不能让那些家伙给我们捣乱，所以我想让你去那里摧毁他们的发电机。

这样可以在我们完成业务之前让他们无法行动。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

caa4bf8a-ab96-4897-9e4c-92edd1628252.title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
caa4bf8a-ab96-4897-9e4c-92edd1628252.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [LOCATION]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
caa4bf8a-ab96-4897-9e4c-92edd1628252.descriptionCn:
这是一个常规警告。我们得知猎头帮正在向星系运输大量的武器，意图对繁荣公民所拥有的定居点发起袭击。

虽然我们相信，变革只能通过非暴力的方式实现，然而，这些武器的存在毫无疑问会导致更多的留学和破坏，因此我们希望它们能从这个局面里移除。

任何拥有适当作战训练的支持者都被要求在 [LOCATION] 附近承担这个危险的任务。我们将为您所承担的巨大风险提供补偿。

谢谢，祝您在外面安全。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

5ad05edc-bdc0-4498-8802-3c3587a9063a.title: Dangerous Ambush
5ad05edc-bdc0-4498-8802-3c3587a9063a.titleCn:
危险的伏击
[埃克哈特 - 伏击 VHRT]
5ad05edc-bdc0-4498-8802-3c3587a9063a.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a [TARGET], who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.

Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an emission cloud near [LOCATION] which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
5ad05edc-bdc0-4498-8802-3c3587a9063a.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：飞船伏击
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们的一位知名客户最近遭遇了重大损失，因为一名飞行员背叛了他们并带着他们的货物逃走了。经过数周的追踪，我们发现这名飞行员与一伙不法分子有联系，所以客户希望我们能够出手，以震慑未来可能出现的类似问题。最终目标是那名驾驶 [TARGET] 的飞行员，他是整个团伙的头目。这事可不简单——他们出行从不单独行动，总有护航战斗机和次主力舰随行。所以我们强烈建议你找一两个信得过的朋友一起出手。

我们的分析员收集的情报显示，他们经常经过 [LOCATION] 附近的一片辐射云，那里是发动突袭的绝佳地点。

合约完成后立即付款。主承包商还能获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的额外奖励。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

288f190b-045a-486f-b800-b88fe1a81ee9.title: Data Transfer
288f190b-045a-486f-b800-b88fe1a81ee9.titleCn:
数据转移
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 入门]
288f190b-045a-486f-b800-b88fe1a81ee9.description:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION] that we want.

All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros
288f190b-045a-486f-b800-b88fe1a81ee9.descriptionCn:
我们是谁、干啥的不重要，你只要知道：我们找人办事，给钱，就完事儿。要是顺顺利利，咱压根不用见面，这不挺好吗？

先给你个简单的活儿热热身。有一架坠毁飞船的黑匣子，就在 [LOCATION]，我们想要。你只要把它送到 [DESTINATION]，钱立马到账，简单吧？小心垃圾佬，这种废船边上，啥怪人都能冒出来。

- 零比特

b9144071-cf16-4012-a33f-a39d42cdc260.title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
b9144071-cf16-4012-a33f-a39d42cdc260.titleCn:
死亡圣徒 - [RANK] 级别 - [CARGO_GRADE] 货物运输
[死亡圣徒 - 一对多货运]
b9144071-cf16-4012-a33f-a39d42cdc260.description:
We're looking for someone discreet to move a new batch of altruciatoxin to a number of buyers . Yeah, it's illegal, but only if you get caught.

The shipment is at [LOCATION]. You'll need to take it to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

Be sure your ship can carry size 8 SCU containers, and don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam. Not sure how you're planning on moving the boxes, otherwise.

-Twitch
b9144071-cf16-4012-a33f-a39d42cdc260.descriptionCn:
我们想找个人低调地把一批新到的梸树毒运给几个买家。没错，这玩意儿是违禁品，但只要不被抓谁管你？

货在 [LOCATION]，你得把它送到这些交货点：

卸货地点（任意顺序）

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

确保你飞船能装下最大尺寸 [MAX_SCU] 的集装箱，别忘了带个手持式牵引光束——不然你打算怎么搬这些箱子？

- 刺痛

0366d1ca-40fc-41af-a6bf-a335fe4b51e4.title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
0366d1ca-40fc-41af-a6bf-a335fe4b51e4.titleCn:
死亡圣徒 - [RANK] 级别 - [CARGO_GRADE] 货物运输
[死亡圣徒 - 多对一货运]
0366d1ca-40fc-41af-a6bf-a335fe4b51e4.description:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

And bring it all to [DESTINATION] before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size 2 SCU containers, and a handheld tractor beam should make loading and unloading nice and easy.

-Twitch
0366d1ca-40fc-41af-a6bf-a335fe4b51e4.descriptionCn:
我们一个最牛的经销商在斯坦顿栽了，得找个替补。那家伙卖货是一把好手，可走私纯纯外行，动不动就撞上安保巡逻队或者一帮海盗。我们现在需要个靠谱的，去这几个地方把货取回来：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

然后把所有货都运到 [DESTINATION]，趁安保还没反应过来赶紧搞定。你飞船得有足够空间装下[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱，再配个手持式牵引光束，装货卸货就轻松多了。

- 刺痛

86f8b30f-5caa-42c4-a8c6-7c0722836641.title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
86f8b30f-5caa-42c4-a8c6-7c0722836641.titleCn:
死亡圣徒 - [RANK] 级别 - [CARGO_GRADE] 货物运输
[死亡圣徒 - 一对多货运]
86f8b30f-5caa-42c4-a8c6-7c0722836641.description:
If you've got a fast ship, can discreetly carry size 8 SCU containers, and love getting a huge payout, we need you to head to [LOCATION] immediately and take what you find there to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

The buyers are paying a premium to get their hands on fresh stormwal meat. Stay sharp. If security catches you with this, it's your ass on the line. If you're smart, you'll use a handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded up quick.

-Twitch
86f8b30f-5caa-42c4-a8c6-7c0722836641.descriptionCn:
如果你船够快、能低调地装下尺寸为 [MAX_SCU] 的集装箱，还喜欢拿大笔赏金，那你赶紧去 [LOCATION] 把货弄到手，然后送到这些地方：

卸货地点（任意顺序）

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

买家愿意出高价就为弄到新鲜的风暴鲸肉，可得悠着点。安保要是抓到你，你可就完蛋了。聪明点就带个手持式牵引光束，赶紧把货全装上。

- 刺痛

cff84619-a0bb-484c-951b-d916c75fe30b.title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
cff84619-a0bb-484c-951b-d916c75fe30b.titleCn:
死亡圣徒 - [RANK] 级别 - [CARGO_GRADE] 货物运输
[死亡圣徒 - 一对多货运]
cff84619-a0bb-484c-951b-d916c75fe30b.description:
We've got a shipment of contraband that needs to be hauled to a couple of different places. If you like creds, head to [LOCATION], load everything up, and bring it to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

You're gonna need a handheld tractor beam to move the boxes and enough room in your cargo hold for size 2 SCU containers.

Avoid other ships if you can. Security will bust you if they figure out what you're hauling, and raiders will just take it for themselves.

-Twitch
cff84619-a0bb-484c-951b-d916c75fe30b.descriptionCn:
咱们有一批违禁品要分头运到几个地方。要是你想赚信用点，就去 [LOCATION] 把货全装上，然后送到这些地方：

卸货地点（任意顺序）

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

你得有把手持式牵引光束来搬箱子，还有飞船货舱得能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱。

能躲别的船就躲远点，安保要是发现你运的是啥，立马给你逮了。要是碰上劫匪那他们直接抢了就跑。

- 刺痛

a8630359-8adb-4579-8a53-745e129ee18a.title: DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul
a8630359-8adb-4579-8a53-745e129ee18a.titleCn:
死亡圣徒 - 运货试用
[死亡圣徒 - 货运 入门]
a8630359-8adb-4579-8a53-745e129ee18a.description:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints.

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling.

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one.

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for 16 SCU cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] without getting security involved.

If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line.

-Twitch
a8630359-8adb-4579-8a53-745e129ee18a.descriptionCn:
叫我刺痛。死亡圣徒由我管着。

你八成听过我们名号，没听过也无所谓——我们啥都干，但最拿手的就是运些得偷偷摸摸处理的货。

我是从我的一个线人那儿打听到你的，他说你驾驶的运输船有东西挺符合咱们的胃口。

我的方案是这样的——我们出信用点，找人运一票特殊货。你船舱得能塞下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱，还得配个手持式牵引光束，好装货卸货。你唯一要做的，就是从 [LOCATION] 把东西运到 [DESTINATION]，别惊动安保。

事儿办漂亮了，以后死亡圣徒的活儿，少不了你。
- 刺痛

死亡圣徒 - [RANK] 级别 - [CARGO_GRADE] 货物运输
[死亡圣徒 - 一对一货运]

59277842-f768-4842-8549-f299ccf99885.descriptionCn:

- 刺痛

4cb22c75-5b48-494d-a44f-29c4fd6dc5b7.title: DEAD SAINTS -- Rookie Rank, Small Scale Cargo Run
4cb22c75-5b48-494d-a44f-29c4fd6dc5b7.titleCn:
死亡圣徒 - [RANK] 级别 - [CARGO_GRADE] 货物运输
[死亡圣徒 - 一对一货运]
4cb22c75-5b48-494d-a44f-29c4fd6dc5b7.description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride.

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [TOTAL] cryopods at [LOCATION] that need to go to [DESTINATION]. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size 2 SCU containers. If you use a handheld tractor beam, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on.

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill.

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch
4cb22c75-5b48-494d-a44f-29c4fd6dc5b7.descriptionCn:
有个挺有意思的事儿，一些被赫斯顿动力公司骗去签了劳工合约的人，想离罗威尔越远越好，他们跟个客运公司谈妥了，把自己给冷冻起来了，现在就等有人去接他们，捎他们一程。

如果你打算干点“冰棍”走私的活儿，那就在 [LOCATION] 找到 [TOTAL] 个冷冻舱，把它们运到 [DESTINATION]。记得你的货舱有空间能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱。要是你有手持式牵引光束，那大概能趁赫斯顿安保还没反应过来的时候就能把所有人都装上船。

赫斯顿那帮人可不乐意有人跑路，所以小心点，他们可是见人就开枪。

这事要是成了，报酬少不了你的。

- 刺痛

fc928502-87e0-46a4-8398-8944f4be08d5.title: Death and cargo
fc928502-87e0-46a4-8398-8944f4be08d5.description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
fc928502-87e0-46a4-8398-8944f4be08d5.descriptionCn:
当地的小队决定袭击我们的舰队，偷走我们的东西。他们逃掉了，但我们可不会让他们庆祝太久。我想让你去 [LOCATION] 的基地，把他们炸得灰飞烟灭，并把我们的东西拿回来。

一旦你拿到货物，就把它送到 [DESTINATION]，然后我们就可以让这些混蛋彻底消失。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

67d02bb9-d556-49d6-82f5-218b8c572b95.title: Deep space hit
67d02bb9-d556-49d6-82f5-218b8c572b95.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGET] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TARGET] around [LOCATION]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
67d02bb9-d556-49d6-82f5-218b8c572b95.descriptionCn:
收到消息，有一队人正在进行犯罪活动，并建立自己的名声。由于他们表示不想和猎头帮扯上任何关系，我们打算在他们成为问题之前将他们拆散。他们的头目是个叫 [TARGET] 的小子，我们想，他被子弹送去见了阎王之后，其他人应该也会崩溃。

据说你可以在 [LOCATION] 附近找到 [TARGET]。赶紧过去处理掉他。

对你这样的专业人士来说，这应该不成问题。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

44f3deee-d85d-4b80-a715-755fe2cf022a.title: Defend [LOCATION] From Mercs
44f3deee-d85d-4b80-a715-755fe2cf022a.titleCn:
从佣兵手里保卫 [LOCATION]
[猎头帮 - 保护实体并护航 VHRT]
44f3deee-d85d-4b80-a715-755fe2cf022a.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the [OBJECTS] and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 6 Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.
44f3deee-d85d-4b80-a715-755fe2cf022a.descriptionCn:
所以，我本以为咱们把事儿办得挺低调的，结果看来 [LOCATION] 跟猎头帮有关系这事儿还是走漏了风声。现在那帮狠角色在那边惹出大麻烦，盯着 [OBJECTS] 搞破坏，搞得我头都大了。

就凭这些不速之客手里的火力，你得带一帮自己的团队才能搞定。特别是还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我给主承包商开出 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的奖励，干漂亮了就归你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

54c44da2-b1b3-4067-a3b9-cfd73fad73c9.title: Defend [LOCATION] from Outlaws
54c44da2-b1b3-4067-a3b9-cfd73fad73c9.description:
We learned that [LOCATION] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws.

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
54c44da2-b1b3-4067-a3b9-cfd73fad73c9.descriptionCn:
我们得知 [LOCATION] 正面临着不法分子攻击的威胁，并已请求援助。我们需要有人保护他们并驱逐这些不法分子。

确保在他们初次攻击后你能紧随其后。大部分情况，不法分子只需派遣足够多的武力就能赢得战斗，所以在离开该区域前请确保你能击退所有的增援部队。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

9cee381f-5638-48df-bffd-0be4600fa531.title: Defend Fuel Tanks From Mercs
9cee381f-5638-48df-bffd-0be4600fa531.titleCn:
从佣兵手里保卫 [OBJECTS]
[猎头帮 - 保护可摧毁实体 VHRT]
9cee381f-5638-48df-bffd-0be4600fa531.description:
A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at [LOCATION]. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the [OBJECTS] there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix.

Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 7 Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.
9cee381f-5638-48df-bffd-0be4600fa531.descriptionCn:
一群枪手被派来搅黄我们在 [LOCATION] 的生意。看来有人通风报信，说要是那里的 [OBJECTS] 被毁了，猎头帮在那片区域的行动就会大受阻碍。这正是个我得让你去解决的麻烦。

不跟你兜圈子了，这些佣兵可不是吃素的。单枪匹马去简直就是送死。所以你不仅要物资备齐，还得找几个信得过的朋友跟你并肩作战。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以只要干得漂亮，主承包商就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

af4ffb08-954a-4f75-9493-e3cd102af48d.title: Defend InterSec Operative
af4ffb08-954a-4f75-9493-e3cd102af48d.titleCn:
保卫互安特工
[互安防务 - 保卫飞船 LRT]
af4ffb08-954a-4f75-9493-e3cd102af48d.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: Require urgent assistance for an InterSec operative who is currently under fire at [LOCATION].

A group of outlaws had previously taken our operative captive with the intention of extracting sensitive information from them, but miraculously they were able to escape. Unfortunately, the pursuing outlaws now have them pinned down.

Due to the number of the ships assaulting them, we're offering additional compensation to accommodate the added danger. Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is highly advised.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
af4ffb08-954a-4f75-9493-e3cd102af48d.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：需要紧急援助一名位于 [LOCATION] 遭受攻击的互安防务特工。

一群不法分子之前抓住了我们的特工，想从他们那儿套出机密信息，但他们奇迹般地逃了出来。不幸的是，那些穷追不舍的不法分子现在把人困住了。

由于攻击他们的飞船数量众多，我们会提供额外补偿来应对额外的风险。非常建议你招募更多飞船来支持你完成这次任务。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

1c5e4a84-749c-4747-9f37-e1ad310da801.title: Defenders needed against Headhunters
1c5e4a84-749c-4747-9f37-e1ad310da801.titleCn: 需要抵抗者以对抗猎头帮
1c5e4a84-749c-4747-9f37-e1ad310da801.description:
We received an emergency comm from [LOCATION] reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
1c5e4a84-749c-4747-9f37-e1ad310da801.descriptionCn:
我们收到来自 [LOCATION] 的紧急通讯，报告称他们正受到一个猎头帮的攻击。我们知道我们在这个星系的存在激怒了猎头帮，但这并不能成为他们毫无理由发起攻击的借口。

如果可能的话，请整理好你的装备，赶往现场。请理解，猎头帮是经验丰富的战士，绝不会轻易退缩。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

b9bbdb7d-d5fd-4f2d-97c2-e3a526c40c3d.title: Deliver a Message
b9bbdb7d-d5fd-4f2d-97c2-e3a526c40c3d.description:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to [LOCATION].

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us.

Stows out.
b9bbdb7d-d5fd-4f2d-97c2-e3a526c40c3d.descriptionCn:
惊喜，惊喜。看来并不是所有人都对猎头帮在斯坦顿的进展感到高兴。特别是有一伙人一直在袭击我们的人，然后逃回 [LOCATION]。

我希望你去那里，让他们也尝尝自己的苦头。清理轨道平台应该能传达一个明确的信息，那就是惹我们会有什么后果。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

86002e11-fa28-4256-bd98-75e644c7dd9a.title: Delivery of Abandoned Ling Cargo
86002e11-fa28-4256-bd98-75e644c7dd9a.titleCn:
运送玲家快递被抛弃的货物
[玲家快递 - 取回货物 非常困难 无战斗]
86002e11-fa28-4256-bd98-75e644c7dd9a.description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
86002e11-fa28-4256-bd98-75e644c7dd9a.descriptionCn:
嘿，

需要找个靠谱的承包商帮我们解个围。

我们一个运输员半道撂挑子了，客户那批货现在卡在半路上。估计是想跟我们重新谈判个更高价，但这可不是玲家快递的作风。反正人已经跑路了，我们急着把这单收尾。

佩特拉和我跟这客户合作好多年了，关系一直挺稳，真不想因为一个不靠谱的运输员全砸了。你能去 [LOCATION] 把货取走吗？记得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 那边的货运电梯就行，我们马上结账。真挺感谢你搭把手的，客户肯定也一样！

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

275c47a7-9af7-4f68-bc1c-310c5f8e375c.title: Destroy Dangerous Drugs
275c47a7-9af7-4f68-bc1c-310c5f8e375c.description:
Reports of a spike in drug overdoses around Stanton has security services worried. Seems like some two-bit crew is juicing their profits by cutting their stuff with toxic chemicals. Shutting down this crew and stopping the distribution of their drugs has become a top priority.

A Foxwell informant has revealed that part of this crew has currently set up shop at [LOCATION]. Hiring a contractor to hustle over there and destroy whatever drugs they’ve got stashed before they’re spread across the system. Better be careful though, word is this crew is armed to the teeth and determined to profit off that poison no matter what.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
275c47a7-9af7-4f68-bc1c-310c5f8e375c.descriptionCn:
关于斯坦顿地区吸毒过量事件报告的激增让安全服务部门感到担忧。看起来某个小团伙通过用有毒化学品掺杂他们的货物来提高利润。取缔这个团伙并阻止他们的毒品分销已成为当务之急。

一名福克斯韦尔的线人透露，这个团伙的一部分目前在 [LOCATION] 设立了据点。雇佣一名承包商前往那里，摧毁他们藏匿的任何毒品，以免这些毒品在星系中传播。不过要小心，听说这个团伙武装到牙齿，决心不惜一切代价从这种毒药中获利。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

0697c275-c36e-4592-a78b-687bdff4597e.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
0697c275-c36e-4592-a78b-687bdff4597e.titleCn: 摧毁猎头帮盗取的数据
0697c275-c36e-4592-a78b-687bdff4597e.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0697c275-c36e-4592-a78b-687bdff4597e.descriptionCn:
猎头帮最近袭击了我们的一艘运输船，遗憾的是被他们成功获取了一些安保数据。虽然这些数据的加密很强，但他们能否访问这些数据只是时间问题。

在那之前，我们需要你前往 [LOCATION] 并摧毁他们服务器上所有信息的痕迹。

你能做到这一点的话，繁荣公民将非常感激你的帮助。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

d7696f35-b781-4c0b-8e9d-b95de9f3d43b.title: Destroy Illegal Drugs
d7696f35-b781-4c0b-8e9d-b95de9f3d43b.description:
We’ve been contracted to take care of a problem at [LOCATION]. There’s been a recent surge of activity in the area tied to the drug trade. It appears to be a well-run operation and there’s a growing concern that it’ll expand wider if not stopped. Any chance you’re available to make sure that doesn’t happen?

Job is pretty straightforward. Head to the site and destroy their stash of drugs. That way they won’t have the creds to expand their operations any further. I wouldn’t expect them to make this easy on you though. Armed guards are regularly seen around the facility, so be sure you’ve got enough gear to deal with them too.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
d7696f35-b781-4c0b-8e9d-b95de9f3d43b.descriptionCn:
我们被委托处理位于 [LOCATION] 的一个问题。该地区与毒品交易相关的活动最近激增。该组织似乎运作良好，如果不加以制止，我们越来越担心它会进一步扩展。你有机会确保这种情况不会发生吗？

工作相当简单。前往这个站点，摧毁他们藏匿的毒品。这样他们就没有足够的资金进一步扩张他们的业务。不过，我不指望他们会让你轻松完成这项任务。设施周围经常可以看到武装安保，所以一定要确保你有足够的装备来应对他们。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

dadc6e2f-2fdf-4eb7-8d92-9395ae811503.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
dadc6e2f-2fdf-4eb7-8d92-9395ae811503.titleCn: 摧毁不法分子的数据服务器
dadc6e2f-2fdf-4eb7-8d92-9395ae811503.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
dadc6e2f-2fdf-4eb7-8d92-9395ae811503.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民一直在监视一个非常危险的不法分子团伙，他们位于 [LOCATION]，我们相信他们正计划一次可能会使整个星系陷入动荡的大规模攻击。

为了保护我们在这里所取得的所有进展，我们希望你能突袭他们的基地，摧毁所有存放他们计划的服务器。

这至少可以为我们争取到一些缓解的时间，让他们重新考虑他们的进攻。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

012adaaf-7a50-49e6-90f2-5bbc62604ee8.title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
012adaaf-7a50-49e6-90f2-5bbc62604ee8.titleCn: 摧毁异种威胁数据服务器
012adaaf-7a50-49e6-90f2-5bbc62604ee8.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at [LOCATION] our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation.

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
012adaaf-7a50-49e6-90f2-5bbc62604ee8.descriptionCn:
一位担任异种威胁线人的繁荣公民成员告诉我们，位于 [LOCATION] 的数据服务器存储着对该帮派运营至关重要的信息。

如果你能代表我们摧毁这些服务器，那将是整个星系安全的一次重大胜利。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

957dae0b-e0ba-4860-b50a-672d57a00c01.title: Destroy XenoThreat Fuel Reserves
957dae0b-e0ba-4860-b50a-672d57a00c01.titleCn:
炸掉异种威胁的燃料储备
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 异种威胁 VHRT]
957dae0b-e0ba-4860-b50a-672d57a00c01.description:
I won't get into the long and complicated politics of why I'm asking you to do this, but it's enough for you to know that I want it done.

Go to [LOCATION] and blow up the XenoThreat fuel reserves there. It'll really be helping me out of a tight spot.

-Stows
957dae0b-e0ba-4860-b50a-672d57a00c01.descriptionCn:
我不想深入复杂的政治原因，只要你知道我想让这件事完成就行。

去 [LOCATION] 炸掉那里的异种威胁燃料储备。这对我来说真的会帮大忙。

- 斯托斯

0739da60-2d98-4e53-9932-3adfd8453840.title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
0739da60-2d98-4e53-9932-3adfd8453840.titleCn: 摧毁异种威胁的物流数据
0739da60-2d98-4e53-9932-3adfd8453840.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system.

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0739da60-2d98-4e53-9932-3adfd8453840.descriptionCn:
我们遇到了一点问题，希望你能帮我解决。我们的一个线人透露，异种威胁正在收集关于繁荣公民在整个星系的行动数据。

如果这些信息被他们利用，就可能会给我们的人带来严重风险。最好的解决办法是请你彻底摧毁存储这些数据的服务器，地址在 [LOCATION]。

一旦他们的信息库被清除，我们的人就有了反击的机会。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

71d8062d-7725-4f88-8ec3-f8710316c691.title: Destroying the Alliance
71d8062d-7725-4f88-8ec3-f8710316c691.titleCn:
摧毁联盟
[沃恩 - 刺杀 人民联盟 VHRT]
71d8062d-7725-4f88-8ec3-f8710316c691.description:
We hope you enjoy a challenge, because this one is looking to be far from a walk in the park.

For reasons our client was unwilling to disclose, a rather prominent member of the People’s Alliance needs disposing of. The target, [TARGET], was last seen at [LOCATION] piloting a high-class ship accompanied by several skilled allies.

Do make the most of this opportunity.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
71d8062d-7725-4f88-8ec3-f8710316c691.descriptionCn:
我们希望你能享受挑战，因为这次可不像轻松散步那么简单。

由于我们客户不愿意透露原因，人民联盟一个重要人物需要被处理掉。目标 [TARGET] 最后出现在 [LOCATION]，当时正驾驶着一艘高级飞船，还带着几名技术娴熟的盟友。

好好把握这次机会。

此致，
沃恩

5d0d0508-0a59-474f-b231-96a5d5f84266.title: Disable Headhunter Comm Towers
5d0d0508-0a59-474f-b231-96a5d5f84266.titleCn:
瘫痪猎头帮的通讯塔
[繁荣公民 - 关闭通讯塔]
5d0d0508-0a59-474f-b231-96a5d5f84266.description:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to [LOCATION] and disable the communication towers. There should be a control panel located at the top of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
5d0d0508-0a59-474f-b231-96a5d5f84266.descriptionCn:
暴力从来不是我们的首选，但有时必须将其作为预防措施。

我们正计划对一个猎头帮控制的前哨站发动攻击，需要你的帮助。

我们必须确保一旦出了什么问题，就要让他们无法呼叫支援或让局势恶化。这就是你需要出手的地方。你要前往 [LOCATION] 并关闭那些通讯塔。每座塔的 顶部都有一个控制面板，你可以用它来让通讯塔瘫痪。

如果你能完成这件事，繁荣公民就能在派罗取得一些关键的进展。

另外也请记住，今后接取合约的时候，你可以选择直接摧毁通讯塔，避免和增援的运输船正面交火。

保持警惕，注意安全。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

8b18d982-1e25-41a5-b159-e7e4ea5c9620.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
8b18d982-1e25-41a5-b159-e7e4ea5c9620.titleCn: 关闭位于 [LOCATION] 的不法分子据点
8b18d982-1e25-41a5-b159-e7e4ea5c9620.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
8b18d982-1e25-41a5-b159-e7e4ea5c9620.descriptionCn:
在针对繁荣公民相关定居点的一系列袭击之后，我们相信已经追踪到负责人位于 [LOCATION]。

直接攻击他们将带来很大的风险，并很可能引发激烈的报复。因此，我们认为如果能让他们的发电机停掉，可能会迫使他们迁到别处。

你觉得你能为我们处理这件事吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e4154f5.titleCn:
做熔岩套装
[兑换 - 岩层护甲 热浪]
9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e4154f5.description: If you have armor, Wikelo can make it look warm. Good look for useful armor. Bring me things and will do.
9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e4154f5.descriptionCn: 你要是有护甲，维科洛能让它看着暖和。实用护甲配上这外观，挺好。把东西带来，我就做。

73f88f71-74e2-454a-9722-dd4b32bb8cf5.title: Down For the Count
73f88f71-74e2-454a-9722-dd4b32bb8cf5.titleCn:
被击倒
[沃恩 - 寻找尸体 HRT]
73f88f71-74e2-454a-9722-dd4b32bb8cf5.description:
[TARGET] was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.

With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit [LOCATION] and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
73f88f71-74e2-454a-9722-dd4b32bb8cf5.descriptionCn:
[TARGET] 这个名字曾经让我们头疼了好一阵子。不管他是逃避大师还是运气好到没话说，我们所有尝试都到目前为止失败了。

话虽如此，看来似乎有人抢先我们一步了。我们希望你去 [LOCATION] 确认一下目标是否真的被干掉了。不过得提醒你一下，我怀疑他之前的船员可能还在这附近，大概是因为错把忠诚当回事儿。我建议你自己带个队伍去，不过具体怎么安排就看你专业了。

此致，
沃恩

6e95c206-a089-40e2-acc5-79881c2c2c3c.title: Driving CFP out
6e95c206-a089-40e2-acc5-79881c2c2c3c.description:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGET] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION] and take out [TARGET]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.
6e95c206-a089-40e2-acc5-79881c2c2c3c.descriptionCn:
我们一直试图与这些繁荣公民好好相处，但他们已经非常清楚地表示，在他们的“安全星系”里我们没有立足之地。他们雇佣佣兵提供安保，结果导致了各种不合理的暴力事件。比如那个混蛋 [TARGET] 对一群定居者开火，以将他们驱离一个他们盯上的前哨站，所以现在是时候不再客气了。

我需要一些干劲十足的人去攻击 [LOCATION]，干掉 [TARGET]。直到你证明你是个威胁之前他们都可能会隐藏起来，所以务必要搞出来一点破坏。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

06bc3bc0-07f5-4f2d-b102-a3d906654da7.title: Drop a XenoThreat
06bc3bc0-07f5-4f2d-b102-a3d906654da7.description:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but [TARGET] is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around [LOCATION]. Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.
06bc3bc0-07f5-4f2d-b102-a3d906654da7.descriptionCn:
我们找到了一名让人头疼的异种威胁。不知道你是否听说过这个名字，但 [TARGET] 在异种威胁中也是个混蛋。残忍、虐待狂，而且还特别讨厌。我们想找人解决掉他。你准备好了吗？

最后的消息是他在 [LOCATION] 附近。去那儿把他解决掉。很简单。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

547c7c86-b5c9-47d1-b5e8-48225fee2523.title: Easy Creds for Easy Work
547c7c86-b5c9-47d1-b5e8-48225fee2523.titleCn:
轻轻松松赚小钱
[死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 入门]
547c7c86-b5c9-47d1-b5e8-48225fee2523.description:
Here’s the deal. Dead Saints need some new blood to help shift gear across the ’verse and if you can prove yourself useful, you could make some nice creds doing it.

Got an easy one to start you out. Couple of hours ago, something went down over at [LOCATION] and a pilot of mine got ghosted. My tracker’s telling me that they didn’t find the stash of gear in there.

If you can get out there, get the package back and take it to [DESTINATION] without dying, I might have some more work for you. Can’t see you running into too much trouble as any ships you spot will likely be scavs looking for a quick cred. I’m sure you can take care of that.

-Twitch
547c7c86-b5c9-47d1-b5e8-48225fee2523.descriptionCn:
情况是这样的。死亡圣徒需要一些新成员来帮助他们将物资运输到其他星系，如果你能证明自己有用，完成这个任务后可以获得不错的报酬。

给你一个简单的任务作为开始。几个小时前，[LOCATION] 那边出了点状况，我的一名飞行员失踪了。我的追踪器显示他们没有找到那里的物资。

如果你能赶到那里，把包裹取回来并安全送到 [DESTINATION]，我可能会给你更多的任务。你应该不会遇到太大麻烦，因为你看到的任何飞船很可能都是那些想赚快钱的不法分子。我相信你能应付得来。

-刺痛

31902480-ece9-4d7d-a4b9-63dacf742c4f.title: Easy Pickings
31902480-ece9-4d7d-a4b9-63dacf742c4f.titleCn:
轻轻松松赚大钱
[零比特 - 飞船抢劫 LRT]
31902480-ece9-4d7d-a4b9-63dacf742c4f.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c
31902480-ece9-4d7d-a4b9-63dacf742c4f.descriptionCn:
听着，我们在筛查一些通讯时，捕捉到了一些关于一笔丰厚交易的激动消息。找出他们藏匿着的一艘装满物资的飞船的地方很简单，我们想，嘿，为什么要把这种有利可图的消息藏起来呢？

给我们打点信用点作为信息费，我们就会把飞船所在的小行星基地的坐标发给你。飞船被锁在一个机库里，所以你需要通过站内的电梯到达那里。但一旦你进去之后，你就可以在控制台上覆盖锁定。做到这一点后，就可以轻松获取到他了。

57 65 65 76 69 6c

3f3e5f1b-2fce-41f6-a56a-27b03214cf89.title: Eliminate Annoyance
3f3e5f1b-2fce-41f6-a56a-27b03214cf89.titleCn:
清除麻烦
[猎头帮 - 地点保卫 VLRT]
3f3e5f1b-2fce-41f6-a56a-27b03214cf89.description:
Headhunters flying in and out of [LOCATION] are being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. Need them dealt with before they become a real pain in the ass.

Get there and I’ll update you on what these pests are doing so you can hunt ‘em down.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows
3f3e5f1b-2fce-41f6-a56a-27b03214cf89.descriptionCn:
猎头帮的飞船在 [LOCATION] 进进出出时，被一些嚣张的新面孔骚扰了。得赶紧收拾他们，免得他们真变成个大麻烦。

你赶到那里后，我会告诉你这些家伙具体在搞什么名堂，然后你就可以去收拾他们了。

把他们清理干净，我会额外给接下这活儿的人 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

bc92e499-e5ae-4a91-8c14-66b8a96ba0a0.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
bc92e499-e5ae-4a91-8c14-66b8a96ba0a0.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
bc92e499-e5ae-4a91-8c14-66b8a96ba0a0.descriptionCn:
我们在 [LOCATION] 遇到的不法分子问题日益严重，我们不能再袖手旁观，任凭他们的侵略伤害我们的社区。

我们对发起全面攻击持谨慎态度，但我们相信如果能够摧毁他们的燃料储备，可以有效遏制进一步的敌对行动。

如果可以的话，我希望你能亲自处理燃料的摧毁。能发射导弹的飞船可能是最合适的选择，但我交给你来决定。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

7d0130fe-adf0-455f-a719-0b7f4cdc9334.title: Eliminate Vanduul Ship
7d0130fe-adf0-455f-a719-0b7f4cdc9334.titleCn:
消灭剜度飞船
[互安防务 - 击杀飞船 ERT]
7d0130fe-adf0-455f-a719-0b7f4cdc9334.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: InterSec requires the services of a skilled pilot who’s prepared to assist in taking down a dangerous Vanduul target that has been involved in numerous attacks.

Vanduul incursions have been on the rise recently, posing not only a threat to the system of Nyx, but the UEE as a whole. It is imperative that these sightings are responded to in a swift and efficient manner.

We require you to fly to the last known sighting of the Vanduul ship at [LOCATION] and eliminate them immediately.

Vanduul pilots are highly skilled and extremely dangerous. Engage the enemy immediately and do not hesitate – they will not show the same mercy.

Compensation proportionate to the risk of the contract will be awarded.

Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
7d0130fe-adf0-455f-a719-0b7f4cdc9334.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安需要一名技术娴熟的飞行员，该飞行员必须准备好协助击落一个危险的剜度目标，这个目标已经参与了许多次攻击。

最近剜度的入侵事件有所增加，这不仅对尼克斯星系构成了威胁，也对整个 UEE 构成了威胁。必须迅速而有效地应对这些情况。

我们需要你飞往 [LOCATION]，即剜度飞船最后一次出现的地点，并立即将其消灭。

Vanduul飞行员技术高超且极其危险。立即与敌人交战，不要犹豫——他们不会手下留情。

根据合约风险，将给予相应的报酬。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

b9a59cf4-f35e-4884-9296-b4d96ba923f5.title: Eliminate XenoThreat Enforcer
b9a59cf4-f35e-4884-9296-b4d96ba923f5.titleCn:
铲除异种威胁执法者
[福克斯韦尔 - 异种 引出首领]
b9a59cf4-f35e-4884-9296-b4d96ba923f5.description:
We have intercepted a location beacon that puts [TARGET] and their personal attack wing at [LOCATION]. They have been one of XenoThreat's most brutal enforcers since their founding.

[TARGET]'s not one to back down from a fight so hit their ships hard enough, do enough damage and they won't be able to resist joining in the action. Once they're out in the open, they'll be your main target.

Ready to go?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
b9a59cf4-f35e-4884-9296-b4d96ba923f5.descriptionCn:
我们已截获一个信标，显示 [TARGET] 及其个人攻击编队位于 [LOCATION]。自成立之初，他们便是异种威胁中最残暴的执法者之一。

[TARGET] 从不畏惧战斗，因此必须对其飞船发动猛烈打击，造成足够损伤，迫使他们不得不参战。一旦他们现身，就是你的主要目标。

准备好了吗？

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

9b0b7809-bcb7-4e60-97ae-71d4e07cbac9.title: Elite Op
9b0b7809-bcb7-4e60-97ae-71d4e07cbac9.titleCn:
精英行动
[猎头帮 - 伏击 ERT]
9b0b7809-bcb7-4e60-97ae-71d4e07cbac9.description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to [LOCATION] there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the [TARGET] and its escorts to pass by.

With a bonus of 16 Council Scrip for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows
9b0b7809-bcb7-4e60-97ae-71d4e07cbac9.descriptionCn:
猎头帮在找能带队干票大的狠角色。有艘军用护卫舰带着小弟在星系里盯咱们金主，准没憋好屁。趁他们盯着肥肉时，咱找人组队抄他们后路。

埋伏点都选好了——去 [LOCATION] 那片辐射云后面猫着。带上兄弟关掉引擎，等 [TARGET] 和护航队经过就动手。

主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 ，光这点就够赚了，而且残骸里的破烂也归你。

- 斯托斯

尼克斯星系需要入门级快递员
[超光速快递 - 投递 尼克斯 简单]
f83522ea-bbb5-4d71-ae52-23cde60b2bcf.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
FTL requires an entry-level courier to complete deliveries in Nyx.
Courier must provide own transportation.
Prior training in manual lifting is preferred, with the ability to move boxes of up to .25 SCU in weight.
By accepting this contract you agree to take full responsibility for the safety of the assigned packages.

Good luck and good speed, courier!
f83522ea-bbb5-4d71-ae52-23cde60b2bcf.descriptionCn:

04eabfdd-ab02-43d9-864d-1d5163e870e5.title: Eradicate All Traces of Headhunter Data
04eabfdd-ab02-43d9-864d-1d5163e870e5.titleCn: 消灭猎头帮数据的所有痕迹
04eabfdd-ab02-43d9-864d-1d5163e870e5.description:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of [TARGET] recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause.

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at [LOCATION] as well as tracking down [TARGET] to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
04eabfdd-ab02-43d9-864d-1d5163e870e5.descriptionCn:
我们现在还在拼凑完整的情况，但到目前为止，我们了解到一名名为 [TARGET] 的猎头帮成员最近窃取了一些敏感数据，如果曝光，将对繁荣公民的事业造成严重损害。

我们需要确保所有被盗数据的痕迹都被消除。这意味着要摧毁位于 [LOCATION] 的所有猎头帮服务器，并追踪 [TARGET]，以阻止他们进一步传播这些信息。

非常感谢你的帮助，利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

1c9a3435-06c4-4612-a510-08361ffb2c61.title: Eradicate UEE Threat: [TARGET]
1c9a3435-06c4-4612-a510-08361ffb2c61.titleCn:
根除 UEE 的威胁：[TARGET]
[互安防务 - 击杀飞船 ERT 多波次]
1c9a3435-06c4-4612-a510-08361ffb2c61.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: [LOCATION]
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Capital Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by [TARGET] has been planning a potentially devastating strike against sensitive UEE targets. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.

After putting together a fighting force of your own, head to the site and engage with the hostiles there. Their leader will not risk entering into the fray themselve unless they feel their operation is suitably at risk. Stay at the site and take out hostile targets, until you can engage with the groups leader directly and put a stop to this heinous attack once and for all.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
1c9a3435-06c4-4612-a510-08361ffb2c61.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：[LOCATION]
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：主力舰级飞船
任务简报：一支由 [TARGET] 率领的不法分子舰队正密谋对重要 UEE 目标发动一场可能毁灭性的打击。互安防务已受命在袭击发起前彻底消除该威胁。

请自行组建作战力量，前往指定地点与敌方交战。其首领通常不会亲自参战，除非判断行动严重受挫。请坚守现场，持续清除敌方目标，直至直接对峙并击毙该首领，彻底终结此次暴行。

此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守相关星系的法律。

7c730e3f-ee4d-4433-95cd-d0f70d8271b0.title: Escapee Bounty Assignment: [TARGET]
7c730e3f-ee4d-4433-95cd-d0f70d8271b0.titleCn:
逃犯赏金任务：[TARGET]
[玩家赏金]
7c730e3f-ee4d-4433-95cd-d0f70d8271b0.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
7c730e3f-ee4d-4433-95cd-d0f70d8271b0.descriptionCn:
嗨，

希望你不介意，但我知道你在赏金猎人工会的情况，并想看下你有没有兴趣和我们北境之岩服务团队签订合约，我们是星系内评价最高的私人安保公司之一。

如果你有的话，首先需要你去完成一份临时嫌犯逮捕合约。与其说是评断，其实更像是次机会，来确保我们能有良好的共事关系。

你要找的嫌犯名叫 [TARGET]。他们可是出了名的难以捉摸，所以对你来说会有些困难。

希望尽快收到你的消息，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

8c7b651d-c125-4d7c-bfb6-82b61171f692.title: Establishing Security
8c7b651d-c125-4d7c-bfb6-82b61171f692.description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we are looking for anyone with combat experience to help secure [LOCATION] that has been taken over by a group of outlaws.

We've tried to work with them but have only been met with violence and threats.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
8c7b651d-c125-4d7c-bfb6-82b61171f692.descriptionCn:
欢迎来到这个星系，不确定你对我们组织是否熟悉，繁荣公民是一个非营利组织，致力于为无主的星系带来安全和文明。

如果你在这个星系中寻找工作，并希望帮助我们实现目标，那么我们正在寻找任何有战斗经验的人来帮助保护 [LOCATION]，该前哨站已被一群亡命之徒占据。

我们曾试图与他们合作，但只遭遇了暴力和威胁。

完成后，我们可以为你提供在这个星系及其他地方的多种新工作机会。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

7c93c444-7bdf-42af-b4f5-ab8e8c926326.title: Exciting New Opportunities with Foxwell Enforcement
7c93c444-7bdf-42af-b4f5-ab8e8c926326.titleCn: 与福克斯韦尔安保合作，激动人心的新机会
7c93c444-7bdf-42af-b4f5-ab8e8c926326.description:
Are you an experienced contractor looking to increase your income with some security work? Or maybe you’re new to the field and are looking for some hands-on experience?

Foxwell Enforcement are looking for enthusiastic new contractors to help with local law enforcement. To see if you’re the right fit for us, we’d like for you to head over to [LOCATION] and support the security forces on site. Local gang members have been giving that spot problems. Help the local forces take care of these outlaws to qualify for more contract opportunities with Foxwell.

Contractors are employed on a strictly freelance basis. Foxwell expects contractors to supply their own weapons and armor and does not accept any responsibility for any injuries, damages, or deaths accumulated during the contract.

Good luck,

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
7c93c444-7bdf-42af-b4f5-ab8e8c926326.descriptionCn:
你是一位经验丰富的承包商吗？希望通过一些安保工作增加收入吗？或者你刚入行，正在寻找一些实践经验？

福克斯韦尔安保正在寻找热情的新承包商来协助当地的执法。为了看看你是否适合我们，我们希望你能前往 [LOCATION]，支援现场的安保部队。当地帮派成员一直在给那个地方制造麻烦。帮助当地部队处理这些不法分子，以获得更多与福克斯韦尔合作的机会。

承包商以严格的自由职业者身份受雇。福克斯韦尔期望承包商自备武器和护甲，并不对合约期间发生的任何伤害、损坏或死亡承担任何责任。

祝你好运，

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

e124df75-8367-4e3f-9c6e-94fe5049ef68.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
e124df75-8367-4e3f-9c6e-94fe5049ef68.descriptionCn:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。
