3add98c7-bf51-4a5a-a67d-bf0ee98d2da8.title: Extensive Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
3add98c7-bf51-4a5a-a67d-bf0ee98d2da8.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at [LOCATION] suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
3add98c7-bf51-4a5a-a67d-bf0ee98d2da8.descriptionCn:
我们需要协助。位于 [LOCATION] 的繁荣公民设施在近期雷暴中严重受损，现寻求能协助维修的人员。

现场勘查显示，需携带 六个保险丝、一个 打捞工具，以及 足够处理约八根管道的 RMC 罐。这些物资应足以修复损伤并使前哨站恢复运作。

2fca4562-bab2-484c-92e5-60ac7d21dced.title: Extra Small Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
2fca4562-bab2-484c-92e5-60ac7d21dced.titleCn:
超小批量科瓦莱什货物需要追回
[科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 非常简单 无战斗]
2fca4562-bab2-484c-92e5-60ac7d21dced.description:
Hi,

So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at [LOCATION]. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] you'd be doing me a huge favor.

Don't forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
2fca4562-bab2-484c-92e5-60ac7d21dced.descriptionCn:
嗨，

我这边有个承包商，本来该给我们送货的，结果彻底失联了。我试着呼叫他飞船，一点回音都没有，只知道他那船现在正飘在 [LOCATION] 那片儿。要是你能过去把货带回来，再送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，真就帮大忙了！

别忘了带把重型牵引光束，不然搬不动；另外船得能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱才行。

[SIGN_OFF]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

Hey,

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

活儿不算大，但你还是得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能塞下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿就行，我们立马把报酬打给你。

aa24ea9f-add6-419a-a9fb-3421a857ed0c.description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

我们的一名飞行员本应该把一批货带回，但看起来他在 [LOCATION] 那儿出了点麻烦。要么他的脑袋被炸得满驾驶舱都是，要么吓得把船扔掉了。为了他着想，希望只是第一种情况，这样我就不用去追杀那个混蛋了。现在最重要的是，我们的货还在那儿。

如果你有重型牵引光束和一艘不错的飞船，能过去把我们的货弄回来吗？袭击我飞行员的那些混蛋很可能还在那儿，而且他们肯定不好对付。

要是你能活着回来，把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就给你报酬。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.
0433aacb-9318-43ad-8b7d-ed0cb79f66bd.descriptionCn:
我们的一名飞行员本应该把一批货带回，但看起来他在 [LOCATION] 那儿出了点麻烦。要么他的脑袋被炸得满驾驶舱都是，要么吓得把船扔掉了。为了他着想，希望只是第一种情况，这样我就不用去追杀那个混蛋了。现在最重要的是，我们的货还在那儿。

如果你有重型牵引光束和一艘不错的飞船，能过去把我们的货弄回来吗？袭击我飞行员的那些混蛋很可能还在那儿，而且他们肯定不好对付。

要是你能活着回来，把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就给你报酬。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

3108e570-fed8-4725-bc71-2f1dedb21125.title: Finishing The Job
3108e570-fed8-4725-bc71-2f1dedb21125.titleCn:
了结工作
[死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 VLRT]
3108e570-fed8-4725-bc71-2f1dedb21125.description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with a heavy-duty tractor beam to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch
3108e570-fed8-4725-bc71-2f1dedb21125.descriptionCn:
我一个运输船在 [LOCATION] 出事了，船被迫弃了，得有人带重型牵引光束过去把货捞回来，这事得赶紧了结。

那船上带着我一批不错的装备，我可不想让哪个“圣母”捡了去，然后顺藤摸瓜找到咱头上。

要是碰上人，别跟他们套近乎，直接干掉那混蛋，拿上货走人，明白？

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，卖了钱我分你一份。

- 刺痛

d73fcf8f-017d-441c-85ff-6ac2c93b1745.title: Finishing The Job
d73fcf8f-017d-441c-85ff-6ac2c93b1745.titleCn:
了结工作
[死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 VLRT]
d73fcf8f-017d-441c-85ff-6ac2c93b1745.description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at [LOCATION].

Grab a crew you can trust and your heavy-duty tractor beam and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in [DESTINATION]. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch
d73fcf8f-017d-441c-85ff-6ac2c93b1745.descriptionCn:
咱们有点情况，一帮名不见经传的小混混，想靠劫咱们的运输船出名，以为抢几艘货船就能当老大，真当自己是个人物了。一群菜鸡。

问题是，他们上次运气好，咱的飞行员差点没命逃出来，但他们的船还停在 [LOCATION]，装满着物资。

挑几个信得过的兄弟，带上你的重型牵引光束，然后赶紧给我滚过去。

搞到货之后，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，这事办成了，我分你一大笔。

- 刺痛

1ef81be1-714c-4fea-9185-e7a4c2604256.title: Firebird Mod
1ef81be1-714c-4fea-9185-e7a4c2604256.titleCn:
火鸟改款
[兑换 - 军刀 火鸟 维科洛战争版]
1ef81be1-714c-4fea-9185-e7a4c2604256.description: Been digging into Aegis Sabre ship. Firebird is very bomb-y. Good build but could make some fun change to it. If you want, I can do. Have a look and tell me. Bye.
1ef81be1-714c-4fea-9185-e7a4c2604256.descriptionCn: 一直在研究圣盾军刀飞船。火鸟很劲爆。良好的建造，但可以做一些有趣的改变。如果你愿意，我可以。看一看，然后告诉我。再见。

a2b7bc80-6147-42ec-8675-119204de8878.title: First Haul in System
a2b7bc80-6147-42ec-8675-119204de8878.description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
a2b7bc80-6147-42ec-8675-119204de8878.descriptionCn:
欢迎来到这个星系，不确定你对我们组织是否熟悉。繁荣公民是一个非营利组织，致力于为无主的星系带来安全和文明。

如果你正在星系中寻找工作，并希望帮助实现我们的目标，那么我们需要你从 [LOCATION] 取走一个包裹，并送到 [DESTINATION]。

完成后，我们可以为你提供在这个星系及其他地方的多种新工作机会。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

7c5bdaa6-ad6a-44b3-a374-796b13ddd5e4.title: Fortune ship for you
7c5bdaa6-ad6a-44b3-a374-796b13ddd5e4.titleCn:
给你财运飞船
[兑换 - 财运 维科洛版]
7c5bdaa6-ad6a-44b3-a374-796b13ddd5e4.description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.
7c5bdaa6-ad6a-44b3-a374-796b13ddd5e4.descriptionCn: 你好，在练习让飞船飞得更好。希安帮助人类造船。飞好。打捞好。但如果你愿意，维科洛可以做得更好。带着东西，我会做的。再见。

6cd001d5-d202-423d-b53e-5588485e3a2c.title: Fracturing the Alliance
6cd001d5-d202-423d-b53e-5588485e3a2c.titleCn:
粉碎联盟
[沃恩 - 刺杀 人民联盟 MRT]
6cd001d5-d202-423d-b53e-5588485e3a2c.description:
It seems the People’s Alliance have been ruffling some feathers recently. A client of ours would be most thrilled if you can prevent [TARGET] from meddling in their affairs ever again.

You’ll find them around [LOCATION], and from what our client has told us, it’s unlikely that they’re alone. These aren’t your run-of-the-mill pilots, they might even pose a slight threat to your safety.

Do try your best to keep it as clean as possible.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
6cd001d5-d202-423d-b53e-5588485e3a2c.descriptionCn:
看来人民联盟最近惹了一些麻烦。我们有个客户特别希望你能阻止 [TARGET] 别再插手他们的事。

你可以在 [LOCATION] 附近找到他们。据我们客户说，他们很可能不是孤身一人。这些家伙可不是普通飞行员，说不定还会对你安全构成一点威胁。

尽量把事情办得干净点。

此致，
沃恩

31f004c2-9b77-4a0f-a500-89f89b606a96.title: Fun Kopion Skull Gun
31f004c2-9b77-4a0f-a500-89f89b606a96.titleCn:
趣味寇骈犬头骨枪
[兑换 - 视差 “趣味寇骈犬头骨” 能量突击步枪]
31f004c2-9b77-4a0f-a500-89f89b606a96.description:
Hello. Can make fun change to gun if you want. Use kopion skin for pattern and little skull dangle. Very effective. Shoot much better.

All you need is bring me parts to [DESTINATIONS] and will make.

Bye.
31f004c2-9b77-4a0f-a500-89f89b606a96.descriptionCn:
你好。如果你想要的话，可以给枪做个有趣的改装。用寇骈犬皮肤的图案，再加个小骷髅吊坠。非常有效。射击效果会好很多。

你只需要把零件带到 [DESTINATIONS]，我就会帮你做。

再见。

4341c2d8-85b4-4623-8271-eff4480ec674.title: Fun Military Skull Gun
4341c2d8-85b4-4623-8271-eff4480ec674.titleCn:
趣味军用头骨枪
[兑换 - 视差 “趣味军用头骨” 能量突击步枪]
4341c2d8-85b4-4623-8271-eff4480ec674.description:
Hello. Can do version of gun if you kopion soldier. Make material like soldier camouflage but with dead skull on front. Gun shoot better too.

If want, bring part to [DESTINATIONS] and will make.
4341c2d8-85b4-4623-8271-eff4480ec674.descriptionCn:
你好。如果用寇骈犬士兵风格打造枪支版本，可采用士兵迷彩材质，并在枪身前部加入死亡头骨元素。枪的射击效果也会更好。

如果想要的话，把零件带到 [DESTINATIONS]，我就会帮你做。

847eeb55-7817-4fac-818f-635441ddc74f.title: Gather Irradiated Valakkar Fangs
847eeb55-7817-4fac-818f-635441ddc74f.titleCn: 收集受辐射的瓦拉卡獠牙
847eeb55-7817-4fac-818f-635441ddc74f.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but to continue their efforts our scientists need materials that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar fangs, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have uncovered the existence of a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION].

Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is offering premium pay to anyone who can assist with collecting the fangs.

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
847eeb55-7817-4fac-818f-635441ddc74f.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正全力以赴阻止重生技术危机的进一步恶化，但我们的科学家需要一些公司供应商无法获取的材料，以继续他们的研究工作。

拉亚利正在寻找有经验的承包商来收集 受辐射的瓦拉卡獠牙，这些獠牙可以从长期暴露在辐射下的成年瓦拉卡身上提取。我们的扫描发现，在靠近 [LOCATION] 的风暴中有一批符合条件的种群。

由于这些动物极其危险，拉亚利为任何能够协助收集獠牙的人提供高额报酬。

一旦收集完成，请将这些珍贵资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

d17af173-e1d7-4935-9026-53119c9e5d35.title: Get My Gear Back
d17af173-e1d7-4935-9026-53119c9e5d35.titleCn:
把我的东西拿回来
[死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 MRT]
d17af173-e1d7-4935-9026-53119c9e5d35.description:
A couple of hours ago I was supposed to receive a shipment of gear from a pilot of mine. I don’t like late, so I need you to head to their location and recover my stuff. I’ve got trackers on the packages so they should be easy enough to find.

My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to [DESTINATION] for me and I’ll wire you the creds.

-Twitch
d17af173-e1d7-4935-9026-53119c9e5d35.descriptionCn:
几个小时前，我本应该收到一名飞行员运送的物资。我不喜欢迟到，所以你需要前往他们的那里把我的东西取回来。我已经给包裹安装了追踪器，应该很容易找到。

我的直觉告诉我飞行员可能遭遇了不测。他们很擅长驾驶飞船，所以袭击他们的那些不法分子应该也挺厉害的。等你把我的三个包裹取回来，把它们送到 [DESTINATION]，我会把报酬转给你。

-刺痛

f5c12cd3-77e1-4712-8149-0e8ef505bbb4.title: Get My Gear Back
f5c12cd3-77e1-4712-8149-0e8ef505bbb4.titleCn:
把我的东西拿回来

6992076b-a400-4444-a0f5-5752eb459dd5.title: Getting Our Gear Back
6992076b-a400-4444-a0f5-5752eb459dd5.titleCn:
把咱们的装备拿回来
[死亡圣徒 - 物品取回]
6992076b-a400-4444-a0f5-5752eb459dd5.description:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at [LOCATION] ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at [DESTINATION] for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch
6992076b-a400-4444-a0f5-5752eb459dd5.descriptionCn:
要想把事儿办漂亮，就得亲力亲为。这话他们常挂在嘴边，对吧？可惜我没那闲工夫，毕竟生意还得照做。

有些货被人弄丢了，我得找个承包商帮我收拾烂摊子。听说 [LOCATION] 那儿的人把我一个手下给干掉了，顺手牵走了咱们的装备。我要你去把那东西抢回来，搞定现场的所有人，然后把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的交货点给我。这事儿办妥了，钱我立马给你结清。

- 刺痛

38437a9a-f57f-4771-8f4f-d5b6612b5cb5.title: Getting Our Goods Back
38437a9a-f57f-4771-8f4f-d5b6612b5cb5.description:
We’ve been using the old Hathor [LOCATION1] and [LOCATION2] as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] where we should be able to keep it on ice.

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store 32 SCU at the very least.

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.
38437a9a-f57f-4771-8f4f-d5b6612b5cb5.descriptionCn:
我们一直在使用旧的哈索尔 [LOCATION1] 和 [LOCATION2] 作为藏货点，但结果发现一些过于热心的没脑子家伙找到了它们，还试图把我们的东西偷走。

幸运的是，货物现在还在那儿——暂时的。我们需要有人去那个平台校准设施和轨道激光平台，从货运电梯上拿走我们的东西，然后把它送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯上，我们应该能把它保管好。

这是需要拿的货物清单。顺序随你，无所谓。确保你带一艘至少能存放 [MAX_SCU] 集装箱的飞船。

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

确保你准备好应对任何碰到的混蛋。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

00bd1ecc-c6df-4a7c-accf-3483eb0ee469.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
00bd1ecc-c6df-4a7c-accf-3483eb0ee469.titleCn:
弄清真相
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 LRT]
00bd1ecc-c6df-4a7c-accf-3483eb0ee469.description:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION] and take it to [DESTINATION]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros
00bd1ecc-c6df-4a7c-accf-3483eb0ee469.descriptionCn:
今天早些时候我们本该收到一个挺重要的包裹，结果飞行员直接跑路了，还把追踪芯片给撬了，挺机灵是吧？其实没那么聪明，因为他们忘了把飞行记录仪一块儿带走。

去 [LOCATION] 的残骸里把黑匣子捞出来，然后送到 [DESTINATION]，你干完活儿我们立马把酬金发你。

对了，小心点垃圾佬，现在这年头大家都快饿疯了，哪怕只是艘报废的快递船，也有人敢下手。

- 零比特

01c7e2d6-e1bf-4109-aad2-bf89d1c063d0.title: Getting What They Deserve
01c7e2d6-e1bf-4109-aad2-bf89d1c063d0.titleCn:
让他们得到报应
[死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 VHRT]
01c7e2d6-e1bf-4109-aad2-bf89d1c063d0.description:
I got a situation I need dealing with pronto. A rival crew has intercepted a major shipment of gear I was expecting and all hell is breaking loose. The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to [LOCATION] and get my five packages.

Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?

When you’re done, take the gear to [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.

-Twitch
01c7e2d6-e1bf-4109-aad2-bf89d1c063d0.descriptionCn:
我有个紧急情况需要处理。一个竞争对手的团队截获了我正在等待的一批重要物资，现在一片混乱。飞行员失踪了，飞船也毁了，他们很快就会拿走我的东西然后离开。如果你愿意对付这些混蛋，就前往 [LOCATION] 取回我的五个包裹。

不过要提醒你，那个失踪的飞行员是我最得力的成员之一，所以这个对手团队肯定装备精良。带上你最厉害的伙伴们，别给他们任何机会。明白了吗？

完成后，把装备送到 [DESTINATION]，我会确保你得到丰厚的报酬。

-刺痛

a953a8b4-4cb7-4f11-94ce-c41a5408bdcf.title: Getting what we deserve
a953a8b4-4cb7-4f11-94ce-c41a5408bdcf.titleCn:
拿我们应得的
[猎头帮 - 取回货物 VHRT]
a953a8b4-4cb7-4f11-94ce-c41a5408bdcf.description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at [LOCATION] and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.
a953a8b4-4cb7-4f11-94ce-c41a5408bdcf.descriptionCn:
事情是这样的，我在 [LOCATION] 遇到了一些麻烦，需要一个头脑清醒的人来帮我解决。我以前的一个飞行员试图和另一个帮派达成交易，但结果可想而知，他失败了。现在我的货物就那样闲置着，还被一群蠢货守着，等着他们的运输船来取走。

你需要带着重型牵引光束和一支可靠的团队去把我的货物夺回来，否则它们就永远没了。

把所有东西送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里，我会从收益中给你一大笔分成。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

3965842d-8aa3-4725-b53b-54cfcfc04047.title: Ghost [TARGET]
3965842d-8aa3-4725-b53b-54cfcfc04047.description:
Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves.

Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is [TARGET], who we’ve tracked to [LOCATION]. Feel like ghosting ‘em?

These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.

- Stows
3965842d-8aa3-4725-b53b-54cfcfc04047.descriptionCn:
真不敢相信这个该死的星系里有这么多罪犯。看来我们得为自己腾出一些空间。

这里有一份高层领导的名单。没有什么比一次完美的斩首行动更能给现有帮派带来混乱和无序了。下一个目标是 [TARGET]，我们已经追踪到他们在 [LOCATION]。想要悄无声息地解决他们吗？

这些老旧的哈索尔平台设施又大又分散。估计还是有办法做到这一点而不引起他们小弟的注意。虽然不容易，但听起来确实很有趣。

-斯托斯

c296798f-b311-4c0a-9dff-f25c8fa2d337.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
c296798f-b311-4c0a-9dff-f25c8fa2d337.titleCn: 悄悄干掉一些异种垃圾
c296798f-b311-4c0a-9dff-f25c8fa2d337.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TARGET] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TARGET] was spotted flying around [LOCATION], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.
c296798f-b311-4c0a-9dff-f25c8fa2d337.descriptionCn:
需要你迅速行动，出现了一位叫 [TARGET] 的异种威胁中尉，判官认为这是对异种威胁指挥部进行打击的大好机会。我听说 [TARGET] 最近在 [LOCATION] 附近飞行，所以赶快去那里，别让他们再次消失了。

我建议带些支援过去，估计他们不会轻易投降。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

a45b3499-7f96-49a3-a909-717279e8bfa0.title: Go on the warpath
a45b3499-7f96-49a3-a909-717279e8bfa0.description:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near [LOCATION]. Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.
a45b3499-7f96-49a3-a909-717279e8bfa0.descriptionCn:
寻找一些打手，去对付那些在星系里对猎头帮搞事情的地方无赖。我们曾试图联系他们给他们讲讲道理，结果他们还把我们的使者给打了，所以现在我们选择方案 B。

你会发现他们在 [LOCATION] 里藏身。去那里，用他们的血给墙壁上上色。

玩得开心。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

5712cdfc-84da-456f-97ed-697c9d04c026.title: Golem Rocks
5712cdfc-84da-456f-97ed-697c9d04c026.titleCn:
魔像石头
[兑换 - 魔像 维科洛工作版]
5712cdfc-84da-456f-97ed-697c9d04c026.description:
Universe need resources so Wikelo always respect people who dig. Good profession. If you starting and want boost to Golem ship. I can do.

Bring.

I make.
5712cdfc-84da-456f-97ed-697c9d04c026.descriptionCn:
宇宙需要资源所以维科洛总是尊重那些挖掘的人。好职业。如果你刚开始并且想要增强到魔像。我可以做。

带来。

我制造。

6114dd52-ede0-41e1-afaa-e33c5d7c7181.title: Goods for the Getting
6114dd52-ede0-41e1-afaa-e33c5d7c7181.titleCn:
可取货物
[零比特 - 飞船抢劫 MRT]
6114dd52-ede0-41e1-afaa-e33c5d7c7181.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them?

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you.

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c
6114dd52-ede0-41e1-afaa-e33c5d7c7181.descriptionCn:
你可能会想，如果有人在策划一次大抢劫，他们不会把所有细节留在任何人都能黑进来的光谱上吧？

但嘿，他们的损失就是你的收获。目前，一艘重型货船被锁在一个小行星基地的机库里。进入的唯一方法是通过站内的电梯。进去之后，你就可以使用控制台覆盖锁定，把所有东西拿出来。我们很乐意把坐标卖给你，但剩下的就靠你了。

看来他们的损失能让我们也赚不少。

57 65 65 76 69 6c

c0d7f644-ad7c-4a00-9bcb-56130d8aeb1c.title: Grab ‘n’ go
c0d7f644-ad7c-4a00-9bcb-56130d8aeb1c.titleCn:
拿上就走
[猎头帮 - 取回货物 VLRT]
c0d7f644-ad7c-4a00-9bcb-56130d8aeb1c.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to [LOCATION]. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a heavy-duty tractor beam on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.
c0d7f644-ad7c-4a00-9bcb-56130d8aeb1c.descriptionCn:
刚收到消息，有一艘被遗弃的飞船，上面堆满了可以轻易拿走的物资。如果你感兴趣，就去 [LOCATION]。消息可能已经传开了，所以可能会有不法分子在那里晃悠，但直接避开他们，把货物拿过来就行。

把货物送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里，我会给你报酬。

记得带上重型牵引光束，因为我不知道那些货物到底什么大小。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

1e9c4001-6d7f-4259-b4ad-bb70d197f520.title: Grab ‘n’ go

拿上就走
[猎头帮 - 取回货物 VLRT]
1e9c4001-6d7f-4259-b4ad-bb70d197f520.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to [LOCATION]. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a heavy-duty tractor beam on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.
1e9c4001-6d7f-4259-b4ad-bb70d197f520.descriptionCn:
刚收到消息，有一艘被遗弃的飞船，上面堆满了可以轻易拿走的物资。如果你感兴趣，就去 [LOCATION]。消息可能已经传开了，所以可能会有不法分子在那里晃悠，但直接避开他们，把货物拿过来就行。

把货物送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里，我会给你报酬。

记得带上重型牵引光束，因为我不知道那些货物到底什么大小。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

7cc2b1b0-3fce-49c2-bb55-876f96a99950.description:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to [LOCATION] and take it back.

Stows out.
7cc2b1b0-3fce-49c2-bb55-876f96a99950.descriptionCn:
很遗憾地说，我们失去了一个前哨站，还是被异种威胁给占领的。要我说这真是令人震惊，所以我们在寻找有时间和弹药的人来夺回它。

如果就是你，就赶紧去 [LOCATION] 把它拿回来。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

4bd43a77-1ac6-4fa4-8f51-a92ef1f4f607.title: Green light on [TARGET]
4bd43a77-1ac6-4fa4-8f51-a92ef1f4f607.description:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TARGET] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at [LOCATION] who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TARGET] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TARGET], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows
4bd43a77-1ac6-4fa4-8f51-a92ef1f4f607.descriptionCn:
我的老板们传来消息，我们要清算旧账。我有一个关于这个老牌杀手 [TARGET] 的线索，他的杀人名单可不小。我们得知他和一些对我们不太友好的人藏在 [LOCATION] 那里，所以他们可能不会对你太友好。[TARGET] 是我们的目标，但你可能得和他们一群人打起来。

再说一次，每次我们试图处理 [TARGET] 时，他们都会杀掉杀他们的杀手。我觉得你会表现得更好，但如果有后援的话，最好带上。

祝你好运。

- 斯托斯

fc6b3de9-5178-4682-85da-1d872c552bbc.title: Ground The Upstarts
fc6b3de9-5178-4682-85da-1d872c552bbc.titleCn:
碾压愣头青
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 VLRT]
fc6b3de9-5178-4682-85da-1d872c552bbc.description:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to [LOCATION] and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out
fc6b3de9-5178-4682-85da-1d872c552bbc.descriptionCn:
猎头帮可不是靠装好人混到今天的。我们盯上了一群不知天高地厚的愣头青，他们正试图入侵我们的地盘。得让他们长长记性。

去 [LOCATION] 把他们的燃料罐给炸个稀烂。等他们的飞船全趴窝的时候，再想插手咱们的生意就得好好掂量掂量了。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

a43e965f-7feb-4380-b74e-00d88a726b17.title: Guard [LOCATION] From Rivals
a43e965f-7feb-4380-b74e-00d88a726b17.titleCn:
从死对头手里守住 [LOCATION]
[猎头帮 - 保护实体并护航 ERT]
a43e965f-7feb-4380-b74e-00d88a726b17.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of [LOCATION] is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting [OBJECTS] there.

Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 6 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
a43e965f-7feb-4380-b74e-00d88a726b17.descriptionCn:
[LOCATION] 的维护和可靠运行对猎头帮来说可是相当重要，但这伙死对头却铁了心要把它踢出局。他们现在就在现场，正冲着那里的 [OBJECTS] 下手。

保护这个据点以及周边的友方飞船至关重要，所以我让你去干掉这些脑残家伙时，务必带上一些可靠的支援。

为了证明我们对此事绝不姑息，只要主承包商能确保万无一失，就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

993af7d7-48b6-4312-92ff-d813d4eb3cb5.title: Guard Fuel Tanks At All Costs
993af7d7-48b6-4312-92ff-d813d4eb3cb5.titleCn:
不计代价守卫 [OBJECTS]
[猎头帮 - 保护可摧毁实体 ERT]
993af7d7-48b6-4312-92ff-d813d4eb3cb5.description:
Our partners at [LOCATION] need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the [OBJECTS] there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order.

With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
993af7d7-48b6-4312-92ff-d813d4eb3cb5.descriptionCn:
我们在 [LOCATION] 的合作伙伴需要帮忙。一伙敌对的不法分子正蜂拥而至，袭击那里的 [OBJECTS]。这本身就够糟糕了，但这处地点对我们未来的区域计划至关重要，必须得让它保持正常运转。

这次攻击规模不小，这些飞行员也身手不凡，毫无疑问，找些靠谱的帮手会对你大有帮助。召集你的人马，飞到现场，在那些马屁精造成永久性破坏之前把他们拦下来。

为了证明我们对此事绝不马虎，只要确保万无一失，主承包商就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

684c9209-3dec-4519-a86c-7f49df47d14c.title: Guardian Fight Mod
684c9209-3dec-4519-a86c-7f49df47d14c.titleCn:
守护者战斗改款
[兑换 - 守护者 维科洛战争版]
684c9209-3dec-4519-a86c-7f49df47d14c.description: This ship look like insect in the Protectorate. Fun look. Painful sting. Wikelo can make custom version for you if you want. Make enemies sting. Bye.
684c9209-3dec-4519-a86c-7f49df47d14c.descriptionCn: 这个船像那些保护国里的小虫子。看着很好玩。蜇人很疼。你想要的话，维科洛给你做一个厉害的版本，让敌人也被蜇。再见。

1af113f6-5650-4da9-abf3-9676dcaf8a91.title: Guardian take down ship
1af113f6-5650-4da9-abf3-9676dcaf8a91.titleCn:
守护者击落飞船
[兑换 - 守护者 QI 维科洛版]
1af113f6-5650-4da9-abf3-9676dcaf8a91.description: Insect ship again. This one help take down other ship but if you want it to take down better. Can make. See list and tell Wikelo. Bye.
1af113f6-5650-4da9-abf3-9676dcaf8a91.descriptionCn: 又是一个像虫的船。别的船它能帮忙打烂。你想让它更厉害一点的话，可以制作。看看那个单子，然后告诉维科洛。再见。

ad595a7c-d314-442b-acce-ea140a56cffd.title: Guardian WiK-X
ad595a7c-d314-442b-acce-ea140a56cffd.titleCn:
守护者 Wik-X
[兑换 - 守护者 MX 维科洛战争版]
ad595a7c-d314-442b-acce-ea140a56cffd.description:
You Humans enjoy strange letter combinations. It very funny. Guardian ship very useful but if you want even more useful, bring me things. I give you better ship. Look better. Act better.

Thank you. Bye.
ad595a7c-d314-442b-acce-ea140a56cffd.descriptionCn:
你们人类喜欢玩奇怪的字母组合。特别搞笑。守护者飞船挺有用。但如果你想让它更实用点。就给我带点东西。我能给你更好的飞船，外观更好看，性能也更强。

谢谢。再见。

588aadf2-a064-4af2-bdd2-d771b8beca38.title: Handle Vanduul Attack on Ship
588aadf2-a064-4af2-bdd2-d771b8beca38.titleCn:
应对剜度对飞船的攻击
[互安防务 - 保卫飞船 ERT]
588aadf2-a064-4af2-bdd2-d771b8beca38.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: An operator working with InterSec is currently being attacked by Vanduul ships at [LOCATION]. The likelihood of them surviving on their own is low, so we’re looking for a contractor willing to provide combat support.

Contractors accepting this mission should be well supplied and ready to face the Vanduul threat head-on.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
588aadf2-a064-4af2-bdd2-d771b8beca38.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：一名与互安防务合作的特工目前正在 [LOCATION] 遭遇剜度飞船的攻击，他们靠自己战斗生还的可能性很低，因此我们正在寻找愿意提供战斗支援的承包商。

接受此任务的承包商必须装备充足，并准备好正面迎战剜度威胁。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

857464b8-d35f-46ef-9c25-409395dfaf28.title: Hauling ask.
857464b8-d35f-46ef-9c25-409395dfaf28.description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry 4 SCU cargo containers.  A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out
857464b8-d35f-46ef-9c25-409395dfaf28.descriptionCn:
你为我们做得很好，所以我还想请你帮个忙。钱我还是会付给你的，但这算是个帮忙。有些物资需要从 [LOCATION] 运送到 [DESTINATION]，而原本负责的人站错了气闸的另一边，但嘿，事情还是得做。

唯一的问题是你需要一艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 个货物集装箱的飞船。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

如果你能帮我解决这个，那就太好了。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

你为我们做得很好，所以我还想请你帮个忙。钱我还是会付给你的，但这算是个帮忙。有些物资需要从 [LOCATION] 运送到 [DESTINATION]，而原本负责的人站错了气闸的另一边，但嘿，事情还是得做。

唯一的问题是你需要一艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 个货物集装箱的飞船。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

如果你能帮我解决这个，那就太好了。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

bd3158f8-4654-43bb-a736-7a1225fd0796.title: Hauling ask.
bd3158f8-4654-43bb-a736-7a1225fd0796.description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry 4 SCU cargo containers.  A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out
bd3158f8-4654-43bb-a736-7a1225fd0796.descriptionCn:
你为我们做得很好，所以我还想请你帮个忙。钱我还是会付给你的，但这算是个帮忙。有些物资需要从 [LOCATION] 运送到 [DESTINATION]，而原本负责的人站错了气闸的另一边，但嘿，事情还是得做。

038c0dab-5ca0-4363-a08e-c825a081d880.title: Headhunter attack on [LOCATION]
038c0dab-5ca0-4363-a08e-c825a081d880.description:
A distress call just came in from [LOCATION] claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
038c0dab-5ca0-4363-a08e-c825a081d880.descriptionCn:
来自 [LOCATION] 的求救信号刚刚传来，声称一支庞大的猎头帮部队刚刚袭击了我们在那里设立的前哨站。已经有多人在逃离现场时遇难和受伤。我们正在寻找任何有空的安保人员前往那里夺回前哨站。

目击者的描述将袭击者识别为精英猎头帮执法者，所以在外面要小心，如果可以的话，带上支援。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

922f2480-2b0f-470d-90c7-63c766633912.title: Headhunter Needs Help
922f2480-2b0f-470d-90c7-63c766633912.titleCn:
猎头帮需要帮助
[猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 LRT]
922f2480-2b0f-470d-90c7-63c766633912.description:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around [LOCATION]. This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships.

Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.

-Stows
922f2480-2b0f-470d-90c7-63c766633912.descriptionCn:
你忙吗？有个很有潜力的候选人正在为我执行一项特殊任务，但在 [LOCATION] 附近遇到了人民联盟的麻烦。这个任务就交给你了。我知道他们不是最出色的战斗机，但以为他们能应付得来，不会遇到其他飞船。

我让他们坚持住，尽一切可能活下来，直到支援到来。以你的能力，应该不会太难。

-斯托斯

85fb56f9-98f6-4206-acd5-bffe9c948162.title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
85fb56f9-98f6-4206-acd5-bffe9c948162.description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [LOCATION] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows
85fb56f9-98f6-4206-acd5-bffe9c948162.descriptionCn:
刚收到消息，附近的 [LOCATION] 有个猎头帮成员卷入了战斗，现在他们无法应对。那个傻瓜想让我来救他。

我想我真是个软心肠，因为我实际上会付钱让你帮我做这件事。你觉得怎么样？想救个傻瓜的命吗？


- 斯托斯

6c6d271d-55ac-4559-b880-08db3f083ec4.title: Headhunter Pilot Needs a Hand
6c6d271d-55ac-4559-b880-08db3f083ec4.titleCn: 猎头帮飞行员需要帮一把
6c6d271d-55ac-4559-b880-08db3f083ec4.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [LOCATION]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out
6c6d271d-55ac-4559-b880-08db3f083ec4.descriptionCn:
看起来有些新手想通过袭击在 [LOCATION] 附近的猎头帮飞船来插手我们的业务。真不明白他们怎么想能逃得掉。

他们需要通过痛苦的教训来明白，在派罗可不是这么回事。你愿意过去给这些家伙上一课吗？

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

7473dfc9-e18c-48f1-98b8-e9da92759440.title: Headhunter Ship Needs Backup
7473dfc9-e18c-48f1-98b8-e9da92759440.description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [LOCATION].

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me.

- Stows out
7473dfc9-e18c-48f1-98b8-e9da92759440.descriptionCn:
我的一名飞行员没考虑清楚，结果在 [LOCATION] 惹上了一堆麻烦。

更糟糕的是，这个傻瓜的货舱满满的。我们可不能损失他们运载的东西，所以如果你能帮我把他们救出来，我会非常感激。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

67b8c703-6a5e-4e14-8d77-0fb8c6e0e172.title: Help Ambushed Convoy
67b8c703-6a5e-4e14-8d77-0fb8c6e0e172.titleCn:
帮助被伏击的舰队
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 碎刃帮 HRT]
67b8c703-6a5e-4e14-8d77-0fb8c6e0e172.description:
One of our convoys is in need of combat support. Sounds like they stumbled upon a Shattered Blade hideout while trying to make a delivery. Now, despite their best efforts, the convoy can’t get away. Looking for a combat pilot willing to head to [LOCATION] to help them fight off this attack before it’s too late.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
67b8c703-6a5e-4e14-8d77-0fb8c6e0e172.descriptionCn:
我们的一支舰队需要战斗支援。听起来他们在送货途中无意中闯入了一个碎刃帮的藏身处。现在，尽管他们已经拼尽全力，但运输队还是摆脱不了困境。我们正在寻找一名愿意前往 [LOCATION] 帮助他们抵御这次袭击的战斗飞行员，别让情况太糟糕了。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

ce7ba584-44ad-482d-9fd9-7418b52938fd.title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party
ce7ba584-44ad-482d-9fd9-7418b52938fd.titleCn:
协助应对不法分子狩猎队
[繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 VLRT 多波次]
ce7ba584-44ad-482d-9fd9-7418b52938fd.description:
Recently we've had incident reports of numerous Citizens for Prosperity contractors in the system having run-ins with an outlaw hunting party operating out of [LOCATION].

To help re-establish safer routes through that sector, you will be dispatched to head there and engage with these outlaws. The group is known to travel in smaller packs, so its important that you and whatever backup you bring wait in the area to deal with all of them or else there's a chance the threat will remain.

Thank you for helping us,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
ce7ba584-44ad-482d-9fd9-7418b52938fd.descriptionCn:
近期我们接到多起报告，称星系内多名繁荣公民承包商在行动中遭遇一支以 [LOCATION] 为据点的不法分子狩猎队。

为协助恢复该星区的安全航线，现派遣你前往该地，与这些不法分子交战。该团伙惯以小股编队行动，因此，你及所携支援力量务必在该区域驻守，直至全部敌对目标全部清除，否则威胁仍有可能存在。

感谢您的协助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cdcc6d94-d081-4a68-82fd-a454b57d5a3d.title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party

023240d7-1f35-41dd-ae2b-9ee5097a6798.title: Help defend [LOCATION] from Headhunters
023240d7-1f35-41dd-ae2b-9ee5097a6798.titleCn: 帮助防御 [LOCATION] 免受猎头帮的攻击
023240d7-1f35-41dd-ae2b-9ee5097a6798.description:
We just received a frantic comm from [LOCATION] and are looking for any available combat specialists to help repel a Headhunter attack. There are still hostiles on site and there are reports of several casualties so we need this handled quickly.

I will provide all relevant data upon acceptance. Thank you for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
023240d7-1f35-41dd-ae2b-9ee5097a6798.descriptionCn:
我们刚刚收到一条来自 [LOCATION] 的紧急通讯，正在寻找任何有空的作战专家来帮助抵御猎头帮的攻击。现场仍有敌人，并且有几人伤亡的报告，因此我们需要迅速处理此事。

我将在接受合约后提供所有相关数据，感谢您的协助。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

afac9eea-809a-4af1-84cf-25e2af550b14.title: Help Headhunters at [LOCATION]
afac9eea-809a-4af1-84cf-25e2af550b14.titleCn:
在 [LOCATION] 帮助猎头帮
[猎头帮 - 地点保卫 HRT]
afac9eea-809a-4af1-84cf-25e2af550b14.description:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to [LOCATION] are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops.

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus 7 Council Scrip.

- Stows
afac9eea-809a-4af1-84cf-25e2af550b14.descriptionCn:
收到消息说，猎头帮的飞船在前往 [LOCATION] 的路上遭到了攻击。扫描显示，附近区域有敌对势力正打算对我们下手。

敌人数量不少，单靠一个人可搞不定这群垃圾。如果你能带上装备，再叫上几个朋友，那就真的帮大忙了。

具体的攻击地点和目标可能会随时变化，现在别管那些细节了。你先赶过去，我会告诉你需要去哪里支援。

只要处理得好，我会给主要承包人额外加个奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

4e98a2ec-6367-4932-927f-e73b78c8207f.title: Help Headhunters at [LOCATION]
4e98a2ec-6367-4932-927f-e73b78c8207f.titleCn:
在 [LOCATION] 帮助猎头帮
[猎头帮 - 地点保卫 HRT]

0ba906a6-ebc7-497d-b96f-a97d63a1bb05.title: Help Headhunters Prospect
0ba906a6-ebc7-497d-b96f-a97d63a1bb05.titleCn:
帮助猎头帮新人
[猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 VLRT]
0ba906a6-ebc7-497d-b96f-a97d63a1bb05.description:
Guess some folks just can’t dogfight. Sent a young prospect out on patrol, and am now being barraged with comms about how they’re barely hanging on. Had them update me with the details about who they’re up against and I damn near fell outta my chair laughing.

If this kid can’t handle a People’s Alliance ship, they sure ain’t ready for flight assignments. Appreciate it if you could save their hide anyway.

If you’re free, could you head over to [LOCATION] and show ‘em how it’s done?

-Stows
0ba906a6-ebc7-497d-b96f-a97d63a1bb05.descriptionCn:
看来有些人就是不擅长战斗机战斗。我派了一个新手去巡逻，现在收到的通讯信息全是他们怎么勉强撑着的。我让他们把对手的情况告诉我，我差点笑得从椅子上摔下来。

如果这孩子连人民联盟的飞船都对付不了，那他们肯定还没准备好执行飞行任务。如果你能帮他们摆脱麻烦，就太感谢了。

如果你有空，能去 [LOCATION] 给他们示范一下该怎么做吗？

-斯托斯

bfc725de-6d4f-4b00-940e-3b96028aae58.title: Help Protect Site
bfc725de-6d4f-4b00-940e-3b96028aae58.description:
Got word that outlaws are attempting to overrun [LOCATION]. There’s local security forces there, but they’re struggling to stop that attack.

Need a contractor to hustle there and help take care of the aggressors. Bring plenty of gear, and be careful when engaging targets. Don’t want to hear about any security team members getting caught in your crossfire.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
bfc725de-6d4f-4b00-940e-3b96028aae58.descriptionCn:
收到消息，不法分子正试图攻占 [LOCATION]。那里有当地的安保部队，但他们在阻止这次攻击方面遇到了困难。

需要一名承包商赶到那里，帮助处理这些侵略者。带上充足的装备，并在与目标交战时要小心。可不想听到任何安保小组成员被卷入交火中。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e413743.title: Hide Snow Suit
9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e413743.titleCn:
躲藏雪地套装
[兑换 - 幽影护甲 雪地迷彩]
9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e413743.description:
You want be hidden. Wikelo understand. Not ask questions why. But what do when you in snow? Wikelo have suit for that.

Welcome.
9d32ff6d-6b62-43d4-8b71-85d50e413743.descriptionCn:
你想要隐藏起来。维基洛理解。不问为什么。但是当你在雪中时怎么办？维基洛有那种服装。

欢迎

65d5fe4b-d2eb-4542-9093-7a5155602448.title: High Risk Shipment Recovery
65d5fe4b-d2eb-4542-9093-7a5155602448.titleCn:
高风险货物取回
[埃克哈特 - 取回货物 HRT]
65d5fe4b-d2eb-4542-9093-7a5155602448.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a transport in need of backup over at [LOCATION]. Signal was patchy, but their comms made it sound like a group of outlaws had gotten wind of what they were hauling and attempted to take it from them.

Considering the state of things before we lost contact, I'm considering this a recovery mission. Multiple hostiles are expected at the site, so a skilled crew is crucial for the success of this operation. There will be a high volume of cargo to deal with, so a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam will be needed.

Upon successful extraction of cargo, deliver to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
65d5fe4b-d2eb-4542-9093-7a5155602448.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：取回货物
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

有一艘运输船在 [LOCATION] 需要支援。信号断断续续，但他们的通讯里提到，一帮不法分子似乎得知了他们运送的物资，正试图夺走它们。

据说一群异种威胁的高层正在 [LOCATION] 秘密会面，计划或发泄情绪，或者做其他事情，但我们打算捣毁这个聚会。或者，由你来完成。

前往那里，消灭你遇到的所有人。没错，我敢肯定那些大人物会参与进战斗，这是他们一贯的做法。

这将会很艰难。尽管我讨厌异种威胁，但他们在战斗中确实很厉害，所以要小心，如果可以的话带上帮手。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

cdea5768-6bb8-43a5-b613-84dc9be80bbc.title: Hit XenoThreat at [LOCATION]
cdea5768-6bb8-43a5-b613-84dc9be80bbc.description:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [LOCATION]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.
cdea5768-6bb8-43a5-b613-84dc9be80bbc.descriptionCn:
我们的一名成员偶然发现了一群异种威胁藏身在靠近 [LOCATION] 的前哨站。不确定他们是扎根在此还是只是路过，但我们想在他们行动之前先发制人。

如果你有人的话，最好带上，因为异种威胁可不好对付。赶快去，让他们知道在这个星系里谁才是掌控者。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

2a2e6539-e536-4622-9cbc-d000a4bff8a3.title: Hitting a CFP site
2a2e6539-e536-4622-9cbc-d000a4bff8a3.description:
Need someone to sweep [LOCATION]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge.

Need it done fast and clean.

Stows out.
2a2e6539-e536-4622-9cbc-d000a4bff8a3.descriptionCn:
需要有人去清扫 [LOCATION]。繁荣公民的安保部队从一群在那儿待了多年的当地人手中夺走了这个前哨站。听说他们把那些人打得很惨，所以他们来找猎头帮寻求报复。

需要快速而干净地完成这个任务。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

ba4e3db4-0f7d-4692-8b9d-8efe3085e84d.title: Hot Shot
ba4e3db4-0f7d-4692-8b9d-8efe3085e84d.titleCn:
热辣射击手枪
[兑换 - 三重击 “热浪” 手枪]
ba4e3db4-0f7d-4692-8b9d-8efe3085e84d.description:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.
ba4e3db4-0f7d-4692-8b9d-8efe3085e84d.descriptionCn:
你需要一把好武器，是吧？我这儿有一把，小巧但威力十足，就像一颗特别辣的巴拉鲁辣椒。维科洛也让这把手枪看起来格外火辣。你带来我需要的东西，我们就做笔交易。

再见。

995895a5-d686-468a-a592-b0fa86d7bffb.title: Hunt Some Heads
995895a5-d686-468a-a592-b0fa86d7bffb.titleCn:
猎一些头
[猎头帮 - 巡逻 ERT]
995895a5-d686-468a-a592-b0fa86d7bffb.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.

- Stows
995895a5-d686-468a-a592-b0fa86d7bffb.descriptionCn:
有群杂碎想把咱们挤出星系。想不想给他们点颜色瞧瞧？

听着，有些人真的不希望我们在这待着，他们已经开始派出五到七艘船的猎杀小队，通常还会有一艘火力更强的大型战舰，跑到我们正在建立势力的地方搞事情。是时候让他们知道，我们可不是好惹的。

我在 HUD 上标记了一个位置标记，串起了几个地点，这些地方是我们遭遇敌对行为最频繁的区域。需要你去每个地方扫描一下，看看能不能引诱他们出来干一架。

我知道这任务不容易，所以别太自信想着单干。如果我是你，我会至少带上三个朋友来帮忙。为了让你觉得值，所以答应给完成任务的主承包商额外 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

4cfe6e6b-9528-43eb-ab7a-1c1e14942173.title: INFILITRATE ASD SITE AND DESTROY SERVERS
4cfe6e6b-9528-43eb-ab7a-1c1e14942173.titleCn:
潜入 ASD 并摧毁服务器
[研究翼楼 - 能源实验室]
4cfe6e6b-9528-43eb-ab7a-1c1e14942173.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Our client has requested the immediate destruction of a group of servers located at a long-shuttered ASD research site. The servers in question contain information that our client considers extremely damaging and is eager to see the data completely eliminated.

Initial surveillance indicates the servers are within the facility’s Energy Lab, located in the Research wing. We’ve also picked up on a number of hostile forces, so be on alert.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
4cfe6e6b-9528-43eb-ab7a-1c1e14942173.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：摧毁服务器
授权代码 = VS-14

需要立即处理

我们的客户要求立即销毁一组位于早已关闭的联合科学与开发公司(ASD)研究站点的服务器。这些服务器包含客户认为极其有害的信息，他们迫切希望彻底清除这些数据。

初步侦察显示，这些服务器位于设施内研究翼楼的能源实验室中。我们还发现了一些敌对势力，因此请保持警惕。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

1464ed09-2099-4102-8672-25f764e278d2.title: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
1464ed09-2099-4102-8672-25f764e278d2.description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.
1464ed09-2099-4102-8672-25f764e278d2.descriptionCn:
各位“客人”，

我们最近接到警报，有一个补氧站出现技术故障。 你知道的，这些补氧站是用来确保你们在参与我们的劳动减刑计划时能有充足的氧气而设置的。

我们需要一位“客人”去重置补氧站。那会把补氧站重连到网络并且解决这个问题。作为第一个吃螃蟹的人，你不仅会得到功绩点奖励，更会为其他人的工作奠定安全的基础。

谢谢。

0f753484-1914-4770-aa59-25eeb460866b.title: Intensive Eradication Effort
0f753484-1914-4770-aa59-25eeb460866b.titleCn:
强力根除行动
[高境荒野 - 击杀动物 HRT 多物种]
0f753484-1914-4770-aa59-25eeb460866b.description:
Native plants and animals near [LOCATION] are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
0f753484-1914-4770-aa59-25eeb460866b.descriptionCn:
由于几种入侵物种数量的剧增，[LOCATION] 附近的本土植物和动物正面临环境崩溃的边缘。我们已被委托大幅减少这些物种的当前数量，以帮助避免环境崩溃。我们需要一位专注且技术高超的“终结者”来执行这个合约。

你可以通过在你的日志中参考《斯坦顿野生动物指南》，更好地了解这些生物。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

cbb52f75-38cd-4fcd-ad00-67bb94a0630a.title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at [DESTINATION]
cbb52f75-38cd-4fcd-ad00-67bb94a0630a.titleCn:
在 [DESTINATION] 的前哨站之间配送
[繁荣公民 - 一对一投递]
cbb52f75-38cd-4fcd-ad00-67bb94a0630a.description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cbb52f75-38cd-4fcd-ad00-67bb94a0630a.descriptionCn:
嘿，

我们有一个机会给任何愿意出手帮助繁荣公民的搬运工。

有一个箱子需要从 [LOCATION] 搬到 [DESTINATION]。如果你在前哨站附近还有空的话，这应该不会花太多时间。

另外，为了让你省点事，我想确保你带了一个手持式牵引光束。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

f8d9090e-07e6-412d-bb9e-349fa3d4b42d.title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at [DESTINATION] - Multiple Boxes
f8d9090e-07e6-412d-bb9e-349fa3d4b42d.titleCn:
在 [DESTINATION] 的前哨站之间配送 - 多个箱子
[繁荣公民 - 一对一投递]
f8d9090e-07e6-412d-bb9e-349fa3d4b42d.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
f8d9090e-07e6-412d-bb9e-349fa3d4b42d.descriptionCn:
嗨，

繁荣公民需要帮助，需要在我们的一处前哨站搬运物资。箱子需要从 [LOCATION] 拿起，然后运送到 [DESTINATION]。

听起来不太难，对吧？只要确保你穿着舒适的鞋子就行了。

另外，为了让你省点事，我想确保你带了一个手持式牵引光束。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
472fe29a-f001-4c12-8c74-f285b4da8e28.descriptionCn:
嗨，

繁荣公民需要帮助，需要在我们的一处前哨站搬运物资。箱子需要从 [LOCATION] 拿起，然后运送到 [DESTINATION]。

听起来不太难，对吧？只要确保你穿着舒适的鞋子就行了。

另外，为了让你省点事，我想确保你带了一个手持式牵引光束。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

dd2e2360-d42b-4459-bf8f-21beb7faf0c6.title: Intercepted Supply Run
dd2e2360-d42b-4459-bf8f-21beb7faf0c6.titleCn:
供应被中断
[繁荣公民 - 取回货物 LRT]
dd2e2360-d42b-4459-bf8f-21beb7faf0c6.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
dd2e2360-d42b-4459-bf8f-21beb7faf0c6.descriptionCn:
边境生活艰难，每一次给我们定居者的补给都至关重要，今年我们真的不能再有更多损失了。

在 [LOCATION] 有位我们的关键供应商遭到一伙不法分子袭击，此后便彻底失联。我担心最坏的情况已经发生，但如果还能抢回他们当时运输的物资，那将意义重大。

袭击他们的不法分子很可能仍潜伏在附近，务必提高警惕。等你清理掉他们后，尽快取走货物，并运送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。请确保你驾驶的飞船能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱，同时务必配备一把 重型牵引光束。

祝你在那飞行平安，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

0a3bc165-d4d5-48b0-9b7a-0a34341e50c0.title: Interdict XenoThreat Attack Force
0a3bc165-d4d5-48b0-9b7a-0a34341e50c0.titleCn:
拦截异种威胁攻击力量
[福克斯韦尔 - 异种 击杀飞船多波次]
0a3bc165-d4d5-48b0-9b7a-0a34341e50c0.description:
Multiple reports are coming in of XenoThreat ships massing at [LOCATION]
We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them.

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
0a3bc165-d4d5-48b0-9b7a-0a34341e50c0.descriptionCn:
收到多份报告称异种威胁飞船正聚集于 [LOCATION]。我们正在招募承包商，准备主动出击。

他们企图让我们相信其占据正义、拥有压倒性兵力。这正是向他们证明我们更胜一筹的绝佳机会。

我不必隐瞒，这对我而言绝不仅仅是一份普通的安全合约。我真心厌恶这些偏执狂及其所代表的一切。

你跟我来吗？

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

1035d0f0-82e7-4cee-8d10-789925b3d138.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?
1035d0f0-82e7-4cee-8d10-789925b3d138.titleCn: 有兴趣共建更美好的未来吗？
1035d0f0-82e7-4cee-8d10-789925b3d138.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond.

A research initiative at [DESTINATION] is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
1035d0f0-82e7-4cee-8d10-789925b3d138.descriptionCn:
拉亚利公司正在寻找独立承包商，为我们在帝国及其他地区推动科学、农业和医学发展的努力提供额外支持。

位于 [DESTINATION] 的一项研究项目急需一些资源，因此我们正在寻找可靠的承包商来获取并交付这些关键成分。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《斯坦顿野生动物指南》。

拉亚利提供具有竞争力的薪酬，并让您知道您正在为构建一个更美好的宇宙贡献力量。

让我们携手共进，

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

a368e5c8-9c12-45eb-a8bb-bb0799485ec5.title: Jackpot
a368e5c8-9c12-45eb-a8bb-bb0799485ec5.titleCn:
头奖
[猎头帮 - 取回货物 HRT]
a368e5c8-9c12-45eb-a8bb-bb0799485ec5.description:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at [LOCATION]. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your heavy-duty tractor beam of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION], I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.
a368e5c8-9c12-45eb-a8bb-bb0799485ec5.descriptionCn:
货就在 [LOCATION] 那艘废弃飞船的后头，你也知道，这货不是我们的，但更不能让别人拿走。要真让那帮繁荣公民的混蛋先得手，我还不如直接跳船。

咱们算走运，是第一个知道这事儿的，但我打赌现在那儿的飞船肯定多得跟寇骈犬尸体上的苍蝇一样。要是你有信得过的兄弟，带上去把那些杂种都干掉。当然，别忘了你的重型牵引光束。

你要是能把货弄到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我给你抽一大笔分成。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

454b2e3a-c775-4ef0-b9e8-6bcd5aa9ca37.title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Engineering Files
454b2e3a-c775-4ef0-b9e8-6bcd5aa9ca37.titleCn: 约里特卷宗：访问工程文档
454b2e3a-c775-4ef0-b9e8-6bcd5aa9ca37.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files.

Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.

Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
454b2e3a-c775-4ef0-b9e8-6bcd5aa9ca37.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
从玛瑙设施找到的人事档案中，我们得知约里特博士最近曾到访过该地点，并在那儿访问了一些文档。接下来的任务是顺着这条线索，查清楚约里特博士在他的旧实验室里到底做了些什么。

合约调查员的行动：
探索工程翼楼并获取约里特博士近期的文件。

补充说明：
我已经找到了一个解决量子航行问题的办法，所以从现在开始你可以直接航行那个地点了。

小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

eb69f7e0-1355-4bfb-a5c6-0b0b107a4ac0.title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Research Files
eb69f7e0-1355-4bfb-a5c6-0b0b107a4ac0.titleCn: 约里特卷宗：访问研究文档
eb69f7e0-1355-4bfb-a5c6-0b0b107a4ac0.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The files you found in Engineering confirm that Dr. Jorrit is actively pursuing something at the site, but it is still unclear what the doctor is up to. I’m hoping that if you can find the data he was accessing in Research it will provide further clarity.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Research wing to locate and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files .

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you accessed these files, I'll be sending you 5 Secure Drives with copies of whatever data we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.
eb69f7e0-1355-4bfb-a5c6-0b0b107a4ac0.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
你在工程区找到的文件证实，约里特博士正在这个地点积极追查某些东西，但目前还不清楚他到底在搞什么名堂。我希望如果你能找到他在研究区访问的数据，可能会让事情更明朗一些。

合约调查员的行动：
探索研究翼楼，找到并获取约里特博士近期的文件。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

一旦你访问了这些文件，我会给你发送 5 个安全驱动器，里面会有我们目前收集到的所有数据的副本。你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。

f4c7498d-bd4e-4b15-a3ff-660d6270cb8b.title: Jorrit Dossier: Lab Sample
f4c7498d-bd4e-4b15-a3ff-660d6270cb8b.titleCn: 约里特卷宗：实验室样本
f4c7498d-bd4e-4b15-a3ff-660d6270cb8b.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
In going through the files, I’ve seen a couple of allusions to a specific lab sample that would potentially be useful to have our people analyze. Not sure where it is exactly, but if you hunt around Onyx Facility you should be able to find the sample and bring it to me.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Onyx Facility Research Wing and track down the Lab Sample and deliver it to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
f4c7498d-bd4e-4b15-a3ff-660d6270cb8b.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
在翻阅文档时，我发现提到了一个特定的实验室样本，要是能让我们的人分析一下应该会很有用。不过不确定具体在哪儿，但你只要在玛瑙设施里仔细找找，应该就能找到样本，然后带回来给我。

合约调查员的行动：
探索玛瑙设施研究翼楼，找到实验室样本，然后将它送到 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

驾驶一辆可以停放在大型机库中的载具前往玛瑙设施。

593436a5-eff9-40b2-801a-6b0e31e3ce59.title: Jorrit Dossier: Onyx Personnel Files
593436a5-eff9-40b2-801a-6b0e31e3ce59.titleCn: 约里特卷宗：玛瑙人事档案
593436a5-eff9-40b2-801a-6b0e31e3ce59.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist Dr. Logan Jorrit. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered Onyx Facility where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and access the research lab’s personnel files so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there.

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.
593436a5-eff9-40b2-801a-6b0e31e3ce59.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
一位客户请求霍克罗事务所为臭名昭著的科学家洛根·约里特博士编纂一份完整的卷宗。洛根博士被认为对发生在联合科学与开发公司拉撒路站点的事件负有责任，客户迫切希望更全面地了解洛根博士及其研究内容。

合约调查员的行动：
进入 ASD 已经关闭的玛瑙设施，洛根博士曾是该设施的首席科学家。到达后，找到并访问研究实验室的人事档案，以便我们能大致了解那里曾经发生的事情。

补充说明：
当设施断电时，通往该地点的量子航行信标也被停用了，所以你得手动驾驶飞船飞完最后一段路程。

虽然 ASD 已正式关闭该设施，但仍需保持警惕。不仅实验室本身可能存在危险，周围区域也显示出近期有人活动的迹象。可能会有拾荒者或擅闯人员在现场。

此外，我设法为你搞到了一个员工 ID 代码，只要你在执行任务，就能访问那里的电脑。

还有，玛瑙设施只有大型机库可用，因此请合理规划你的行程。

9583e420-a4ea-4183-8064-90684dc4afc7.title: Jorrit Dossier: Power Usage Data
9583e420-a4ea-4183-8064-90684dc4afc7.titleCn: 约里特卷宗：能源用量数据
9583e420-a4ea-4183-8064-90684dc4afc7.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The seismic data you extracted had some interesting revelations. My expert says she thinks that Jorrit might have been excavating down there. Hate to think what he’s doing, but it's our job to find out. I think we’re close to cracking this, so I want you to go back to Onyx and gather the Power Usage data. If we can track energy flow from the last couple months, a pattern should reveal itself.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and upload the Power Usage data.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll be sending you 10 Secure Drives with copies of the information we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.
9583e420-a4ea-4183-8064-90684dc4afc7.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
你提取的地震波数据里有一些有趣的发现。我的专家表示，她觉得乔里特可能在下面进行过挖掘。虽然不太想猜测他在干嘛，但搞清楚这是我们的任务。我觉得我们快找到答案了，所以我想让你返回玛瑙，收集能源用量数据。如果我们能追踪过去几个月的能源流动，应该就能发现一些规律。

合约调查员的行动：
探索工程翼楼并上传能源用量数据。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

驾驶一辆可以停放在大型机库中的载具前往玛瑙设施。

一旦你交出这些数据，我会给你发送 10 个 ASD 安全驱动器，里面会有我们目前收集到的所有数据的副本。你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。

ff1673f2-fa07-47b8-8d3f-2a1435dc9279.title: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
ff1673f2-fa07-47b8-8d3f-2a1435dc9279.titleCn: 约里特卷宗：海伯利安项目
ff1673f2-fa07-47b8-8d3f-2a1435dc9279.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

80c3155a-f57c-4d22-8bad-de66ce2b0a60.title: Keep [LOCATION] Safe
80c3155a-f57c-4d22-8bad-de66ce2b0a60.titleCn:
保证 [LOCATION] 安全
[猎头帮 - 保护实体并护航 VLRT]
80c3155a-f57c-4d22-8bad-de66ce2b0a60.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that [LOCATION] is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their [OBJECTS]. It won't stand.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows
80c3155a-f57c-4d22-8bad-de66ce2b0a60.descriptionCn:
不跟你啰嗦那些细节，但信我，[LOCATION] 对猎头帮来说至关重要。所以你知道当我听说那帮不知天高地厚的愣头青正疯狂骚扰他们、一心想把他们的 [OBJECTS] 给毁了时，我有多火大吗？这事儿没门！

赶紧过去，在一切被毁之前提供保护，包括周边任何需要帮忙的任何友方飞船。像这种脑残家伙，对你这种冉冉升起的新星来说应该算不上什么挑战吧。

把他们全给我收拾干净，谁接了这活儿，我就扔给他 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

[猎头帮 - 保护可摧毁实体 VLRT]
c0c71b98-64c3-4564-b74c-f1d97a3579fa.description:
You don't need all the details, but Headhunters have an interest in what happens over at [LOCATION] and I just got word they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts.

The dumb sods are trying to cripple the place by taking out their [OBJECTS]. I'm not having it.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed. These chumps are lightweights so shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to handle.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows
c0c71b98-64c3-4564-b74c-f1d97a3579fa.descriptionCn:
你不用知道所有细节，但猎头帮对 [LOCATION] 那边发生的事很感兴趣，我刚收到消息说他们正被一些不知天高地厚的愣头青骚扰。

这帮蠢货想通过摧毁他们的 [OBJECTS] 来废掉那个地方。我绝不允许这种事发生。

赶紧过去提供保护，别等一切都毁了再后悔。这些家伙都是些软脚虾，对你来说应该不是什么大麻烦。

把他们全收拾干净，谁接了这个活儿，我就额外给谁 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

9aced3fa-2745-48ae-882d-491aa7f2b031.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TARGET], who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [LOCATION], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
9aced3fa-2745-48ae-882d-491aa7f2b031.descriptionCn:
需要再处理一艘繁荣公民的船。它属于 [TARGET]，这个家伙一直在逼迫当地人，如果他们不接受繁荣公民的帮助，就得离开他们的家。他们真是个麻烦，我们已经得到了指示，可以解决他们。

他们的船在 [LOCATION] 附近被发现，所以赶紧去那里完成任务。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

71ac016c-3b19-439c-aa85-a053ad69b931.title: Kill the king
71ac016c-3b19-439c-aa85-a053ad69b931.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at [LOCATION], they're getting hit by some geniuses led by [TARGET]. We've tussled against [TARGET] in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up.

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but [TARGET] should be your focus.

Stows out.
71ac016c-3b19-439c-aa85-a053ad69b931.descriptionCn:
寻找可以迅速出击的打手。在 [LOCATION] 那里，他们正遭到一群由 [TARGET] 领导的“天才”们的攻击。我们之前和 [TARGET] 有过冲突，所以他们没能吸取教训也就不足为奇了。

我们希望你去那里将他们击败。你可以杀任何人，但 [TARGET] 应该是你的重点目标。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

9f87be01-d306-4663-9c63-b6f669783b48.title: Knock Out New Drug Op
9f87be01-d306-4663-9c63-b6f669783b48.description:
Some folks will do anything for a few creds. There’s a group of upstart outlaws over at [LOCATION] that have decided to start manufacturing drugs. Turns out they’re not too good at it, or maybe a little too good. The junk they’re pumping out is stronger than the normal stuff and a real danger to anyone who uses it.

We’ve been hired to knock out their operation and destroy whatever drugs stashes are on site. Armed guards are protecting the place, but they don’t seem too skilled. Our surveillance teams observed one of them almost shoot himself in the foot. Can’t say for certain, but odds are they won’t give a pro like you too many problems.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
9f87be01-d306-4663-9c63-b6f669783b48.descriptionCn:
有些人为了几个信用点什么都愿意做。在 [LOCATION] 那里，有一群新兴的不法分子决定开始制造毒品。结果发现他们的技术不太好，或者说有点太好。他们生产的垃圾比普通的毒品要强得多，对任何使用它的人都是真正的危险。

我们被雇佣来摧毁他们的运作并销毁现场藏匿的毒品。武装保安正在保护这个地方，但他们似乎并不太专业。我们的监视团队观察到其中一个人差点把自己脚射了。我不敢肯定，但很可能他们不会给像你这样的专业人士带来太多麻烦。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

1dd9f39c-119f-4815-94b6-a91946ffea33.title: Knock Power Out
1dd9f39c-119f-4815-94b6-a91946ffea33.description:
Got a few scavs that have rooted themselves into [LOCATION]. We have our own plans there and need the place cleared out.

That's why I want you to ho and turn off their power. Let's see if that doesn't cause these rats to abandon the place for good.

-Stows
1dd9f39c-119f-4815-94b6-a91946ffea33.descriptionCn:
有几个垃圾佬已经在 [LOCATION] 安了家。但我们在那有自己的计划，所以需要把地方清理干净。

所以我希望你能去那儿关掉他们的电源。看看这样是否能让这些老鼠永远离开这个地方。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

12a94de8-d1a1-489b-a866-2bc745b02413.title: Large Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
12a94de8-d1a1-489b-a866-2bc745b02413.titleCn:
大批量科瓦莱什货物需要追回

12a94de8-d1a1-489b-a866-2bc745b02413.description:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at [LOCATION] and bringing it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
12a94de8-d1a1-489b-a866-2bc745b02413.descriptionCn:
嗨，我是艾拉。

这活儿得赶紧找人干，我们有个承包商突然有“私人紧急情况”，直接扔下飞船跑了，看样子是不打算回来了，够糟心的。

好消息是货还在，至少追踪器上显示没丢。你能赶去 [LOCATION] 把货捞回来，再送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿吗，那对我来说真是帮大忙了！

这单子挺大的，你得开艘能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船，还得配把重型牵引光束才搬得动。真谢谢你啦！

[SIGN_OFF]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

4785d6e2-2543-8db6-2009-1524a3f38aaf.title: Last Landings needs a bunch of repairs
4785d6e2-2543-8db6-2009-1524a3f38aaf.description:
Sending a call out to anyone nearby. Got a pretty heavy work order for one of our outposts at [LOCATION]. Sounds like we need six fuses fixed. You'll also need a salvaging tool with enough RMC to patch up about five pipes to stop the place from falling apart.

If you bring all the shit needed to patch them up, we'll pay you out.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
4785d6e2-2543-8db6-2009-1524a3f38aaf.descriptionCn:
呼叫附近能干活的。我们在 [LOCATION] 有个前哨站需要大修，得搞定 六个保险丝。你还得带上 打捞工具 和 足够修补五根管道的 RMC 罐，防止这破地方彻底垮掉。

把修修补补的破烂工具都带齐了，我们就给你结账。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过建议你翻翻 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

450cce64-c9ea-2bf0-bf69-328e80c30fa6.title: Last Landings needs massive repairs
450cce64-c9ea-2bf0-bf69-328e80c30fa6.description:
Down at [LOCATION], the place got utterly smashed in a storm and needs some serious patchwork.

If anyone out there has a bunch of fuses (I hear six should be plenty), a salvaging tool, and enough RMC cans to deal with eight or so messed up pipes, we'll hook you up with some creds to do the fix.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
450cce64-c9ea-2bf0-bf69-328e80c30fa6.descriptionCn:
[LOCATION] 那破地方被风暴彻底蹂躏了，现在急需大规模修补。

要是有谁带着 一堆保险丝（听说 六个 就够用）、打捞工具 和 能修理八根左右破管道的 RMC 罐，咱们可以谈笔维修的买卖。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，最好瞅瞅你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

41ee2638-1389-0538-311f-e2b8b8f61a9a.title: Last Landings needs some repairs
41ee2638-1389-0538-311f-e2b8b8f61a9a.description:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at [LOCATION] got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but no more than three I think). If you can bring a salvaging tool with enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
41ee2638-1389-0538-311f-e2b8b8f61a9a.descriptionCn:
如果你看到这个，我们需要帮手。我们在 [LOCATION] 的前哨站被恶劣风暴袭击受损。平常的技术员不是没空就是已经挂了（字面意思），所以想雇人去修几个保险丝（不确定具体数量但 最多三个）。要是你能带个 打捞工具 和 足够修理三根管道的 RMC 罐，应该就能搞定。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》 或许值得翻翻。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

e85ccd0b-6449-4ffe-9773-c945d57295dc.title: Launch Surprise Attack
e85ccd0b-6449-4ffe-9773-c945d57295dc.titleCn:
发动奇袭
[埃克哈特 - 伏击 MRT]
e85ccd0b-6449-4ffe-9773-c945d57295dc.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Need someone to take out a [TARGET] and deal with the escort ships protecting it. They’ve already interfered with several of our ongoing operations and have become a real problem across several of Eckhart Security cases. Not sure what their endgame is, but it won’t matter once you deal with them.

We’ve let slip that we will be working a job over at [LOCATION] which should serve as bait to draw them out. The spot is ideal for an ambush because of the emission cloud that’s a perfect place to power down and hide until you’re ready to strike. If you’re available, the [TARGET] and its escorts should be passing through soon.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
e85ccd0b-6449-4ffe-9773-c945d57295dc.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：飞船伏击
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

需要有人干掉 [TARGET] 以及保护它的护航舰队。他们已经干扰了我们好几项正在进行的行动，在埃克哈特安全公司的多个案例中都成了大麻烦。我们不清楚他们的真正目的，但一旦你解决了他们，那就都无关紧要了。

我们已经透露我们将在 [LOCATION] 执行一项任务，这应该能吸引他们过来。这个地点非常适合设伏，因为那里有辐射云，可以让你关闭飞船藏起来，等到行动时机成熟再出击。如果你有空的话，[TARGET] 及其护航舰队应该很快就会经过。

合约完成后立即付款。主承包商还能获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的额外奖励。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

43a88af1-e644-480f-b0fa-928a61d3941c.title: Legendary Info?
43a88af1-e644-480f-b0fa-928a61d3941c.titleCn:
传奇信息？
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 HRT]
43a88af1-e644-480f-b0fa-928a61d3941c.description:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at [LOCATION] surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION] for us.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros
43a88af1-e644-480f-b0fa-928a61d3941c.descriptionCn:
你听说没？[LOCATION] 那儿一堆船围着艘烧得只剩架子的飞船，知道为啥不？我们可好奇死了。你能不能溜进那堆废铁里，找到黑匣子再溜出来？事成之后我们付钱。

这地方到处都是不靠谱的家伙，你最好带几个帮手盯着后背，除非你真打算一个人单干——但咱还是希望你能活下来，好把黑匣子送到 [DESTINATION] 这儿来。

不过嘛，咋干你说了算，只要事儿能办成。

- 零比特

44e71db6-73d6-4ca6-83b3-b83496306b63.title: Ling Family Rookie Cargo Haul - Medium Scale
44e71db6-73d6-4ca6-83b3-b83496306b63.titleCn:
玲家 [RANK] 货物运输 - [CARGO_GRADE] 级别
[玲家快递 - 一对一货运]
44e71db6-73d6-4ca6-83b3-b83496306b63.description:
Hi,

Guess the folks at [DESTINATION] are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

Please remember to bring a handheld tractor beam, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to 8 SCU.


Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
44e71db6-73d6-4ca6-83b3-b83496306b63.descriptionCn:
嗨，

我猜 [DESTINATION] 那帮人是打算要开派对，所以急着凑齐所有东西，你这单得跑好几趟，其中一趟能去尼克斯提点“金克斯金酒”——你没喝过吧？那可是尼克斯的招牌，有人嫌它粉嘟嘟地发光，但我超爱，就爱喝那一口独特的劲道。

以下是取货地点：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

忘了带个手持式牵引光束，货箱最大尺寸有 [MAX_SCU]，光靠胳膊可搬不动。


运货顺利，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

34ba1fc9-c6fd-4505-8dfe-bc7d67509776.title: Ling Family Rookie Cargo Haul - Small Scale
34ba1fc9-c6fd-4505-8dfe-bc7d67509776.titleCn:
玲家 [RANK] 货物运输 - [CARGO_GRADE] 级别
[玲家快递 - 一对一货运]
34ba1fc9-c6fd-4505-8dfe-bc7d67509776.description:
Hi,

Normally Reyes schedules our hauls, but she’s gone for the day, and I just got a comm inquiring about a simple, direct run from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. The cargo is a load of fruit that will lose its value if it spoils. We don't want to anger this client, so would appreciate it if you knocked this out in a timely manner.

Here’s some other details you should know. The largest container used is 2 SCU, so don’t forget your handheld tractor beam.


Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
34ba1fc9-c6fd-4505-8dfe-bc7d67509776.descriptionCn:
嗨，

平时都是雷耶斯安排货运，但她今天不在，我刚接到个消息，说有一单简单的直达运货，从 [LOCATION] 到 [DESTINATION]，货是水果，放久了就烂，价值直接归零，我们可不想惹毛这客户。如果你能及时解决这个问题那我将感激不尽。

顺带一提，最大集装箱的尺寸是 [MAX_SCU]，别忘了带个手持式牵引光束，不然真搬不动。


此致，
佩特拉·玲
