45df5785-3b88-409f-80d8-e029c23b35d4.description:
Hi,

Guess the folks at [DESTINATION] are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

Please remember to bring a handheld tractor beam, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to 2 SCU.


Happy Hauling,

45df5785-3b88-409f-80d8-e029c23b35d4.descriptionCn:
嗨，

[DESTINATION] 那帮人估计是准备要开派对了，急着把东西凑齐。你得跑好几个地方提货，其中一个还得去尼克斯拿点“金克斯金酒”——你没喝过吧？那可是尼克斯的招牌，有人嫌它粉嘟嘟地发光，但我超爱，就爱喝那一口独特的劲道。

以下是取货地点：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

别忘了带上手持式牵引光束，集装箱最大能到 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸，没它真搞不定。


运货顺利，

8f29a2e2-4f34-4a9e-8335-e0b7e4d32f4c.description:
Hey,

Any chance you’d be willing to do a haul into Pyro? I know it can get dangerous there but this is for a good cause. A group of new CFP members have moved to [DESTINATION] and had a tough time adjusting to life in the system. They all left stuff behind in Stanton, because their transporter didn’t have room, so we’ve been hired to pick it all up and bring it to them.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
- [LOCATION 4]

CFP leaders hope that bringing them this stuff will make the system feel more like home. Let’s make sure this one goes down smoothly. Remember to equip your handheld tractor beam, and a ship that can fit 2 SCU cargo containers.


Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator

8f29a2e2-4f34-4a9e-8335-e0b7e4d32f4c.descriptionCn:
嘿，

你愿意跑一单去派罗吗？我知道那地方挺危险，但这事儿真挺有意义的。一群新加入繁荣公民的家伙刚搬去 [DESTINATION]，在星系里过得特别不不适应。他们东西全撂在斯坦顿了，因为他们的运输舱塞不下。我们这回就是去把他们家当全捡回来，送过去。

以下是取货地点：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

繁荣公民的领导们说，把这些东西送过去，他们才能觉得这地方像家。咱可得把这单干漂亮了。别忘了带上手持式牵引光束，再找艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的船，就稳了。


运货顺利，
雷耶斯·玲

81370d58-c460-4622-a171-19a865df227d.descriptionCn:

想找点轻松的工作？有位客户正等着收货，但我们的运输员飞船出了引擎故障，一时半会儿修不好，急需有人接手。

a56c6f15-51a4-41cd-9f38-570fbcaf3fc6.title: Little Heavy Lifting at [DESTINATION]
a56c6f15-51a4-41cd-9f38-570fbcaf3fc6.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at [LOCATION] that have to be moved to [DESTINATION]. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t.

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a  handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.

Stows out.
a56c6f15-51a4-41cd-9f38-570fbcaf3fc6.descriptionCn:
在 [LOCATION] 有一堆箱子需要搬到 [DESTINATION]。听起来挺简单，对吧？可实际上并没那么容易。

本来负责搬运的那个傻逼试图一次性把所有箱子都扛过去，结果背扭了。所以，你知道的，或许可以带个牵引光束，像个正常人一样一次搬一个。不过，嘿，别让我告诉你怎么做你的工作。把事情办妥就行。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

[霍克罗 - 寻找尸体 HRT]
c24d61ed-6547-4325-bb62-b7c3c7c4d272.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP65817
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A client has hired the agency to look for a missing friend who has not been returning their comms and have been acting increasingly erratic. The client has shared all the information they possess on [TARGET] and we’ve been able to pinpoint their ship’s location.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION] and verify the status of [TARGET]. If they are deceased, examine their body and we will pass the information on to the client.

Additional Notes:
Our scout reported heavy outlaw activity in the vicinity and was forced to retreat, meaning we have designated this as a highly dangerous case.
c24d61ed-6547-4325-bb62-b7c3c7c4d272.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP65817
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
一位客户雇佣了我们事务所来寻找一位失踪的朋友，这位朋友已经停止了通讯联系，行为也越来越异常。客户已经提供了他们所掌握的所有关于 [TARGET] 的信息，我们现在已经确定了他们的飞船位置。

合约调查员的行动：
前往 [LOCATION]，核实 [TARGET] 的情况。如果他们已经死亡，请检查他们的尸体，然后我们将把相关信息报告给客户。

补充说明：
我们的侦察员报告称该地区有大量的不法分子活动，被迫撤退，因此我们将此案件列为高危案件。

寻找失踪的客户
[霍克罗 - 寻找尸体 VLRT]
30c018af-d3f0-472c-b494-9367b4e7cbbe.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP51643
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Looking for an operative to confirm the status of a client. They and their partner missed a scheduled meeting and all attempts to contact them have proven in vain. Last we heard they were undertaking some business in [SYSTEM] and fear that they may be the victim of some unfortunate tragedy.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate [MISSINGPERSONLIST] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Be cautious while conducting your search. If the client did meet harm, it would be unfortunate for you to meet the same fate.
30c018af-d3f0-472c-b494-9367b4e7cbbe.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP51643
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
需一名行动人员确认某客户当前状态：该客户与其搭档未能如期赴约，且所有联络尝试均告失败。据最后消息，二人此前正在 [SYSTEM] 处理某项事务，我们担忧其或已遭遇不幸事件。

合约调查员的行动：
请前往 [LOCATION] 找到 [MISSINGPERSONLIST] 并确认其状态。

若他们已身亡，请仔细检查遗体，以便我们通过您的 mobiGlas 核实死亡情况。

b8ed09b9-30af-4d8a-bef3-df9a20c1e833.title: Looking for a Damn Hero
b8ed09b9-30af-4d8a-bef3-df9a20c1e833.titleCn:
急需一个英雄
[猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 ERT]
b8ed09b9-30af-4d8a-bef3-df9a20c1e833.description:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near [LOCATION]. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.

Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.

-Stows
b8ed09b9-30af-4d8a-bef3-df9a20c1e833.descriptionCn:
我们这下可麻烦大了。一艘执行重要任务的猎头帮飞船在 [LOCATION] 附近遭到了攻击。虽然不能透露太多细节，但他们的生存绝对至关重要。人民联盟也必须知道这件事，因为他们正在倾尽全力对付我们。

我们不会手下留情。这是个非常严重的情况，很多人在这种情况下都活不下来。如果你能成功解决这个问题，我会好好表扬你，而且保证你会得到丰厚的报酬。

-斯托斯

a43da254-512c-4f81-9897-fcacde7f5245.title: Looking for a little revenge
a43da254-512c-4f81-9897-fcacde7f5245.description:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to [LOCATION] and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows
a43da254-512c-4f81-9897-fcacde7f5245.descriptionCn:
事情是这样的。一些繁荣公民雇佣的安保，竟然对一些只是路过的猎头帮开枪。他们甚至什么都没做，只是在飞行而已。

不管怎样，我们追踪到了他位于 [LOCATION]，我们想报仇。准备好你的装备，充当我们的武器，我们会让你得到回报。

- 斯托斯

c980057a-d5da-4c8e-8f12-1d53394d4d35.title: Looking For Trouble
c980057a-d5da-4c8e-8f12-1d53394d4d35.titleCn:
主动找茬
[猎头帮 - 巡逻 HRT]
c980057a-d5da-4c8e-8f12-1d53394d4d35.description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?

The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus 14 Council Scrip as thanks.

- Stows
c980057a-d5da-4c8e-8f12-1d53394d4d35.descriptionCn:
最近针对猎头帮飞船的袭击变多了，这让我感到不安。有批重要补给物资经不起闪失，得找人探路清场——我标了几个要是我就肯定会埋伏的点。

从你 HUD 上的位置标记开始扫荡，完事再发你下个坐标。听说这些地方最近总有杂碎晃悠，所以带上个朋友掩护你是个明智的选择。

只要你把这事办成，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

- 斯托斯

deeadc0e-5d60-4436-bd2a-0098ea14c865.title: Lost But Not Gone
deeadc0e-5d60-4436-bd2a-0098ea14c865.titleCn:
迷失但并未消失
[死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 ERT]
deeadc0e-5d60-4436-bd2a-0098ea14c865.description:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at [LOCATION].

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a heavy-duty tractor beam to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch
deeadc0e-5d60-4436-bd2a-0098ea14c865.descriptionCn:
一帮对手摸清了我的送货路线，现在他们把我的一艘货船围在 [LOCATION] 了。

那帮混蛋全守着船，肯定在等谁派运输船去接货，所以你得赶在他们前面到。

带齐你的兄弟过去，再拎上重型牵引光束，直接把货抢回来，别像我把他们当软柿子。

干掉他们，把货送回 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，我保证让你赚翻。

- 刺痛

b2acdd21-9002-40a2-a736-6c20981711e6.title: Lost But Not Gone
b2acdd21-9002-40a2-a736-6c20981711e6.titleCn:

880a9c42-35e4-4fe6-8110-c804e657b826.title: Luminalia Present Delivery
880a9c42-35e4-4fe6-8110-c804e657b826.description:
Happy Luminalia!

I have a huge favor to ask. Thanks to some very ill timed maintenance issues, my ship is out of commission for at least a week and I won't be able to finish delivering presents to everyone on my gift list.

Looked into using FTL but with their holiday pricing I'll end up paying more credits than what the gifts cost!

Figured I would see if you're interested in helping me out. I get my gifts delivered on time and you get some extra Luminalia spending credits.

The gifts are wrapped and waiting at [LOCATION]. [DESCRIPTIONSETUP].

Thanks in advance and may your light glow a little brighter this year!

Sincerely,
[GIFTSENDER]
880a9c42-35e4-4fe6-8110-c804e657b826.descriptionCn:
光灯节快乐！

我要你帮个大忙。我的船因为一些很不凑巧的维护问题，至少有一个星期不能飞，这搞得我没法给名单上的人送礼物了。

我想过叫超光速快递，但根据他们的假日定价，我花在物流上的钱比礼物本身还高!

我想看看你是否有兴趣帮我。我的礼物会按时送到，而你会得到额外的光灯节奖励。

礼物都包好了，放在 [LOCATION] 等你了。[DESCRIPTIONSETUP]。

在此先感谢你，并希望今年你的灯光更加明亮！

此致，
[GIFTSENDER]

5dec704a-de79-4311-88d1-53f9d05db952.titleCn:
做一个大熊座改款
[兑换 - 大熊座 医疗 维科洛版]
5dec704a-de79-4311-88d1-53f9d05db952.description: Wikelo branching into ships too. Took a look at Ursa and improved. Bring parts for me and I will make for you. Explore planet better. Go do.
5dec704a-de79-4311-88d1-53f9d05db952.descriptionCn: 维科洛也有涉足飞船领域。看看大熊座，进步了。给我拿零件来，我给你做。更好地探索星球。去做。

12926a62-afde-4984-8887-dbe564527192.title: Make ATLS shoot
12926a62-afde-4984-8887-dbe564527192.titleCn:
让 ATLS 能射击
[兑换 - ATLS IKTI]
12926a62-afde-4984-8887-dbe564527192.description:
Hello. Know you human like strange metal suit. How about metal suit with ikti? Sorry, ikti is Banu word, you call it 'gun.'

If want, bring things I say and I will make for you. Gun will shoot. Cause many damage.

Bye.
12926a62-afde-4984-8887-dbe564527192.descriptionCn:
你好。我知道你们人类喜欢奇怪的金属动力服。那么带 ikti 的金属动力服怎么样？抱歉，ikti 是巴努语，你可以叫他“枪”。

如果你想要的话，把我说的东西带来，我会为你制作。枪可以射击，造成很多伤害。

再见。

b4a0ba2d-a5f6-496b-bc04-5f0bce49067a.title: Make glowy armor
b4a0ba2d-a5f6-496b-bc04-5f0bce49067a.titleCn:
制作发光的护甲
[兑换 - 阿纳护甲 辐照]
b4a0ba2d-a5f6-496b-bc04-5f0bce49067a.description:
Wikelo had exciting idea during brief work rest. Was thinking about the little glow worms in Pyro and saw armor get changed to look like.

If you get me parts, bring to [DESTINATIONS] and will make for you then you can glow too.

Bye.
b4a0ba2d-a5f6-496b-bc04-5f0bce49067a.descriptionCn:
维科洛在短暂的工作休息中，有令人兴奋的想法。是在想派罗里的小蠕虫，并看到护甲被改造成看起来像它。

如果你给我零件，带到 [DESTINATIONS] 然后我将为你制作成这样。你也能发光。

再见。

7b7cd8d9-d3e4-4f48-b995-487933fd332e.title: Make jumpy ATLS shoot
7b7cd8d9-d3e4-4f48-b995-487933fd332e.titleCn:
让 ATLS 能跳又能射
[兑换 - ATLS GEO IKTI]
7b7cd8d9-d3e4-4f48-b995-487933fd332e.description:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to [DESTINATIONS]. Will make.

Wikelo
7b7cd8d9-d3e4-4f48-b995-487933fd332e.descriptionCn:
找到一个非常有趣的部件，可以装在大型人类动力服上，让你跳得非常高。现在你能射击又能跳了。令人兴奋。

如果你想要，把这些东西带来 [DESTINATIONS] 给我。我会制作。

维科洛

e404f6c6-997d-4195-8e48-1a8f859398c9.title: Make VOLT shotgun angrier
e404f6c6-997d-4195-8e48-1a8f859398c9.titleCn:
让 VOLT 霰弹枪更愤怒
[兑换 - 棱镜 “辐照” 激光霰弹枪]
e404f6c6-997d-4195-8e48-1a8f859398c9.description:
You feel like gun not angry enough? VOLT shotgun very powerful, very dangerous, but not scary? Bring to me. Can make very scary and angry.

They respect you then. Bring to [DESTINATIONS] and we make.

Bye.
e404f6c6-997d-4195-8e48-1a8f859398c9.descriptionCn:
你感觉枪不够愤怒吗？VOLT 霰弹枪非常强大非常危险但是不可怕？带来给我。能做得很可怕和愤怒。

他们就会尊敬你。带到 [DESTINATIONS] 然后我们制作。

再见。

4017b0a8-acc9-46c1-8168-94bfab7debdc.title: Making the Most of a Bad Situation
4017b0a8-acc9-46c1-8168-94bfab7debdc.titleCn:
充分利用糟糕处境
[死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 HRT]
4017b0a8-acc9-46c1-8168-94bfab7debdc.description:
Just got a comm from the pilot who was transporting some gear for me and it sounded like they got jumped while on the call. I need someone to head to their location, grab the four packages that are still left inside their ship and bring them back to me.

Before they cut out, they told me that the ships that attacked them weren’t your standard transporters. These assholes are rocking some serious weaponry. Bring a crew, get my shit, and take it to [DESTINATION]. This whole thing is such a mess that I’d be willing to fork out some extra creds if you can get this done.

-Twitch
4017b0a8-acc9-46c1-8168-94bfab7debdc.descriptionCn:
我刚收到那个为我运输装备的飞行员的消息，听起来他们在执行任务时遭遇了袭击。我需要派人去他们的位置，把他们飞船里剩下的四个包裹拿回来带给我。

在他们通讯中断之前，他们告诉我袭击他们的飞船不是普通的运输船。那些混蛋配备了非常厉害的武器。带上一个团队，把我的东西拿回来，然后送到 [DESTINATION]。整个情况太混乱了，如果你们能完成这个任务，我愿意多付一些报酬。

-刺痛

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
- [LOCATION 4]

And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

72ce1dd9-475b-43cb-bba3-14acbb6ce666.title: Mjr. Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
72ce1dd9-475b-43cb-bba3-14acbb6ce666.titleCn: 主要采购订单：飞船开采矿石
72ce1dd9-475b-43cb-bba3-14acbb6ce666.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
72ce1dd9-475b-43cb-bba3-14acbb6ce666.descriptionCn:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM]

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[MULTITOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

3a776eaa-5f22-41d3-954b-ca17858aae60.title: Moderate Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
3a776eaa-5f22-41d3-954b-ca17858aae60.description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit [LOCATION] which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
3a776eaa-5f22-41d3-954b-ca17858aae60.descriptionCn:
您好，

我们获知 [LOCATION] 遭遇了破坏性风暴，导致建筑结构受损。现场技术人员仍在评估可修复范围，但无法处理全部问题。若您能携带 六个保险丝、一个 打捞工具 以及 足够修复约五根管道的 RMC 罐，我们就能完成剩余维修工作。

如需了解更多维修细节，请查阅 mobiGlas 日志中的 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

f6f93348-d833-44d5-9f52-0c6d0b75bdfb.description:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to [LOCATION] with the required supplies and perform some repairs.

As it stands, you’ll need six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so. That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

99b90562-4e98-46d2-aa7e-0926bed3bdf8.title: More than a Max
99b90562-4e98-46d2-aa7e-0926bed3bdf8.titleCn:
不仅仅是 MAX
[兑换 - 星际枪骑兵 MAX 维科洛工作版]
99b90562-4e98-46d2-aa7e-0926bed3bdf8.description: If you want to move many things. Hercules ship, very good for that. Wikelo even know souli back in Protectorate that started to use. Very big. Wikelo can give you similar version if you get what Wikelo need. Look at list and tell me.
99b90562-4e98-46d2-aa7e-0926bed3bdf8.descriptionCn: 如果你想移动很多东西。大力神飞船，非常适合。维基洛甚至知道商会早在保护国就开始使用了。非常大。如果你给维科洛需要的东西，维科洛就可以给你类似的版本。看看清单，然后告诉我。

3c839c32-d313-4c13-ade0-eb45b5bdea4b.title: Most Special Wolf
3c839c32-d313-4c13-ade0-eb45b5bdea4b.titleCn:
最特别的狼
[兑换 - 狼式 维科洛战争版]
3c839c32-d313-4c13-ade0-eb45b5bdea4b.description: You have been good trade partner for Wikelo. Offer you this very special Wolf mod. Make trade even better - Bring me what I want and I give you the special Wolf AND Antium Armor AND a VOLT LMG. Very good deal for my very good customer.
3c839c32-d313-4c13-ade0-eb45b5bdea4b.descriptionCn: 你一直是维科洛很好的贸易伙伴。给你这个非常特别的狼式改款。让交易更划算 - 带齐我想要的东西，我就给你特别的狼式改款和安腾护甲和一把 VOLT 轻机枪。非常好的交易给我非常好的顾客。

cfac6492-3deb-48c7-9346-6bdbe4dc63d2.title: My Deepest Condolences
cfac6492-3deb-48c7-9346-6bdbe4dc63d2.titleCn:
我最深切的哀悼
[沃恩 - 寻找尸体 MRT]
cfac6492-3deb-48c7-9346-6bdbe4dc63d2.description:
Whilst we pride ourselves on our efficiency and general cleanliness when it comes to our work, sometimes our contractors can get a little carried away themselves. Circumstances surrounding a former contractor’s death, and more importantly, the target, are somewhat unclear to us.

We’ll need you to travel to [LOCATION] and locate [TARGET]’s body so we can deliver clear confirmation to our client. As for the former contractor… you needn’t concern yourself with them. Arrangements for disposal have already been made.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
cfac6492-3deb-48c7-9346-6bdbe4dc63d2.descriptionCn:
虽然我们在工作上以高效和干净著称，但有时候我们的承包商自己会有点失控。关于一位前承包商的死因，更重要的是目标的情况，我们目前还不太清楚。

我们需要你前往 [LOCATION] 找到 [TARGET] 的尸体，这样我们就能向客户给出明确的确认了。至于那位前承包商...你不用操心他们。处理事宜已经安排好了。

此致，
沃恩

6c4bd89b-9105-40db-b19e-038cecd41a51.description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named [TARGET]. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty.

Heard they're posted over at [LOCATION]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.
6c4bd89b-9105-40db-b19e-038cecd41a51.descriptionCn:
需要一位有空的抢手来对付位于繁荣公民前哨站的目标。他们是个真正的混蛋，名叫 [TARGET]。老派佣兵，心狠手辣。

听说他们驻扎在 [LOCATION]。过去把他们解决掉。尽量不要造成太多损失，目标是他，而不是其他人。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

Heard they're posted over at [LOCATION]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

adb9586c-4c26-465f-a6a2-bc97af16eedb.title: Need a Hauler
adb9586c-4c26-465f-a6a2-bc97af16eedb.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle 4 SCU cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
adb9586c-4c26-465f-a6a2-bc97af16eedb.descriptionCn:
嗨，我们需要在星系中运输一些物资，想知道你是否能帮忙。我知道这超出了你通常的职责范围，但我现在选择不多。这也是一个很好的机会，展示你对繁荣公民更大使命的承诺。

如果你前往 [LOCATION]，应该能通过一个货运电梯找到一些可用的物资，我们需要你把它们送到 [DESTINATION] 的另一个货运电梯。

唯一需要注意事情就是，你的飞船必须能够处理 [MAX_SCU] 的货物集装箱。为了省点事，你最好随身带个手持式牵引光束。这应该是一次简单的运输。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

34ed9d72-d537-418a-b0f1-35a19401acb7.title: Need a hitter
34ed9d72-d537-418a-b0f1-35a19401acb7.description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
34ed9d72-d537-418a-b0f1-35a19401acb7.descriptionCn:
事情是这样的，我们有一些小混球，觉得自己很了不起，正在 [LOCATION] 附近的一个基地里活动。我不知道他们喝了什么毒东西，搞得他们以为去招惹猎头帮飞船是个好主意。杀了一个，伤了三个。所以我想派人去把他们的雄心彻底打掉。

去把他们干掉，你会得到一笔丰厚的奖励。

- 斯托斯

c18a747a-ba1e-4946-bf9a-be7d5290ed52.title: Need multiple CFP outposts retaken
c18a747a-ba1e-4946-bf9a-be7d5290ed52.titleCn: 需要夺回多个繁荣公民前哨站
c18a747a-ba1e-4946-bf9a-be7d5290ed52.description:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around [LOCATION]. While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.

We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by [TARGET] who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like [TARGET] dealt with to prevent future attacks.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
c18a747a-ba1e-4946-bf9a-be7d5290ed52.descriptionCn:
这里的不法分子最近变得更加猖獗，很多人都受到了伤害。我们最近在 [LOCATION] 附近失去了几个集群。虽然我们不想诉诸暴力，但董事会已经承认这些地点对在星系中建立稳定至关重要，并授权使用安全小组来夺回它们。

我们也意识到，现场的敌对人员是由 [TARGET] 领导的，他有攻击繁荣公民权益的历史。堂会希望能解决 [TARGET] 的问题，以防止未来的攻击。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

0137aa6a-c647-4e30-92d5-5bd91acbd270.title: Need Resource for Research
0137aa6a-c647-4e30-92d5-5bd91acbd270.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
0137aa6a-c647-4e30-92d5-5bd91acbd270.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们在 [DESTINATION] 的研究团队正在不懈努力解决当前的“再生危机”，处理不稳定印记的问题。他们的工作取得了可喜的成果，但缺少的一项关键资源阻碍了他们进行进一步实验的能力。

我们从供应商那里得知，由于需求的增加和采矿的产量下降，我们将无法在接下来的几个月内收到预定的货物。我们的研究团队等不及那么久，我们希望您能提供帮助。

这种资源难以获得，但我们有可靠消息称，旧哈索尔采矿设施建造在资源浓度较高的区域。由于哈索尔在建立其系统内的运营后不久就停业，因此激活其中一个采矿激光器很可能能为我们提供所需的资源。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

feae9712-e48a-47a8-ad31-c7f8868935f8.title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
feae9712-e48a-47a8-ad31-c7f8868935f8.titleCn:
瓦解危险的罪犯舰队
[繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 HRT 多波次]
feae9712-e48a-47a8-ad31-c7f8868935f8.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
feae9712-e48a-47a8-ad31-c7f8868935f8.descriptionCn:
一支罪犯舰队已在繁荣公民正着力开发的星区扎根，其暴力行径已致使所有前进步伐都停滞了。为保障长期战略目标，我们必须在事态进一步恶化前设法彻底瓦解这支舰队。

你及你最信赖的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对目标。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

0227bf5e-0f06-4a91-89f5-8e49021b27c7.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0227bf5e-0f06-4a91-89f5-8e49021b27c7.descriptionCn:
一支罪犯舰队已在繁荣公民正着力开发的星区扎根，其暴力行径已致使所有前进步伐都停滞了。为保障长期战略目标，我们必须在事态进一步恶化前设法彻底瓦解这支舰队。

你及你最信赖的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对目标。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: Seemingly unsatisfied with their takings in Nyx, an outlaw group lead by [TARGET] has been planning a major strike against the UEE. This cannot be allowed to come to pass.

Thanks to the work of our Intelligence team, we've been able to track them down to [LOCATION].

Head there as soon as you can and engage before they have a chance to leave the system. Based on our strategic analysis, we recommend a well-armed and skilled fleet will be necessary for the successful completion of this mission.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

[霍克罗 - 寻找尸体 入门]
aa5a2f0c-a578-4061-a792-2b93e74bb2bc.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP38100
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Hockrow Agency is looking for new contractors with a strong stomach and familiarity with dangerous situations to handle the legwork of an active missing persons investigation.

Reports indicate that it is highly unlikely that you will encounter any hostiles.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION], search for [TARGET], and confirm their status. If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Successful completion of this task will open up other employment opportunities within Hockrow Agency.
aa5a2f0c-a578-4061-a792-2b93e74bb2bc.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP38100
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

霍克罗事务所正在寻找具有较强心理承受能力且熟悉危险情况的新承包商，以处理这起正在进行的失踪人员调查的实地工作。

报告显示，你遇到敌对势力的可能性非常低。

e25f601a-6734-4703-944c-69991778367d.titleCn:
新机会 - 埋伏突袭
[埃克哈特 - 伏击 入门]
e25f601a-6734-4703-944c-69991778367d.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re looking for contractors with combat experience who are willing to get their hands dirty so to speak. A client of ours was double-crossed by a [TARGET] and we’ve been waiting for an opportunity to deal with the issue. After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified [LOCATION] as the ideal spot to intercept them. It features an emission cloud where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting for the [TARGET].

Intel suggests that they may travel with an escort. If they do, you’ll have to deal with them too. Since this is your first contract, we will have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
e25f601a-6734-4703-944c-69991778367d.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：飞船伏击
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们正在寻找有战斗经验，并愿意亲自动手解决问题的承包商。我们的一个客户被 [TARGET] 欺骗了，我们一直在寻找机会处理这个问题。经过几周的追踪，我们确定 [LOCATION] 是拦截他们的理想地点。那里有一片辐射云，你可以躲在里面并关闭飞船的引擎，等待 [TARGET] 的出现。

情报显示他们可能会带着护航舰队出行。如果他们真的有，你也得一并应对他们。因为这是你的第一份合约，所以一旦你开始行动，我们也会在附近安排其他承包商提供支援。

合约完成后立即付款。主承包商还能获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的额外奖励。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

1c417c3a-03d3-40df-9950-fc5f150f3328.title: No Fly Zone
1c417c3a-03d3-40df-9950-fc5f150f3328.titleCn:
禁飞区
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 LRT]
1c417c3a-03d3-40df-9950-fc5f150f3328.description:
Some competition has taken root at [LOCATION] and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out
1c417c3a-03d3-40df-9950-fc5f150f3328.descriptionCn:
在 [LOCATION] 出现了一些竞争者，他们真的让我们在这个区域的操作变得很麻烦。

我心里有一部分看到了这些新人的潜力，希望能够把他们拉入我们的圈子，但同时，我也不能让他们四处飞来飞去惹麻烦。

所以我想让你去炸掉他们的燃料罐。这应该能让他们被迫停下来，给我时间去劝说他们的脑袋冷静下来。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

eb1cc349-e772-4171-b743-57c818f33f8d.title: No Honor Amongst Assassins
eb1cc349-e772-4171-b743-57c818f33f8d.titleCn:
身为刺客毫无荣誉我最深切的哀悼
[沃恩 - 寻找尸体 ERT]
eb1cc349-e772-4171-b743-57c818f33f8d.description:
I have a very specific task that requires my best people.

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at [LOCATION]. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.

I need you to head to the location and identify that [TARGET] is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
eb1cc349-e772-4171-b743-57c818f33f8d.descriptionCn:
我有一个非常具体的任务，需要我最得力的人来完成。

好像在 [LOCATION] 那边发生了一些不寻常的事情。我们的一位承包商完成任务后似乎变得叛变了，拒绝跟我们沟通，还无差别地攻击遇到的任何人。现在，我有其他办法对付这些叛变的人，但我们的客户仍然需要确认原来目标已经死了，而由于这个飞行员的存在，我们无法提供这种确认。

我需要你去那个地点，确认 [TARGET] 确实已经死了，最好是在这位前不满的承包商摧毁他之前。作为善意提醒，他们是我们在职员工中最彻底、最无情的一个，所以必须格外小心。你最好带上最能干的盟友来支持你。

此致，
沃恩

e05b8ffb-7455-4f24-bbcf-43e9dffc0cca.description:
Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship.

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bring to [DESTINATIONS] if want.

Bye.
e05b8ffb-7455-4f24-bbcf-43e9dffc0cca.descriptionCn:
维科洛最近和一个不太聪明的人类做了交易，拿到了很多蓝图。现在可以造很大的船。

不便宜。而且需要很多零件。但我们会造出来。如果你想要，就快点。这对维科洛来说成本很高，所以不能持续太久。但我喜欢新的人类星系，所以想感谢你们的欢迎。

如果想要，就带到 [DESTINATIONS]。

再见。

a033aab9-262e-44da-9213-35e225fc828a.title: Noxy Mod
a033aab9-262e-44da-9213-35e225fc828a.titleCn:
Nox 改款
[兑换 - Nox 维科洛版]
a033aab9-262e-44da-9213-35e225fc828a.description: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.
a033aab9-262e-44da-9213-35e225fc828a.descriptionCn: 维科洛认识好多希安人。你有耐心的话。他们说话很慢，但很有意思。这个小东西快快的，带你跑遍星球。维科洛做了改动，它更快了。你要是想要，维科洛给你做一个。再见。

560b8ff4-a3a8-4b23-ab2d-637da1b594c2.title: Obtain Irradiated Valakkar Pearls
560b8ff4-a3a8-4b23-ab2d-637da1b594c2.titleCn: 获取受辐射的瓦拉卡珍珠
560b8ff4-a3a8-4b23-ab2d-637da1b594c2.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar pearls, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION]. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls.

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
560b8ff4-a3a8-4b23-ab2d-637da1b594c2.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正在不遗余力地阻止当前的再生危机，但我们的科学家需要一种罕见的资源，而公司供应商无法获取这种资源。

拉亚利正在寻找有经验的承包商来收集 受辐射的瓦拉卡珍珠，这些珍珠可以从长期暴露在辐射下的成年瓦拉卡体内提取。我们的扫描发现，在靠近 [LOCATION] 的风暴中有一批符合条件的种群。因为这些动物极其危险，拉亚利准备慷慨地补偿任何能够协助收集珍珠的人。

一旦收集完成，请将这些珍贵的资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

2b4a7a21-7932-4304-8e10-1d2026300271.title: Operative Extraction
2b4a7a21-7932-4304-8e10-1d2026300271.titleCn:
人员撤离
[互安防务 - 保卫飞船 MRT]
2b4a7a21-7932-4304-8e10-1d2026300271.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: An undercover agent of ours was compromised and is now being pursued by the outlaw pack they had infiltrated. As such, they are in need of immediate extraction at [LOCATION].

Once on site, engage with all hostiles in order to provide cover so our operative can QT away.

Bring additional backup and don't underestimate these outlaws. They are violent and motivated so they are unlikely to give up anytime soon.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
2b4a7a21-7932-4304-8e10-1d2026300271.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：我们的一名卧底特工身份暴露了，现在正被他们渗透的不法分子团伙追捕。因此，他们急需撤离 [LOCATION]。

一抵达现场，就与现场所有的敌对目标交战，为我们的人争取量子航行离开的时间。

带上额外的支援，别小看这些不法分子。他们非常暴力且目标明确，所以不太可能轻易放弃。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

d483b415-717e-4643-bcd5-e68f3eacd8bc.title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
d483b415-717e-4643-bcd5-e68f3eacd8bc.titleCn:
成为独立货运员的机会
[科瓦莱什 - 货运 入门]
d483b415-717e-4643-bcd5-e68f3eacd8bc.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of [ITEM] from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
d483b415-717e-4643-bcd5-e68f3eacd8bc.descriptionCn:
摘得“帝国金融Top10航运公司”和“投递领域2945最值得信赖的运输”等荣誉后，科瓦莱什比以往都更加繁忙。这意味着更多的货物将运往更多的地方，这就是需要你发挥作用的地方。

科瓦莱什正在寻找可靠且勤奋的飞行员加入我们不断壮大的家庭。你有能装载尺寸为 [MAX_SCU] 的集装箱货物的飞船吗？如果需要，你能通过督导局的背景调查吗？那么，一个充满机会的宇宙正在等着你。

从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯里取出 [[ITEM]] 并把它成功送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，即可完成“试用评估”。

圆满完成后，你将有资格成为拥有庞大的运输网络的科瓦莱什货运专员。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。


科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

dba10330-cde8-4e2b-8d2e-7614bbdc5bc6.title: Orange Level Contract: [SHIP] Needs Assistance
dba10330-cde8-4e2b-8d2e-7614bbdc5bc6.titleCn: 橙色级别合约：[SHIP] 需要援助
dba10330-cde8-4e2b-8d2e-7614bbdc5bc6.description:
Got an orange level contract for any available combat pilots. A [SHIP] is under attack around [LOCATION] and is in desperate need for assistance. We're not sure how many perpetrators there are, but they seem motivated and dangerous so exercise caution.

Once on site, engage and destroy any hostiles you encounter and protect the client. Once they've transferred the credits, we'll route you your payment.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
dba10330-cde8-4e2b-8d2e-7614bbdc5bc6.descriptionCn:
这有一份橙色级别的合约提供给任何有空的战斗飞行员。一艘 [SHIP] 在 [LOCATION] 附近遭到攻击，急需支援。我们不确定有多少不法分子，但似乎他们的动机明确且非常危险，因此请务必小心。

到达现场后，攻击并摧毁你遇到的任何敌对目标，保护客户。一旦他们转账了费用，我们会将你的报酬转给你。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

5365d562-a6c2-4bb4-af8e-346cf3430b62.title: Orange Level Contract: Destroy Outlaw Infrastructure
5365d562-a6c2-4bb4-af8e-346cf3430b62.titleCn:
橙色级别合约：摧毁非法基础设施
[福克斯韦尔 - 轰炸 HRT]
5365d562-a6c2-4bb4-af8e-346cf3430b62.description:
An opportunity has presented itself for a client to take action against a group of criminals who have been harassing their business.

According to reports, this group of outlaws are currently laying low at [LOCATION]. The client thinks this is a good time to catch them off guard and bring them to justice. The job is to take out their fuel tanks and putting an end to their smuggling operations once and for all.

These folks are not to be underestimated. You better bring some backup and fly low to avoid the turrets. Priority as always is the fuel tanks.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
5365d562-a6c2-4bb4-af8e-346cf3430b62.descriptionCn:
客户迎来一次良机，可对长期骚扰其生意的一伙罪犯采取行动。

据情报显示，这群不法分子目前正蛰伏于 [LOCATION]。客户认为眼下正是出其不意、将其绳之以法的绝佳时机。任务目标是摧毁其燃料罐，彻底终结他们的走私活动。

切勿轻敌，务必携带支援力量，并低空飞行以规避炮塔火力。一如往常，燃料罐始终是最高优先级目标。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

30166c56-392f-4090-91ae-189a538275d5.title: Orange Level Contract: Destroy Outlaw Threat
30166c56-392f-4090-91ae-189a538275d5.titleCn:
橙色级别合约：铲除不法分子威胁
[福克斯韦尔 - 击杀飞船 MRT 多波次]
30166c56-392f-4090-91ae-189a538275d5.description:
A splinter group of outlaws have broken off from one of the main gangs in the system and have been trying to strike out on their own. With the amount of trouble they've been causing its clear they're looking to establish a name for themselves as quickly as they can. It's going to be up to you and your support crew to put a stop to them.

Once your crew is ready, head over to [LOCATION] and engage with the gang. Not all of them will just be waiting there on site. Expect reinforcements to arrive once you begin your assault. Just be sure to stay until every last one of them has been take care of.

Good luck,

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives."
30166c56-392f-4090-91ae-189a538275d5.descriptionCn:
星系里从某大帮派分裂出来的一支不法分子，最近单干闹事，想尽快打出点名堂来。看他们惹的乱子就知道，这帮人急着立威。现在就靠你和你的支援团队把他们摁下去了。

等你们团队准备好了，直接去 [LOCATION] 找上那帮人开干。并不是所有的人都会在那里等着，等你一动手，援军就会到达。一定要待在这里，直到他们都被解决掉。

祝你好运，

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

9ef512ad-9832-4fa9-bad7-60e99268df74.title: Orange Level Contract: Handle Security Threat
9ef512ad-9832-4fa9-bad7-60e99268df74.titleCn:
橙色级别合约：处理安全威胁
[福克斯韦尔 - 摧毁监视器 MRT]
9ef512ad-9832-4fa9-bad7-60e99268df74.description:
After a contractor successfully recovered data stolen from one of our clients, a security analyst verified that it was captured by unauthorized surveillance monitors illegally installed around [LOCATION]. We’re looking for someone to follow up and take out those monitors.

You will need to find the [MONITOR_COUNT] and destroy them before any more data can be gathered. Passive 'Skimmers' like these typically are hard to find so be thorough in your search.

Once attacked, their security protocols will cause them to begin transmitting the contents of their drives, so it’s imperative that you stop the upload before it can complete. There’s also a good chance that whoever’s responsible might be in the area, so be careful.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
9ef512ad-9832-4fa9-bad7-60e99268df74.descriptionCn:
在承包商成功回收了我们客户被窃取的数据后，安全分析师确认，这些数据是通过非法安装在 [LOCATION] 周边未经授权的监视器截获的。我们需要有人跟进并清除这些监视器。

你必须找到 [MONITOR_COUNT] 个监视器，并在更多数据被窃取前将其摧毁。这类被动式“数据窃取器”通常极难发现，搜索时务必仔细彻底。

一旦遭到攻击，它们的安全协议会立即启动，开始传输硬盘内容，因此你必须在上传完成前彻底阻止。此外，极有可能幕后黑手就在附近，务必小心行事。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

62f48881-77c5-42ff-9acb-119d2a2db812.title: Orange Level Contract: Potential Security Threat
62f48881-77c5-42ff-9acb-119d2a2db812.titleCn: 橙色级别合约：潜在安全威胁
62f48881-77c5-42ff-9acb-119d2a2db812.description:
Several unknown ships have been spotted in areas frequented by haulers delivering goods for our client. They’re worried these ships are monitoring their haulers in preparation for an ambush, so they’ve hired us to patrol the area.

Start by going to the location marker on your HUD and scan it to ensure it’s clear. After that, we’ll send you to some other areas to scan for potential threats. We recommend that you bring a wingman and plenty of supplies to be ready to handle whatever might come your way.

Also know that successfully completing this contract will earn the main contractor a bonus payment of 14 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
62f48881-77c5-42ff-9acb-119d2a2db812.descriptionCn:
我们客户的货运飞船经常光顾的区域发现了几艘不明飞船。客户担心这些飞船正在踩点准备打劫，所以雇我们来巡逻这片空域。

先去在你 HUD 上的地点标记扫描确认是否安全。之后，我们会派你去其他区域扫描潜在威胁。我们建议你带上一名僚机和充足的物资，以便应对任何可能出现的情况。

同时请注意，成功完成这份合约将使主承包商获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

82414003-38be-42d6-ba61-5d9d96e2f86a.titleCn: 橙色级别合约：潜在安全威胁

6e8b61d3-a08a-4f8e-aa61-0a84b6e35754.description:
Recently, a [TARGET] baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at [LOCATION] that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?

It’ll be you against the [TARGET], other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

我们的监视显示这支小队有一个规律的飞行路线，我们认为可以加以利用。在 [LOCATION] 处有一片巨大的辐射云，非常适合我们设伏。你觉得自己能处理好这一切吗？

这将是你对抗 [TARGET]、其他大型飞船和一支庞大的护航队。真希望我能提供更具体的信息，但这支队伍经常轮换飞船。最好带上点支援，以免被他们的人数压倒。

[福克斯韦尔 - 保护可摧毁实体 HRT]
31d2d60e-aa5f-4c43-b39b-caf3195b67a7.description:
One of our high priority clients is under attack from a criminal gang targeting their [OBJECTS] in [LOCATION]. The client’s assets are valuable, so we need to keep those safe at all costs, but I won’t kid – it’ll be a challenge and a half with these thugs determined to do some real damage.

If it were me, I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. They’re no joke, so we’re offering a well-earned 6 MG Scrip to the main contractor who deals with these guys successfully.

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

31d2d60e-aa5f-4c43-b39b-caf3195b67a7.descriptionCn:

换作是我的话我绝不犹豫，会立刻 呼叫增援 来对付他们。这些人可不是好惹的，因此，若主承包商能成功解决这些麻烦，我们将向其提供一份实至名归的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为报酬。

8c9b2f0e-6dae-4e6d-a3ab-b414eeec9861.title: Our Version of The Truth
8c9b2f0e-6dae-4e6d-a3ab-b414eeec9861.titleCn:
咱们版本的真相
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 VHRT]
8c9b2f0e-6dae-4e6d-a3ab-b414eeec9861.description:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at [DESTINATION].

-Bit Zeros
8c9b2f0e-6dae-4e6d-a3ab-b414eeec9861.descriptionCn:
我就不跟你说这王八蛋对咱们干过啥了，反正关键是这个混蛋想通过飞船坠毁去骗保，保险公司想看黑匣子录像来确认一切是不是“光明正大”的。

我们肯定不能让这事儿发生。

去 [LOCATION] 把黑匣子抢出来，给我们送到这儿来，我们好对录像做点“创意编辑”。

话说这片区域有点危险，估计也是他们选这儿策划事故的原因。你最好带上几个帮手，别还没把黑匣子运到 [DESTINATION] 给咱们就被人整没了。

- 零比特

9277c342-efc1-4b6c-9919-4bf7343b96d9.title: Our Version of The Truth
9277c342-efc1-4b6c-9919-4bf7343b96d9.titleCn:

ddc816b2-f3ee-4a0e-903a-385bb8eb3f0c.title: Outlaw attack at [LOCATION]
ddc816b2-f3ee-4a0e-903a-385bb8eb3f0c.description:
Several CFP clusters near [LOCATION] just got hit by a group of outlaws led by [TARGET]. We're looking for any available combat specialists to help retake the outposts.

I can provide the locations upon acceptance but we need to clear out the main outpost and satellite installations from all hostile forces and take out [TARGET] as it's unlikely that they will not cease their hostilities if they escape.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
ddc816b2-f3ee-4a0e-903a-385bb8eb3f0c.descriptionCn:
我们在 [LOCATION] 附近的几个繁荣公民前哨站集群刚刚遭到由 [TARGET] 领导的一群不法分子的袭击。我们正在寻找任何有空的作战专家来帮助夺回这些前哨站。

我可以在接受合约后提供具体位置，我们需要清除主要前哨站和卫星设施中的所有敌对力量，并消灭 [TARGET]，因为他们不太可能在逃脱之后就停止敌对行动。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

9b29e05d-5931-46cd-b5a6-029801d4aad7.title: Outsmarting our Enemies
9b29e05d-5931-46cd-b5a6-029801d4aad7.titleCn:
智取敌人
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 ERT]
9b29e05d-5931-46cd-b5a6-029801d4aad7.description:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at [LOCATION]. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out
9b29e05d-5931-46cd-b5a6-029801d4aad7.descriptionCn:
我们听说一伙新帮派正计划进攻 [LOCATION] 那块地方。他们盘算着只要端掉那里的燃料补给，那地儿就归他们了。

但他们不知道的是，我们要先派你去把那些油罐炸了，好在他们动手前把地盘占下来。要是按计划行事，咱们既能清空那块地，又能顺便给那帮混蛋点颜色看看，一举两得。

唯一的麻烦是那儿武装到了牙齿。带上一个团队去把那些燃料罐搞定，剩下的交给我们。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

c30907e2-b089-4788-940d-e3cabe2f363d.title: Paid Target in CFP
c30907e2-b089-4788-940d-e3cabe2f363d.titleCn: 繁荣公民里的付费目标
c30907e2-b089-4788-940d-e3cabe2f363d.description:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [LOCATION]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TARGET] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TARGET] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TARGET] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows
c30907e2-b089-4788-940d-e3cabe2f363d.descriptionCn:
猎头帮正在 [LOCATION] 附近发起攻击。如果那里的人不投降交出武器的话，一个名叫 [TARGET] 的前海军陆战队混蛋一直在派遣他的雇佣兵去清除那边的营地。

虽然所有的安保措施都已获批，但 [TARGET] 被特别点名。在他们的最后一次突袭中，他们把一个无家可归者打死了，因为那人顶嘴。结果发现那个无家可归者是我们一个小组成员的表亲，所以他们愿意额外支付，以确保正义得以伸张。

不过要小心，[TARGET] 可能是个该得报应的混蛋，但他们毕竟是前军人，所以不容易对付。

- 斯托斯

dbcff4e6-8038-4252-b339-a6e60646d238.title: Patrol Dangerous Outlaw Sector
dbcff4e6-8038-4252-b339-a6e60646d238.titleCn:
巡逻危险的非法区域
[繁荣公民 - 巡逻 VHRT]
dbcff4e6-8038-4252-b339-a6e60646d238.description:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least two wingmen to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 18 MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
dbcff4e6-8038-4252-b339-a6e60646d238.descriptionCn:
我们盯上了一片最近老被不法分子袭击的星域，我觉得只要咱们主动去巡逻，局势就能扭转回来。建议你拉上至少两个队友，都开上能打的船，碰上敌对势力直接干。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点扫一遍，确认安全。主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

5673cea0-752a-4c64-bbab-f313a5274cd9.title: Patrol Dangerous Sector
5673cea0-752a-4c64-bbab-f313a5274cd9.titleCn:
巡逻危险区域
[互安防务 - 巡逻 HRT]
5673cea0-752a-4c64-bbab-f313a5274cd9.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has received intelligence that outlaws are planning to launch an attack on a target within the UEE. In an effort to prevent this from happening, we need a contractor to patrol a sector we believe these outlaws are using to prepare for their attack.

Outlaw activity in this sector is higher than normal, so InterSec recommends that you bring backup. When ready, dispatch to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. Once you've confirmed that the entire sector is clear, the main contractor will receive a bonus of 14 MG Scrip.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
5673cea0-752a-4c64-bbab-f313a5274cd9.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安收到情报，不法分子正计划对 UEE 内的一个目标发动攻击。为了防止这种情况发生，我们需要一名承包商在该区域进行巡逻，我们认为这些不法分子正在该区域为攻击做准备。

该区域的不法分子活动比平时更为频繁，因此互安建议你带上支援。准备好后，前往 HUD 上的位置标记，并扫描路线上的各个点。一旦确认整个区域安全，主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的奖金。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

0dade7c4-f7ed-46ef-8620-f7244b72e174.title: Patrol Dangerous Travel Lanes
0dade7c4-f7ed-46ef-8620-f7244b72e174.titleCn:
巡逻危险航道
[繁荣公民 - 巡逻 MRT]
0dade7c4-f7ed-46ef-8620-f7244b72e174.description:
Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 8 MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0dade7c4-f7ed-46ef-8620-f7244b72e174.descriptionCn:
最近这条热门航线上不法分子越来越猖獗，咱们得赶紧去震慑一下，别等到事儿闹大了。你开艘能打的船过去，碰上敌对势力就直接干掉。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点都扫一遍。等全搞定，主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

aacbdcb7-1c1a-4754-8f37-d19841a2d02a.title: Patrol Extremely Dangerous Sector
aacbdcb7-1c1a-4754-8f37-d19841a2d02a.titleCn:
巡逻极端危险区域
[繁荣公民 - 巡逻 ERT]
aacbdcb7-1c1a-4754-8f37-d19841a2d02a.description:
After weeks of seeing crime rates increase, we’ve been able to identify a sector that we believe to be the source of the outlaw activity that has been leeching into the surrounding areas. While it would be too much to expect to eradicate all threats, we believe that by sending combat patrols into the area we might be able to start reversing this worrisome trend. Our in-house combat analysts recommend bringing around three wingmen in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 24 MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
aacbdcb7-1c1a-4754-8f37-d19841a2d02a.descriptionCn:
折腾了几个星期，总算摸清了那帮不法分子的老巢，就藏在最近闹得最凶的那片星域。想彻底清干净是没戏，但咱派巡逻队杀过去，也许能压一压这股邪风。我们内部的战斗分析员建议你带上三架僚机，开艘能硬刚的船以对抗你可能遇到的任何敌对势力。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点都扫一遍。等全搞定，主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

5efe71ac-6522-4819-9dce-107479eaf35b.description:

5efe71ac-6522-4819-9dce-107479eaf35b.descriptionCn:

接了这活儿之后，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点都扫一遍。等全搞定，主承包商会额外奖励 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

d41b2b5b-09e9-4aa0-adf2-0a430f8b29ce.titleCn:
巡逻高危航道
[繁荣公民 - 巡逻 LRT]
d41b2b5b-09e9-4aa0-adf2-0a430f8b29ce.description:
We’ve noted an increase in traffic along one of the travel lanes we monitor. Chances are that we won’t be the only ones paying attention. I’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and make sure there are no outlaws attempting to take advantage of this sense of security.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 4 MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
d41b2b5b-09e9-4aa0-adf2-0a430f8b29ce.descriptionCn:
我们注意到咱们监控的一条航线上最近船多了起来，八成不止咱们在盯。你开艘能打的船过去，看看有没有不法分子想趁机搞事。

afbd5caf-585e-4f1e-b357-afea66248852.title: Patrol to Prevent Possible Attack
afbd5caf-585e-4f1e-b357-afea66248852.titleCn:
巡逻以防范可能的袭击
[互安防务 - 巡逻 VHRT]
afbd5caf-585e-4f1e-b357-afea66248852.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been tracking increased outlaw activity in certain sectors of the system. This activity in conjunction with other intelligence leads us to believe that outlaws are planning an attack on elements traveling from the UEE. We're aiming to patrol these sectors and disrupt any plans before they can be put into action.

Currently, we need someone who can help patrol a highly dangerous sector. Once you've accepted the mission, you can proceed to the location marker on your HUD. From there, we'll send you along a specific route with additional waypoints to scan. Complete the patrol and we'll send the main contractor a bonus of 18 MG Scrip.

Due to the high probability of attack and general threat level of local outlaws, we recommend recruiting trusted wingmen to provide combat support.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
afbd5caf-585e-4f1e-b357-afea66248852.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安一直在追踪星系某些区域的不法分子活动有所增加。结合其他情报，我们认为这些不法分子正在策划对来自 UEE 的船只发动攻击。我们的目标是巡逻这些区域，在他们的计划实施之前予以破坏。

目前，我们需要有人协助巡逻一个危险性极高的区域。一旦你接受任务，就可以前往 HUD 上的位置标记。从那里，我们会为你提供一条包含多个检查点的具体路线。完成巡逻后，我们将向主承包商发放 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的奖励。

由于攻击的可能性很高且当地不法分子的威胁等级较高，我们建议招募可靠的僚机以提供战斗支援。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

ef629d5d-7439-4d6a-b373-aad9629117ee.title: Patrol Travel Lanes
ef629d5d-7439-4d6a-b373-aad9629117ee.titleCn:
巡逻航道
[繁荣公民 - 巡逻 VLRT]
ef629d5d-7439-4d6a-b373-aad9629117ee.description:
We need someone with combat experience to patrol a travel lane for us. Over the years, we’ve found that it's good to get out there and make ourselves visible. Sometimes a pilot like yourself traveling through an area is enough to deter any potential outlaws. But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of 2 MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
ef629d5d-7439-4d6a-b373-aad9629117ee.descriptionCn:
我们想找有实战经验的飞行员帮我们巡逻一条航路。这些年我们发现，只要有人在那儿来回溜达，就能吓退不少不法分子。当然，万一碰上几个胆子大的，还是建议你开艘能打的船去。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把所有航路点都扫一遍，确认路线安全。主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

c3fa11ea-d56f-4b04-a967-d90b65762f93.titleCn:
巡逻剜度狩猎场
[互安防务 - 巡逻 ERT]
c3fa11ea-d56f-4b04-a967-d90b65762f93.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: There's a growing concern that Vanduul hunting parties are pushing further into Nyx. The first line of defense against this encroachment is increased patrols. InterSec has identified a sector that has seen an uptick in Vanduul activity and are looking for someone to patrol the region and provide an update on it.

You'll begin your patrol at a location marker sent to your HUD and then scan a series of waypoints along a designated route. The Vanduul ships in this sector are highly skilled and aggressive, so InterSec highly recommends that you bring several combat-ready ships along as backup.

InterSec understands the immense danger you'll be under on this patrol, so we'll send a special bonus of 24 MG Scrip to the main contractor once the sector is clear.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：人们越来越担心剜度狩猎队伍正在进一步侵入尼克斯。防止这种入侵的第一道防线是加强巡逻。互安已经确定了一个剜度活动增加的区域，正在寻找人员前往该地区进行巡逻并提供最新情况。

你将从发送到 HUD 的位置标记开始巡逻，然后沿着指定的路线扫描各个点。该区域的剜度飞船技术高超且极具攻击性，因此互安强烈建议你带上几艘准备好战斗的飞船作为支援。

互安了解你在这次巡逻中将面临的巨大危险，因此一旦该区域安全，我们将向主承包商发放 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的特别奖励。

ade95587-2c0d-433e-87c4-865e7dc80b0c.description: Wikelo not want to race but can still make fast ship faster. If you want, bring me things, and go faster.
ade95587-2c0d-433e-87c4-865e7dc80b0c.descriptionCn: 维科洛不想竞速。但还是可以让快船更快。你要是想要。带点东西给我。然后飞得更快。

6cf1e4cc-5b44-48af-a0a1-46563b1fabde.title: Pick Up and Drop Off
6cf1e4cc-5b44-48af-a0a1-46563b1fabde.titleCn:
取货送货
[死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 VLRT]
6cf1e4cc-5b44-48af-a0a1-46563b1fabde.description:
Need someone solid to head to [LOCATION] and finish a delivery for me. The last contractor got themselves perished and now my stash is sitting in the back of their ship.

The scavs that took out my pilot might be there too, so stay alert. Take my package to [DESTINATION] and I’ll pay you for your time.

-Twitch
6cf1e4cc-5b44-48af-a0a1-46563b1fabde.descriptionCn:
需要一个可靠的人去 [LOCATION] 完成这次送货任务。上一个承包商死了，现在我的物资还留在他们的飞船里。

袭击我飞行员的那些不法分子可能也在那里，所以要保持警惕。把我的包裹送到 [DESTINATION]，我会付你报酬。

-刺痛

f4ee5c4c-db01-4b6c-930e-b266ce5b39db.titleCn:
拿起来，放下去
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 VLRT]
f4ee5c4c-db01-4b6c-930e-b266ce5b39db.description:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at [LOCATION] and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at [DESTINATION].

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros
f4ee5c4c-db01-4b6c-930e-b266ce5b39db.descriptionCn:
有个我们关注的人最近在 [LOCATION] 那儿挂了（不是咱们干的），我们得搞清楚怎么回事。你去把飞船上的黑匣子拿出来，送到 [DESTINATION] 就行。

顺便说一下，那是个沉船现场，估计会有垃圾佬在那儿转悠。不过别担心，咱们已经把这笔麻烦钱加到你的工资里了。

- 零比特

79b4171b-1494-4c7a-837a-400a2579c2ed.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [LOCATION] and they won't make it much longer without support.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
79b4171b-1494-4c7a-837a-400a2579c2ed.descriptionCn:
看起来我们曾认为相对安全的路线实际上并不安全。不法分子在 [LOCATION] 袭击了我们的一个飞行员，如果没有支援，他们很快就撑不下去了。

若你能尽快飞到那里，帮助他们应对这些攻击者，我将不胜感激。

Travel to their last known location and if they're still alive, defend them long enough to ensure they can escape. Ensuring the safety of the operative is crucial, as is eliminating any Vanduul threats to the UEE.

You'll most likely need a strong group of ships to successfully neutralize these Vanduul.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin

前往他们最后已知的位置，如果那人还活着，就保护他直到他能逃离。确保人员安全至关重要，清除任何对 UEE 构成威胁的剜度也是同样。

60826e88-0e47-4527-a92f-da99b70240e0.title: Plug a traitor
60826e88-0e47-4527-a92f-da99b70240e0.description:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TARGET] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to [LOCATION], find [TARGET], and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.
60826e88-0e47-4527-a92f-da99b70240e0.descriptionCn:
这真让我感到悲伤。不知道你在与我们打交道时是否遇到过 [TARGET]。我一直以为他们是个好人。和猎头帮在一起多年，但肯定发生了什么事，他们跑去找繁荣公民求保护了，在这个过程中还背叛了我们的一些兄弟姐妹。

所有法官都怒火中烧，想要血债血偿，这就是你的任务。前往 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGET]，然后杀了他。

不需要什么花哨的，只要结果。

真他妈可惜。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

89dbcf32-7f95-494d-8989-5f7295ce3ee5.titleCn:

89dbcf32-7f95-494d-8989-5f7295ce3ee5.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP50122
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Need an operative to help us potentially prevent a death. An informant has reported an active hit issued for [TARGET] and fears the worst, but the client has hired us like us to look into it.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Last known location was [LOCATION]. Head over there and see if the person mentioned by our client is still with us. If they’re not, examine the body closely so we can report back to them with details of their death.

Additional Notes:
This contract has been flagged as combat-likely so prepare accordingly.

合约调查员的行动：

94079b3a-b689-40ce-b8bf-f1371e4f6398.description:
Got a line on a bounty named [TARGET]. Someone spotted them along with known criminal accomplices at [LOCATION]. Need you to get there before they get going.

[TARGET] has a reputation for only showing their face in places with civs. Really need you to take down this bounty without there being any civilian collateral damage. Foxwell can’t afford to be caught in the shitstorm that would erupt over the loss of innocent life.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
94079b3a-b689-40ce-b8bf-f1371e4f6398.descriptionCn:
我们得到了一个名为 [TARGET] 的赏金目标的消息。有人发现他们与已知的犯罪同伙一起出现在 [LOCATION]。需要你在他们离开之前赶到那里。

[TARGET] 以只在有平民的地方露面而闻名。真的需要你在不造成任何平民附带伤害的情况下拿下这个赏金目标。福克斯韦尔可不想卷入因无辜生命损失而引发的胡搅蛮缠当中。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: Stanton
RISK ASSESSMENT: Medium
LAST KNOWN LOCATION:  [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS:
NOTES: This preliminary bounty is being offered to you as a formal evaluation of your skills. Successful completion of this contract will lead to additional bounty work being made available.

It is believed that the target will be on foot and well armed, so be prepared to engage in a firefight. Additionally, there may be other hostiles forces at the site, while they should not be your primary focus, you may have to engage with them while in pursuit of the target.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.
0b81a651-29e3-4ca2-a3dd-2f2af5d14b40.descriptionCn:

---------------------  赏金合约  ---------------------
--------------------------------------------------------


赏金猎人公会
处理与分配部门

赏金猎人公会已授权一份官方赏金

姓名：[TARGET]
星系：斯坦顿星系
风险评估：中等
最后已知位置：[LOCATION]
已知关联：
注意：这个初步的赏金任务是为了正式评估你的能力而提供的。成功完成这个合约后，还会有更多的悬赏任务开放给你。

据信目标没有使用交通工具并且全副武装，所以要做好交火的准备。此外，现场可能还有其他敌对势力，虽然他们不是你的主要目标，但在追捕目标的过程中，你可能不得不与他们交战。

赏金猎人公会
追求正义

赏金猎人公会是一个由雇佣兵公会批准的安保服务，根据《外星贸易授权法案》被授权在 UEE 及其以外地区开展行动。

927f4e62-c90e-4366-a31d-9183c377806e.title: Primo Target
927f4e62-c90e-4366-a31d-9183c377806e.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGET] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGET] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
927f4e62-c90e-4366-a31d-9183c377806e.descriptionCn:
有一个白金目标需要被解决。[TARGET] 是个重磅人物，是繁荣公民的安全负责人之一。虽然 [TARGET] 可能已经忘记了，但猎头帮还记得，几年前与一家雇佣军公司合作的事情，导致五位兄弟姐妹的死亡，我们要血债血偿。

他们最近在 [LOCATION] 附近出现过，所以你应该还能在那找到他们。

他们是个狠角色，所以带上些朋友，但一定要确保他死。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

730b6bba-3de0-4890-b6c5-653daef81b00.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
730b6bba-3de0-4890-b6c5-653daef81b00.titleCn:
临时逃犯赏金任务
[玩家赏金]
730b6bba-3de0-4890-b6c5-653daef81b00.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system.

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid.

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
730b6bba-3de0-4890-b6c5-653daef81b00.descriptionCn:
你好，

我叫布雷登·科查多，北境之岩服务团队的后勤官，斯坦顿星系内最大的独立安保公司。我可能已经找过你了，但我们希望能联系上每个达到高标准的人，并去完成我们的临时合约。

成为北境之岩的承包商绝对是你的不二之选。我们良好的声誉能为你提供一些既有趣又不乏挑战性的工作，且报酬高于星系内的其它竞争者。

如果，你想获得认证的话，你需要去抓捕 [TARGET]。他们最近刚从拘留中心里逃出来，而你的工作就是在他们消声灭迹前，把他们抓回去。

有些线索能帮得上忙，可以假设他们此时应该赶着要去清除记录，我建议你在拘留中心的位置，和他们有机会能骇入记录系统的地方进行下三角定位。

搞定这事我再看看能不能安排给你更多的活。

希望尽快收到你的答复，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

27e79407-6b9b-4534-a960-4e350552f6b9.title: Pro Tem Suspect Apprehension
27e79407-6b9b-4534-a960-4e350552f6b9.titleCn:
临时嫌犯逮捕合约
[玩家赏金]
27e79407-6b9b-4534-a960-4e350552f6b9.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
27e79407-6b9b-4534-a960-4e350552f6b9.descriptionCn:
嗨，

希望你不介意，但我知道你在赏金猎人工会的情况，并想看下你有没有兴趣和我们北境之岩服务团队签订合约，我们是星系内评价最高的私人安保公司之一。

如果你有的话，首先需要你去完成一份临时嫌犯逮捕合约。与其说是评断，其实更像是次机会，来确保我们能有良好的共事关系。

你要找的嫌犯名叫 [TARGET]。他们可是出了名的难以捉摸，所以对你来说会有些困难。

希望尽快收到你的消息，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

200def0f-c70b-4f05-918f-b3efa7f8590f.title: Prospects Look Good
200def0f-c70b-4f05-918f-b3efa7f8590f.titleCn:
勘探者看起来不错
[兑换 - 勘探者 维科洛工作版]
200def0f-c70b-4f05-918f-b3efa7f8590f.description: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.
200def0f-c70b-4f05-918f-b3efa7f8590f.descriptionCn: 维科洛喜欢石头。想要帮你搞到更多更好的石头。把这个勘探者改得更厉害，适合干这种硬活。拿东西来换，你就能得到。

efaadba5-667f-4ca5-a2ff-84b743704a1f.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Attack
efaadba5-667f-4ca5-a2ff-84b743704a1f.titleCn: 保护 [LOCATION] 抵御异种威胁的攻击
efaadba5-667f-4ca5-a2ff-84b743704a1f.description:
We’ve learned that XenoThreat is about to launch an attack on [LOCATION]. If they are successful, the number of casualties is expected to be high. I’m hoping that with your aid in defending them, we can make sure that doesn’t happen.

We know from past encounters that XenoThreat sends several raiding parties to carry out their attacks, so make sure you don’t leave the outpost until you’ve fought off all the reinforcements.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
efaadba5-667f-4ca5-a2ff-84b743704a1f.descriptionCn:
我们得知异种威胁即将对 [LOCATION] 发动攻击。如果他们成功，可能会造成大量伤亡。我希望你能来协助防守，这样我们就可以确保这种情况不会发生。

根据以往的遭遇，我们知道异种威胁会派遣几个突击队进行攻击，所以在你确定击退所有增援之前，请不要离开前哨站。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

f5519744-fb8c-45ea-bfb5-6e31d2afe8c4.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Incursion
f5519744-fb8c-45ea-bfb5-6e31d2afe8c4.titleCn: 保护 [LOCATION] 抵御异种威胁的入侵
f5519744-fb8c-45ea-bfb5-6e31d2afe8c4.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [LOCATION] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
f5519744-fb8c-45ea-bfb5-6e31d2afe8c4.descriptionCn:
紧急情况！

异种威胁正在准备大规模入侵，企图将 [LOCATION] 从地图上抹去。你是他们唯一的希望，挡下这次攻击，保护他们免受异种威胁的残害。

我知道我是在要求你把自己置身险境，但只有像你这样面对危险能挺身而出的人，才能改变这个星系。再多的钱也抵不上你的壮举带来的益处。

如果你愿意并有能力执行这项任务，一定要带上一些盟友。如果异种威胁发现自己损失惨重，他们肯定会派出更强大的援军。

我们相信你。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

f09b6204-cab2-4081-b14f-48e2a5631501.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Raid
f09b6204-cab2-4081-b14f-48e2a5631501.titleCn: 保护 [LOCATION] 抵御异种威胁的袭击
f09b6204-cab2-4081-b14f-48e2a5631501.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is targeting [LOCATION] to send a message to other settlers about what happens if they accept our support.

If you’re able to fend off the attackers, I’m sure they’ll send additional forces, so you’ll need to dig in for multiple assaults. Since XenoThreat has a lot of resources at their disposal, you should think about recruiting others to help you keep everyone safe.

We’re all counting on you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
f09b6204-cab2-4081-b14f-48e2a5631501.descriptionCn:
紧急情况！

异种威胁打算威胁 [LOCATION] 的定居者，因为他们支持我们。

即使你能击退攻击者，他们应该也还会派出更多的部队，所以你需要防御多次攻击。异种威胁拥有大量资源，你应该考虑招募盟友来帮助你保护大家的安全。

我们都指望着你。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

d9b69130-1021-4d00-9178-ab800bcb3027.title: Protect Fuel Tanks From Luggers
d9b69130-1021-4d00-9178-ab800bcb3027.titleCn:
从走私犯手里保护 [OBJECTS]
[猎头帮 - 保护可摧毁实体 LRT]
d9b69130-1021-4d00-9178-ab800bcb3027.description:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

Stows out.
d9b69130-1021-4d00-9178-ab800bcb3027.descriptionCn:
一些脑子进水的家伙抱着极度膨胀的自我认知，竟敢愚蠢地袭击了 [LOCATION] 那边的 [OBJECTS]。那边我们已经部署了一些人手，绝不能让他们得逞。

如果你有兴趣帮忙，就赶紧过去，在他们造成太大破坏前收拾掉这些蠢货。对付他们，你估计不会费多大劲。

另外，为了表示感谢，我会给主承包商额外加赏 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve gotten word that outlaws have their sights set on attacking [LOCATION]. Our client is concerned the attack is imminent and requested that security be deployed to the site immediately. If you’re interested and available, gather all the supplies and support you may need and head to the location pronto.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

合约 & 派遣

授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们得到消息，不法分子的目标是对 [LOCATION] 进行攻击。我们的客户担心攻击即将发生，并请求立即向该地点部署安保。如果你有兴趣并且现在有空，请准备好所有你可能需要的的物资和支持，迅速前往该地点。

63deca2e-dc75-4d78-a729-8dbd74456c2c.title: Protect Our Site
63deca2e-dc75-4d78-a729-8dbd74456c2c.titleCn:
保护我们的站点
[猎头帮 - 地点保卫 LRT]
63deca2e-dc75-4d78-a729-8dbd74456c2c.description:
Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around [LOCATION]. Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

Stows out.
63deca2e-dc75-4d78-a729-8dbd74456c2c.descriptionCn:
有些不怕死的蠢货正在 [LOCATION] 附近攻击我们的飞船。可不能让他们就这么嚣张下去，得让他们付出点代价。想亲自收拾他们吗？

如果想的话，赶紧出发去追他们。那边的船员正在追踪攻击者的动向，我会随时把最新的情况告诉你。

另外，为了表示我的感谢，我会给主要承包人额外加个奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证，就当是锦上添花了。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

保护重要资产
[互安防务 - 保卫飞船 HRT]
a945ab4e-ea8f-4e5b-886f-fd02a68f439c.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: One of our pilots is under attack at [LOCATION] and is in need of assistance.

This operative is carrying key information regarding a coordinated attack on key UEE infrastructure and it is vital that they are able to deliver it to us. You and any dependable pilots you can recruit are charged with protecting them from the outlaws in pursuit long enough for them to QT away.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
a945ab4e-ea8f-4e5b-886f-fd02a68f439c.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：我们的一名飞行员在 [LOCATION] 受到了攻击，急需援助。

这名特工携带了关于针对 UEE 关键基础设施协同攻击的重要信息，他们必须把信息送到我们手上。你和任何你能招募到的可靠飞行员负责保护他，让他摆脱追击的不法分子，直到他量子航行离开。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

c606f7ba-034c-4ce1-9e3b-9e989bf397e7.titleCn: 保护前哨站免受异种威胁攻击
c606f7ba-034c-4ce1-9e3b-9e989bf397e7.description:

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
c606f7ba-034c-4ce1-9e3b-9e989bf397e7.descriptionCn:
异种威胁的部队对 [LOCATION] 发起了毫无理由的攻击。我们正在寻找任何有空的战斗操作员前去提供支援。

如果你之前没有与他们交手过的话，你要知道异种威胁是经过训练的战士，这很重要，所以这将不是一场轻松的战斗，但这是必要的。

f51e3afa-be1b-4e30-a32e-fa10c1342fc8.description:
Reports indicate that [LOCATION] has come under attack from a group of armed individuals led by a notorious outlaw named [TARGET]. There have been multiple reported deaths and injuries, so Citizens for Prosperity has been looking for qualified combat operatives to provide some support.

Though we don't advocate conflict resolution through violence, we believe that the group will disperse if [TARGET] is not there to lead them.

Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
f51e3afa-be1b-4e30-a32e-fa10c1342fc8.descriptionCn:
报告显示，[LOCATION] 附近的一个前哨站遭到了由臭名昭著的不法分子 [TARGET] 领导的一群武装人员的攻击。已有多起报告死亡和受伤的事件，因此繁荣公民正在寻找合格的作战人员提供支持。

尽管我们不支持通过暴力解决冲突，但我们相信，如果没有 [TARGET] ，这个团体就会解散。

尽快前往，人命关天。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

利玛·恩迪科特

繁荣公民
