ffbb40e6-09d7-4047-85a7-440c2c8066d1.title: PURGE ASD SERVERS
ffbb40e6-09d7-4047-85a7-440c2c8066d1.titleCn:
清除 ASD 服务器
[研究翼楼 - 异种科技实验室]
ffbb40e6-09d7-4047-85a7-440c2c8066d1.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client has asked us to infiltrate an old ASD research site and wipe the contents of a few specific servers there.

We believe the servers are located somewhere within the Xenotech Lab, in the Research wing. The client has also informed us that despite the facilities being publicly declared as closed, you're still likely to find hostile forces there.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
ffbb40e6-09d7-4047-85a7-440c2c8066d1.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：摧毁服务器
授权代码 = VS-14

需要立即处理

一位客户要求我们潜入一个旧的联合科学与开发公司(ASD)的研究站点，并清除其中几台特定服务器的内容。

我们相信这些服务器位于研究翼楼的异种科技实验室内的某个地方。客户还告知我们，尽管这些设施已被公开宣布关闭，但你仍可能在那里遇到敌对势力。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

4ec364ec-883c-431f-82d6-52dc70d199cd.title: Purge XenoThreat Servers
4ec364ec-883c-431f-82d6-52dc70d199cd.titleCn: 清除异种威胁的服务器
4ec364ec-883c-431f-82d6-52dc70d199cd.description:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people.

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at [LOCATION].

-Stows out
4ec364ec-883c-431f-82d6-52dc70d199cd.descriptionCn:
我现在气得眼睛都看不清楚了。一个我本以为可以信任的猎头帮成员居然叛变了，投向了异种威胁。没错，外星人杀了你的家人，这真让人糟心，但你总不能背叛自己的同胞。

更让人恼火的是，这家伙居然把我们的一些情报交给了异种威胁。我让其他人去追踪这个叛徒，但我需要你帮我清除被盗的数据。那些数据存储在 [LOCATION] 的服务器上。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

a2e2b879-011f-4b42-a3a2-8df7bd68b9bd.titleCn: QV 碎岩站 BRK-110 采矿权（共享）
a2e2b879-011f-4b42-a3a2-8df7bd68b9bd.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
a2e2b879-011f-4b42-a3a2-8df7bd68b9bd.descriptionCn:
合约：采矿权转让
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
舒宾星际的勘探者们最近发现了一处已被废弃的 QV 行星服务公司碎岩站的位置，该站位于基格小行星带附近。这些站点最初由这家已倒闭的公司用来从小行星内部开采珍贵资源，但其确切位置早已丢失多年。

虽然该站点目前处于离线状态，但我们的侦察队认为，只要进行必要的维修，它就能重新投入使用。此外，一旦将其恢复运行，现场已经有一块富含资源的小行星，随时可以由站点的采矿激光进行开采。

不幸的是，由于在尼克斯运营面临的各种挑战，舒宾手头目前没有足够的宽裕自行处理上述维修工作。但这却为像您这样对独立采矿作业感兴趣的人创造了一个机会。

条款*:
我们提供该 QV 碎岩站站的共享采矿权。购买后，我们将向您及您的船员提供该站点的坐标。（请注意，任何其他有兴趣购买采矿权的人也将获得该站点的访问权限。）随后，您的船员可驾驶采矿飞船前往该地点，将该空间站的采矿激光恢复至运行状态，开采小行星，并在内部获取资源。

请注意，由于这是一份共享合约，所以我们能够以较低的价格提供这些采矿权，但小行星中的资源将与现场的其他采矿人员按先到先得的原则共享。此外，其他感兴趣的各方（如不法分子）也有可能自行发现该空间站的位置。请务必谨慎行事。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

集结起来帮助运输舰队

73090b67-7bcf-4485-a6e3-a5341724f50d.description:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen.

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to [LOCATION] immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.
73090b67-7bcf-4485-a6e3-a5341724f50d.descriptionCn:
我们有一个小队陷入了困境。他们刚刚发来通讯，说他们的舰队正遭到人民联盟的围攻，急需帮助。他们描述的情况虽然比较夸张，但可以想象情况肯定很严重。我可不想听到如果他们没能活下来，不得不重生时他们会怎么跟我讲。

如果这个小队都这么慌了，那情况肯定很严重。真的需要你立刻去 [LOCATION]，确保他们能安全脱身。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Citizens for Prosperity
0fed970e-9222-490a-b1d8-993c9d896b58.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民正在寻找安保人员，以夺回一个曾经是繁荣公民前哨站的地点，该地点目前被猎头帮作为藏身之所，用于帮助他们在整个星系内发起攻击。

它位于 [LOCATION] 附近，夺回这个前哨站将使繁荣公民能够更好地支持当地建立稳定。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

4cd24c49-870e-48af-9a37-3f55dad7316a.title: Reclaim XenoThreat Outpost
4cd24c49-870e-48af-9a37-3f55dad7316a.description:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [LOCATION] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
4cd24c49-870e-48af-9a37-3f55dad7316a.descriptionCn:
尽管我们努力倡导非暴力，但当地的非法团伙依然持续攻击我们的组织。异种威胁最近袭击了 [LOCATION] ，把我们在那里工作的志愿者驱赶了出去。

我们希望招募战斗人员来夺回这个前哨站。理想情况下，我们希望能找个办法促使他们撤退，但异种威胁很快就会通过暴力来解决他们的所有问题，因此毫无疑问会发生一场战斗。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cdbd2484-129b-4aef-a22c-42c52ae02cdc.title: Reclaiming Clusters from Headhunters
cdbd2484-129b-4aef-a22c-42c52ae02cdc.titleCn: 从猎头帮手里夺回前哨站集群
cdbd2484-129b-4aef-a22c-42c52ae02cdc.description:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near [LOCATION] that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out [TARGET], who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cdbd2484-129b-4aef-a22c-42c52ae02cdc.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民的理事会刚刚批准资金，雇佣安全人员夺回几个位于 [LOCATION] 附近的前哨站集群，这些地方已经落入猎头帮之手。虽然我们曾试图接受这个损失，但显然这些地点对我们在星系中的持续运营至关重要。

你需要清理我们提供的每一个地点，但更重要的是，你还需要解决 [TARGET]，他是现场敌对人员的领导者

。这些猎头帮成员资历很深，且有暴力历史，所以你应该做好相应的准备。

玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

229c9217-0b98-406b-bb78-91a95cafb678.title: Reclaiming Outposts from XenoThreat
229c9217-0b98-406b-bb78-91a95cafb678.titleCn: 从异种威胁手中夺回前哨站
229c9217-0b98-406b-bb78-91a95cafb678.description:
Looking for any available security personnel to reclaim several clusters previously lost to XenoThreat aggressors. Located near [LOCATION], they had been seized in brutal attacks led by [TARGET], a notorious XenoThreat lieutenant.

We're looking to take these clusters back so we can reestablish operations and continue our good work. You'll need to clear all the hostiles still on-site as well as [TARGET].

Just a reminder, that XenoThreat are highly trained and quick to fight, so prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
229c9217-0b98-406b-bb78-91a95cafb678.descriptionCn:
我们正在寻找任何有空的安全人员，以夺回几个之前陷落于异种威胁侵略者之手的前哨站群。它们位于 [LOCATION]，曾在 [TARGET] 这个臭名昭著的异种威胁中尉的领导下遭到残酷攻击而被夺走。

我们希望重新夺回这些集群，以便重新建立运营，继续我们的工作。你需要清除现场仍在活动的所有敌对人员并击杀 [TARGET]。

请记住，异种威胁训练有素且反应迅速，所以请做好准备。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

706aedbf-efdb-44f6-b075-f5d0d775ce37.title: Recover Vanduul Corpses
706aedbf-efdb-44f6-b075-f5d0d775ce37.titleCn:
取回剜度尸体
[互安防务 - 资源收集 剜度尸体]
706aedbf-efdb-44f6-b075-f5d0d775ce37.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Cargo Capable Ship, Personal Arms, Heavy-Duty Tractor Beam
Briefing:
Our latest intel shows that the Shattered Blade have replenished their stock of Vanduul corpses and will shortly be transferring them from the old QV Logistics stationthey're operating from to an interested buyer. The UEE can't have another incident like what happened with ASD so they're eager for us to recover the cryopods and deliver them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

While the Shattered Blade members present at the site might offer resistance, they are not the focus of you mission. Deal with them as needed and get the cryopods.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
706aedbf-efdb-44f6-b075-f5d0d775ce37.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子出现且有武装
装备规格：具备货物运输能力的飞船，单兵装备，重型牵引光束
任务简报：
我们的最新情报显示，碎刃帮已经补充了他们的剜度尸体库存，很快就会将这些尸体从他们目前使用的旧 QV 物流空间站转移到一个感兴趣的买家手中。UEE 不希望再次发生像 ASD 那样的事件，因此他们迫切希望我们取回冷冻舱，并将它们送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。

虽然碎刃帮的成员可能会在现场抵抗，但他们并不是你这次任务的主要目标。根据需要处理他们，然后拿到冷冻舱。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

0a3c40b0-f0e7-473f-bf75-fc7f4f0b5ffc.titleCn:

0a3c40b0-f0e7-473f-bf75-fc7f4f0b5ffc.description:

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms

Following from your previous experience, it would not be surprising if the Shattered Blade offer resistance, but ensure that your focus is on recovering the materials.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin

InterSec Defense Solutions

6fc1b754-5f7e-4da6-8499-81e1b0dee659.title: Recover VIP Covalex Shipment
6fc1b754-5f7e-4da6-8499-81e1b0dee659.titleCn:
追回科瓦莱什 VIP 货物
[科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 超级困难 无战斗]
6fc1b754-5f7e-4da6-8499-81e1b0dee659.description:
Hey,

Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.

Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.

The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at [LOCATION]. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to collect it all.

Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
6fc1b754-5f7e-4da6-8499-81e1b0dee659.descriptionCn:
嘿，

这活儿只找最优秀的承包商来做。我们一位极其重要的客户正等着一批超级关键的货，结果现在严重超期了。

在科瓦莱什，我们向来等对待所有客户，不管送啥都拼尽全力服务到位。但这次要是搞砸了合约，肯定有人要倒大霉，而我真的不希望那个人是我...

追踪器显示，上一任承包商的飞船还在 [LOCATION] 那儿。这单别掉以轻心，你得开一艘能装得下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞，还得配上一把重型牵引光束，不然根本搬不动。

货一拿到手，立刻送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿。然后咱们就翻篇，而且你还能赚一大笔信用点，挺不错吧？

[SIGN_OFF]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

befb9ad9-6ddc-4304-a696-95fa214a6800.title: Recovering Valuable Supplies
befb9ad9-6ddc-4304-a696-95fa214a6800.titleCn:
回收珍贵物资
[繁荣公民 - 取回货物 MRT]
befb9ad9-6ddc-4304-a696-95fa214a6800.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
befb9ad9-6ddc-4304-a696-95fa214a6800.descriptionCn:
一艘繁荣公民的飞船在 [LOCATION] 遭到一伙不法分子伏击，急需一名技术娴熟的飞行员前去支援。

我们中途与他们失联了，但最后听到的通讯里，他们似乎正承受猛烈火力。他们或许已凶多吉少，但他们所运送的关键物资仍有可能派上用场。请立即飞赴现场，清除所有敌对目标，并回收这批货物。你需要驾驶一艘能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并配备一把 重型牵引光束，以便将物资转运上船。

随后将货物送至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。我保证，这批物资定会物尽其用。

在外务必保重，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

af13a863-6d63-4935-bec6-d55d73e44f83.title: Red Fight Apollo
af13a863-6d63-4935-bec6-d55d73e44f83.titleCn:
红色战斗阿波罗
[兑换 - 阿波罗 分诊 维科洛鬼祟版]
af13a863-6d63-4935-bec6-d55d73e44f83.description: Apollo very good ship. Would be much better if ship was red. Wikelo make all things possible. You trade for what I want and we have a deal.
af13a863-6d63-4935-bec6-d55d73e44f83.descriptionCn: 阿波罗是一艘很好的飞船。如果船是红色的会更好。维科洛让一切成为可能。你我想要的东西交换，我们就成交。

05bb00fc-bb90-40a5-bcff-214ff876662b.title: Red Fight Armor
05bb00fc-bb90-40a5-bcff-214ff876662b.titleCn:
红色战斗护甲
[兑换 - 蒙德护甲 猩红迷彩]
05bb00fc-bb90-40a5-bcff-214ff876662b.description: Wikelo hear that Humans think red is the color of passion and anger. This armor good for both. You give me items on list and this red armor is yours.
05bb00fc-bb90-40a5-bcff-214ff876662b.descriptionCn: 维科洛听说人类认为红色是激情与愤怒的颜色。这套装甲正适合这两种情绪。你把清单上的物品给我，这套红色装甲就是你的。

cc80cd24-2ed0-4e9c-aa10-766e6bbdf3d1.title: Red Fight Shotgun
cc80cd24-2ed0-4e9c-aa10-766e6bbdf3d1.titleCn:
红色战斗霰弹枪
[兑换 - R97 “猩红迷彩” 霰弹枪]
cc80cd24-2ed0-4e9c-aa10-766e6bbdf3d1.description: Shooting can be messy. Red Human Blood everywhere. Not a problem with this shotgun. Splashes blends right in! I give it to you if you give me everything I want on list. Good trade.
cc80cd24-2ed0-4e9c-aa10-766e6bbdf3d1.descriptionCn: 射击可能会弄得一团糟。到处都是鲜红的人类血液。但这把霰弹枪不是问题！飞溅的血迹完美融入其中！只要你给我清单上我想要的东西，我就把它给你。划算的交易。

3e7d0f51-7185-4674-bdc5-50ca2d0798b5.title: Red Level Contract: Ambush Attack Squad
3e7d0f51-7185-4674-bdc5-50ca2d0798b5.titleCn: 红色级别合约：伏击攻击小队
3e7d0f51-7185-4674-bdc5-50ca2d0798b5.description:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens.

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a [TARGET], was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by [LOCATION]. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
3e7d0f51-7185-4674-bdc5-50ca2d0798b5.descriptionCn:
福克斯韦尔收到一位重要客户的消息，称不法分子组建了一支小队，正在用次主力舰和护航战斗机在星系中游荡。我们的客户担心，如果不加以制止，不法分子会组建更多这样的攻击小队，从而破坏星系安全。我们被雇来在这种情况发生之前消灭这伙人。

我们需要一位自信且技术熟练的承包商来执行这个任务。好消息是我们已经有了计划。这个小队使用的一艘船，一艘 [TARGET]，是从我们的客户那里偷来的，客户仍然能够追踪它的动向。他们与我们分享了位置信息，我们发现这个小队经常在 [LOCATION] 一带活动。我们已经侦察过这个地点，发现一片巨大的辐射云非常适合设下伏击。

老实说，这可不是件容易的事。我们没有额外的力量可供调动，所以最好带上你自己的支援。

要是你能办成这事儿，我已经安排好了给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

福克斯韦尔收到一位重要客户的消息，称不法分子组建了一支小队，正在用次主力舰和护航战斗机在星系中游荡。我们的客户担心，如果不加以制止，不法分子会组建更多这样的攻击小队，从而破坏星系安全。我们被雇来在这种情况发生之前消灭这伙人。

我们需要一位自信且技术熟练的承包商来执行这个任务。好消息是我们已经有了计划。这个小队使用的一艘船，一艘 [TARGET]，是从我们的客户那里偷来的，客户仍然能够追踪它的动向。他们与我们分享了位置信息，我们发现这个小队经常在 [LOCATION] 一带活动。我们已经侦察过这个地点，发现一片巨大的辐射云非常适合设下伏击。

老实说，这可不是件容易的事。我们没有额外的力量可供调动，所以最好带上你自己的支援。

要是你能办成这事儿，我已经安排好了给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

50b65c1a-14ad-4e69-bba6-efac087a3735.description:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at [LOCATION1] and [LOCATION2], but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle 32 SCU cargo containers.  It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

在旧的哈索尔采矿设施中发生了一些奇怪的事情。平台校准设施和轨道激光平台已经被废弃积灰了几十年，但不法分子开始将它们用作行动基地。

我们受雇于一个相关的客户，他最近被这样一个团伙抢走了大量重要货物。目前，他们的货物被藏在 [LOCATION1] 和 [LOCATION2]，但有人担心这个团伙可能很快就会转移货物。这就是为什么我们被雇佣同时袭击这两座哈索尔设施，从货运电梯取回货物，并将其送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。

以下是每个位置需要取回的具体信息。无论你按什么顺序执行，只要确保所有货物都被收集并送达即可。记得确保你有一艘能处理 [MAX_SCU] 集装箱的飞船。

而且带上一个手持式牵引光束也没啥坏处。

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

福克斯韦尔还未能侦察这些地点，如果我是你的话，我会预计到会遇到一些严重的武装抵抗。最好带上大量装备和一些朋友。

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the location marker on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan.

From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least two trusted pilots by your side for this one.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 18 MG Scrip.

1c7c6b3b-424a-4909-8902-de4dc38e8a83.title: Red Level Contract: Secure Threatened Space
1c7c6b3b-424a-4909-8902-de4dc38e8a83.titleCn: 红色级别合约：保卫受威胁空域
1c7c6b3b-424a-4909-8902-de4dc38e8a83.description:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the location marker on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least three friends to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 24 MG Scrip at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

2d2c0eed-a792-4a1d-a98e-e602777503ac.titleCn: 红色级别合约：突袭攻击
2d2c0eed-a792-4a1d-a98e-e602777503ac.description:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an [TARGET] and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near [LOCATION]. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack.

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [TARGET] is aggressive and battle hardened.

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of 16 MG Scrip in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

6d1aacc1-5c0c-433a-bfa9-6f3d3a425a1b.description:
An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [LOCATION] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s  [OBJECTS] and of their ships that may need assistance.

This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering 6 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on.

Stay safe, and good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
6d1aacc1-5c0c-433a-bfa9-6f3d3a425a1b.descriptionCn:
来自福克斯韦尔一位 VIP 客户旗下的维护团队发出了紧急求救信号。如有可能，请立即前往[LOCATION]。在应对袭击者时，你需要全力保护客户的 [OBJECTS] 及其可能需要援助的飞船。

这些不法分子此前已多次作案，相信我，绝不能轻视他们的飞行技术。我强烈建议你安排一支高度专业的增援部队与你一同飞往现场。

如果你能成功捍卫客户利益，我们将向敢于接下此任务的勇敢主承包商支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

注意安全，祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

233840df-b7e4-4113-b20e-f72b3e5e4c75.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · [LOCATION]

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.

eb9d2458-6b41-4163-8869-5f5b22e5e95b.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · [LOCATION]

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Outlaws are making our jobs much harder to complete these days. We need a contractor with combat experience to head to our former delivery pilot’s ship location at [LOCATION] and recover the packages left there.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
     · 3x [ITEM1]

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Deliver to [DESTINATION]

While you're out there, be on the lookout for trouble, we’re getting reports of multiple outlaws in the vicinity.

4445c5ea-6f35-43e1-89e7-8264bd442f89.title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
4445c5ea-6f35-43e1-89e7-8264bd442f89.titleCn: 减少不法分子的作战储备
4445c5ea-6f35-43e1-89e7-8264bd442f89.description:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system.

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves.

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
4445c5ea-6f35-43e1-89e7-8264bd442f89.descriptionCn:
在 [LOCATION] 有一群不法分子，他们在攻击繁荣公民的资产时变得越来越猖狂。

为了尽量减少人员伤亡，我们希望通过破坏他们的发电机和摧毁他们的燃料储备，先尝试说服他们离开，去别的地方。

希望这样足以让他们放弃，去别的“好地方”。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

b7587d9d-2141-4d61-89d6-dd11ca9a96e8.title: Reduce Overpopulation
b7587d9d-2141-4d61-89d6-dd11ca9a96e8.titleCn:
减少种群过剩
[高境荒野 - 击杀动物 单物种]
b7587d9d-2141-4d61-89d6-dd11ca9a96e8.description:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at [LOCATION] regarding an uptick in the [CREATURE] population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the [CREATURE] population is reduced before that happens.

If you can help, please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
b7587d9d-2141-4d61-89d6-dd11ca9a96e8.descriptionCn:
我们一直在监测 [LOCATION] 的情况，过去几个月 [CREATURE] 的数量有所增加。我们的模型显示，如果这种情况持续下去，许多本地植物和动物将受到不利影响。在此之前，必须减少 [CREATURE] 的数量。

如果您能提供帮助，请参阅《斯坦顿野生动物指南》。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

67a43a4e-3da9-4a30-80d8-b39e597cef79.title: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
67a43a4e-3da9-4a30-80d8-b39e597cef79.titleCn:
削减碎岩站的瓦拉卡种群数量
[高境荒野 - 击杀动物 LRT 碎岩站]
67a43a4e-3da9-4a30-80d8-b39e597cef79.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.

We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.

Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
67a43a4e-3da9-4a30-80d8-b39e597cef79.descriptionCn:
若您近期有任务需前往基格小行星带的任一老旧 QV 碎岩站，我们另有一项工作希望您顺道协助。

我们近日接到人民联盟的请求，协助推进一项计划：为修复这些废弃空间站做前期准备。遗憾的是，瓦拉卡种群的入侵已严重破坏站内基础设施，并极大降低了其未来重启的可能性。鉴于瓦拉卡属入侵物种，经评估，清除其种群实为唯一可行方案。

请在任一老旧 QV 碎岩站内削减瓦拉卡数量，任务完成后我们将支付相应报酬。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

02f841ac-ebed-47b6-89e6-8973b37398be.title: REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
02f841ac-ebed-47b6-89e6-8973b37398be.titleCn:
加油请求：[SHIP]
[旅者联合 - 燃料补给 LRT]
02f841ac-ebed-47b6-89e6-8973b37398be.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.

A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is running on empty, so make sure your fuel pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and  [QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum , and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
02f841ac-ebed-47b6-89e6-8973b37398be.descriptionCn:
你好啊，

如果你加装了加油设备，可能会喜欢这个任务。

一个信标刚刚在 [LOCATION] 附近上线。是一位客户的委托，他的 [SHIP] 已经没油了。所以请确保你的燃料吊舱加满了。

客户飞船将按氢燃料每 SCU [FUELRATE] aUEC 和量子燃料每 SCU [QTFUELRATE] aUEC 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

看起来是个零麻烦、一次搞定就完事的活，但保持扫描器开启总没坏处。
如有兴趣请告知，我们好让这些人顺利启程。

静候佳音，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部

adb3771b-2a54-4c8d-bdf7-a471df078c39.title: Remove Upstart Gang From Sector
adb3771b-2a54-4c8d-bdf7-a471df078c39.titleCn:
清除星区的新兴帮派
[繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 MRT 多波次]
adb3771b-2a54-4c8d-bdf7-a471df078c39.description:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises.

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
adb3771b-2a54-4c8d-bdf7-a471df078c39.descriptionCn:
总感觉每当我们在星系中刚取得实质性进展，不法分子就会跳出来让我们往回退一步。我们不久前才刚肃清 [LOCATION]，却得知一支新的不法团伙已在此扎根，并将其作为各类犯罪活动的跳板。

鉴于我们无法容忍这种腐化继续蔓延，现指派你携数艘支援飞船前往该地，彻底清除所有帮派成员。每击溃一股敌军编队后，请务必耐心等待，直至所有敌对势力均被歼灭为止。

要知道，你正在做出真正的贡献，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

There’s a serious problem brewing for one of our clients at [LOCATION]. They’ve been warned that a highly skilled outlaw crew has their sights set on overrunning and occupying that location. We’ve been hired to make sure that doesn’t happen.

Need a contractor to deploy to the location immediately. Based on the intel provided by the client, this won’t be a walk in the park. We strongly advise you to bring allies and plenty of supplies to help ward of the impending attack.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

c20815c8-b8ca-4a13-9845-7a124e95f192.title: Reprisal Attack
c20815c8-b8ca-4a13-9845-7a124e95f192.titleCn:
报复行动
[猎头帮 - 伏击 HRT]
c20815c8-b8ca-4a13-9845-7a124e95f192.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.
c20815c8-b8ca-4a13-9845-7a124e95f192.descriptionCn:
有一队飞船最近劫了我们的运输舰队，我赌十块钱他们还会再来。想找人在那之前给他们给他们点颜色看看。

已经确认这帮蠢货由几艘大船和一艘护卫舰组成。领队开的是 [TARGET]，就把它定为首要目标。既然对方人多势众又穷凶极恶，搞突袭才是上策。他们常经过 [LOCATION] 那片带辐射云的星域——藏好身形，伺机而动。

除非你自认是王牌飞行员，否则最好带几个帮手。不妨告诉来帮忙的人，干完这票可以在可以在残骸里随便捡值钱货。

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

e845bc01-f15b-4160-901f-9c5c56a7e131.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [LOCATION]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.
e845bc01-f15b-4160-901f-9c5c56a7e131.descriptionCn:
一些混蛋拒绝支付我们应得的报酬。问题是，这些蠢货还到处炫耀。要是他们保持沉默的话我们还能用更有效方法解决这个问题，但现在我们需要给他们个下马威。

这帮蠢货在 [LOCATION]。我们需要他们全部消失，动静越大越好，等所有人都处理干净了，我们会把你的报酬发过去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

8951adc3-16df-43f3-8147-85ceefe4cb87.title: Rescue Incomplete Ling Delivery
8951adc3-16df-43f3-8147-85ceefe4cb87.titleCn:
抢救玲家快递未完成的交付
[玲家快递 - 取回货物 中等难度 无战斗]
8951adc3-16df-43f3-8147-85ceefe4cb87.description:
Hi,

Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.

One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at [LOCATION]. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers to complete the haul for us.

Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].  And I probably don't have to say this, but a heavy-duty tractor beam would probably be handy to have along.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
8951adc3-16df-43f3-8147-85ceefe4cb87.descriptionCn:
嗨，

有个挺简单的活儿，你要是有兴趣的话。

我们一个飞行员没当回事，直接无视了维护警报，结果几小时后，飞船真在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。人现在正回办公室路上，但我们需要个靠谱的运输员，开艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱 的大船，帮我们把这趟货拉完。

你觉得能搭把手不？先去把滞留的货取走，再送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行。我猜不用多说你也知道，带个重型牵引光束肯定更方便。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

1de8482e-8162-490a-a4ad-754e8e2a328b.title: Respond to Distress Beacon
1de8482e-8162-490a-a4ad-754e8e2a328b.titleCn:
响应求救信标
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 VHRT]
1de8482e-8162-490a-a4ad-754e8e2a328b.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near [LOCATION]. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
1de8482e-8162-490a-a4ad-754e8e2a328b.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民组织的一支补给运输舰队在 [LOCATION] 附近丢下了一个求救信标。他们没有任何回应，所以我估计情况很严重。这支运输队里有些技术不错的飞行员，要是他们不回话，那就说明真的需要支援了。

我们会给你报酬来支援这支运输舰队。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

e474df93-fce1-488c-aa04-8754e8f7e62e.title: Restore Order at [LOCATION]
e474df93-fce1-488c-aa04-8754e8f7e62e.titleCn:
恢复 [LOCATION] 的秩序
[猎头帮 - 地点保卫 ERT]
e474df93-fce1-488c-aa04-8754e8f7e62e.description:
Our crew at [LOCATION] needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised.

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
e474df93-fce1-488c-aa04-8754e8f7e62e.descriptionCn:
我们在 [LOCATION] 的船员需要支援。敌方飞船正在这片区域疯狂出没，见什么打什么。这已经够糟了，但这个地点还有一些极其关键的设备和人员，绝对不能被摧毁或者落入敌人手里。

考虑到这次袭击的规模，你得有一艘全副武装的飞船，再带上几个靠谱的僚机伙伴。召集你的队伍，飞到现场，我会告诉你最需要支援的具体位置。

为了表明我们对完成任务的重视程度，只要确保一切顺利，没有任何闪失，主承包人将会获得一笔额外奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

ef25b98a-e749-4151-a54b-c97600b393f7.title: Retaking Outposts from Headhunters
ef25b98a-e749-4151-a54b-c97600b393f7.titleCn: 从猎头帮手中夺回前哨站
ef25b98a-e749-4151-a54b-c97600b393f7.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near [LOCATION] from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by [TARGET] and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
ef25b98a-e749-4151-a54b-c97600b393f7.descriptionCn:
重新夺回位于 [LOCATION] 附近的几个前繁荣公民设施，这些设施目前被猎头帮控制。这些区域曾被 [TARGET] 暴力夺走，导致众多志愿者遇难。

重新让我们掌控这些前哨站将有助于为星系带来更多稳定。报告显示，[TARGET] 通常会藏在他下属的背后，因此在大部分敌对力量被清除后，他们才可能会出现。

猎头帮受过训练且脑子一根筋，所以他们不会轻易放弃。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

fa61f3d9-d314-498e-9265-dcd853411bae.title: Retrieval Op
fa61f3d9-d314-498e-9265-dcd853411bae.titleCn:
回收行动
[死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 MRT]
fa61f3d9-d314-498e-9265-dcd853411bae.description:
You got a ship and a heavy-duty tractor beam? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at [LOCATION]. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to [DESTINATION] and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch
fa61f3d9-d314-498e-9265-dcd853411bae.descriptionCn:
你有船，还有重型牵引光束？行，我有活儿找你。

不知道那帮人咋知道咱们要来，我一个运输队在 [LOCATION] 被人伏击了，飞行员彻底失联，八成凉了，但货的追踪器还停在原地没动。

我猜干掉飞行员那帮混蛋肯定还蹲在那儿，带点人手去，捞了货就跑别硬刚，别再搭上好货船了。

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，钱立马打你账上。

- 刺痛

889e49e3-3e9b-4d6f-b593-cc546c1e382b.title: Retrieval Op

4f735fe1-caec-4c9d-acba-606d8e096ba6.title: Retrieve Additional Smuggler Intel
4f735fe1-caec-4c9d-acba-606d8e096ba6.titleCn:
获取更多走私犯情报
[互安防务 - 调查剜度科技走私]
4f735fe1-caec-4c9d-acba-606d8e096ba6.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we update our intel.

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old QV Logistics station.

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the encrypted data and use the decryption key to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
4f735fe1-caec-4c9d-acba-606d8e096ba6.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：存在武装不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船、单兵武装
战斗简报：互安防务再次需要你的帮助。

你之前收集的情报在识别数名非法获取的剜度部件买主方面至关重要。但自那以后，碎刃帮仍在继续活动，而 UEE 要求我们更新情报。

我们相信，在旧的 QV 物流空间站的储存设施中，还能获取更多线索。

这次行动的参数与你上一次任务相同：找到加密数据，并使用解密密钥解密后上传清单给我们。碎刃帮自上次之后必定加强了该区域的防御，做好应对抵抗的准备。

祝你好运，我们会再联系你。

此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

fd8e44db-6c4d-4aac-8cd7-6f570254c591.title: Salvage Wrecked Ships on the Drift
fd8e44db-6c4d-4aac-8cd7-6f570254c591.description:
Got word there’s a few ships near [LOCATION] just floating all by their lonesome. It’s good salvage, but none of our crews have the time right now. We figured to give you first snap at it.

If you want the coords, we’ll sell them to you for a price. Then you’re free to pick the wreck as clean as you like and sell it all for a tidy profit. Now, you might run into some trouble out there from rival scavs, but I’m sure it won’t be anything you can’t handle.

- Smokey
fd8e44db-6c4d-4aac-8cd7-6f570254c591.descriptionCn:
听说在 [LOCATION] 附近有几艘飞船孤零零地漂浮着。这是不错的打捞机会，但我们现在的团队都没时间去处理。我们想先给你这个机会。

如果你想要坐标，我们可以以一个价格卖给你。然后你可以尽情打捞残骸，卖掉赚取可观的利润。不过，你可能会遇到一些来自竞争对手的麻烦，但我相信这对你来说没什么问题。

-“烟雾”

34a577e6-134c-4d1d-8a6c-db3e6f20e10c.title: Save Ship
34a577e6-134c-4d1d-8a6c-db3e6f20e10c.titleCn:
拯救飞船
[埃克哈特 - 保卫飞船 VLRT]
34a577e6-134c-4d1d-8a6c-db3e6f20e10c.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client is reporting trouble near [LOCATION]. Based on their comms, it doesn’t sound like an organized, professional attack. Still, we’re paid to provide protection and it’s been requested.

Need a contractor to fly there and secure the situation.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
34a577e6-134c-4d1d-8a6c-db3e6f20e10c.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

有一位客户报告在 [LOCATION] 附近遇到了麻烦。根据他们的通讯内容，这次攻击似乎并不像是有组织的、专业的行动。不过，我们受雇就是为了提供保护，而且客户也提出了这个请求。

需要一名承包商飞到那里并控制局面。

报酬将在合约顺利完成后支付。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

3e2038ff-3ee3-4887-aa8a-9c7fd865c4fe.title: Scout and Scan
3e2038ff-3ee3-4887-aa8a-9c7fd865c4fe.titleCn:
侦查与扫描
[猎头帮 - 巡逻 LRT]
3e2038ff-3ee3-4887-aa8a-9c7fd865c4fe.description:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go.

This one kicks off at the location marker on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor 4 Council Scrip as a thanks.

Stows out.

[猎头帮 - 保护实体并护航 MRT]
affa71b7-2192-4ef6-b16a-b1b19b4f4a69.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows
affa71b7-2192-4ef6-b16a-b1b19b4f4a69.descriptionCn:
有个新冒出来的帮派正让猎头帮头疼得要命，他们居然把 [OBJECTS] 给盯上了，地点就在 [LOCATION]。这事儿可不太妙，毕竟我们很在意那边人的安危，更别提要是让他们搞出大动静，搞不好会把接下来的行动全搅黄了。

你一到那儿就赶紧去阻止他们，别让他们造成永久性破坏。要是发现有友方飞船需要帮忙，你也得搭把手。别指望这帮家伙好对付，但只要你保持冷静，应该还是能摆平他们的。

要是你还缺点动力，那么我特意给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

7f1e662e-4827-4330-a9b9-2cc1b8a3f2c1.titleCn:
看看那儿有啥
[猎头帮 - 巡逻 VLRT]
7f1e662e-4827-4330-a9b9-2cc1b8a3f2c1.description:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the location marker on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of 2 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

- Stows
7f1e662e-4827-4330-a9b9-2cc1b8a3f2c1.descriptionCn:

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Client has requested a discreet contractor to infiltrate an ASD research site, locate a group of servers, and destroy the information stored on them permanently.

The client was able to share the location of the servers within the facility: the Control Center in the Engineering wing. The site has officially been shuttered, but there still may be hostile forces there. Be on your guard.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

客户要求一名行事谨慎的承包商潜入一个联合科学与开发公司(ASD)的研究站点，找到一组服务器，并永久销毁存储在其中的信息。

客户能够分享设施内服务器的位置：位于工程翼楼的控制中心。该地点已正式关闭，但仍可能存在敌对势力。请保持警惕。

[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 入门]
0e34310d-6843-4572-b04e-6c40594aac0f.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try.

A civilian ship has requested combat support near [LOCATION]. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.

Please be aware. This mission is not a training exercise. This is a real encounter, so please do your best to save the ship in distress.

Good Luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0e34310d-6843-4572-b04e-6c40594aac0f.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民组织正在寻找具有空战狗斗经验的飞行员。如果你想展示自己的技能，这里有一个任务可以给你试试。

有一艘民用飞船在[LOCATION]附近请求战斗支援。前往那里，证明你具备执行这类任务的能力，我们会好好利用你的才能。

请注意，这并不是一次训练演习，而是一次真正的战斗。请尽你最大努力拯救那艘处于困境中的飞船。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

设个陷阱
[猎头帮 - 伏击 入门]
799082e0-971d-46d5-9253-5b1d6aea0bb4.description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a[TARGET] and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently.

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.

你要帮我们设一个陷阱。你看，[LOCATION] 附近有一片辐射云，他们经常从那里飞过。

你去那里，把飞船的引擎关掉藏在云里，一旦看到他们和其他蠢货一起飞，就立刻发动攻击。第一次攻击就靠你一个人了，但我们会派几艘支援飞船来帮忙完成剩下的工作。

作为为我们完成的首次突袭，完成任务后，主承包商会得到[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的额外奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

你去那里，把飞船的引擎关掉藏在云里，一旦看到他们和其他蠢货一起飞，就立刻发动攻击。第一次攻击就靠你一个人了，但我们会派几艘支援飞船来帮忙完成剩下的工作。

作为为我们完成的首次突袭，完成任务后，主承包商会得到[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的额外奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

0aae9359-4b9f-4d9b-af72-1b513594ccc8.titleCn:
设个陷阱
[猎头帮 - 伏击 入门]
0aae9359-4b9f-4d9b-af72-1b513594ccc8.description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a[TARGET] and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently.

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.

[埃克哈特 - 伏击 VLRT]
723d015f-59af-4985-b96f-f2bfe37e05f0.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of our clients has been the victim of consistent harassment so the time has come to send a clear cease-and-desist message by taking out their prized [TARGET].  The lowlife in question follows a fairly predictable routine making them susceptible to an ambush. We’ve identified [LOCATION] as the ideal spot. It features an emission cloud where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting.

By the way, the [TARGET] often flies alone but is sometimes joined by a friend in a single-seat ship. Neither should give you too much trouble, but we have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

我们的一个客户一直遭受持续的骚扰，现在是时候通过采取行动来发出明确的停止骚扰信号了，目标就是他们珍贵的 [TARGET]。那个卑鄙的人有着相当可预测的行踪，这使得他们很容易成为伏击的目标。我们已经确定了 [LOCATION] 作为理想的伏击地点。那里有一片辐射云，你可以在那里关闭飞船隐藏等待时机。

[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 MRT]
33ae888c-ec22-47d2-a276-c29637a9fb75.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [LOCATION] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity
33ae888c-ec22-47d2-a276-c29637a9fb75.descriptionCn:
一艘隶属于繁荣公民的飞船正在尝试将一些物资送往 [LOCATION]，却遭到了不想付钱的收件人的攻击，他们选择了暴力。

9ab245c8-3176-40d5-a46a-c1bc2b2bcfe3.title: Shot in the chaos
9ab245c8-3176-40d5-a46a-c1bc2b2bcfe3.description:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake [LOCATION]. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by [TARGET] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
9ab245c8-3176-40d5-a46a-c1bc2b2bcfe3.descriptionCn:
我老大在找一个可以出手的雇佣兵，猎头帮正打算重新夺回在 [LOCATION]。那里的佣兵已经准备好进行一场漫长的战斗。听着，我们不想杀任何非杀不可的人，所以我们在寻找其他路子。

那里的安保由 [TARGET] 负责，我的判断是如果他被解决掉，其他人就会四散而逃。流一点血总比流很多好，对吧？

- 斯托斯

d6defd29-bd2a-4dcc-92e6-1e681bcf1b83.title: Show Them Who's Boss
d6defd29-bd2a-4dcc-92e6-1e681bcf1b83.description:
Word’s gotten out that we’re expanding into Stanton and a local crew has hit a few of our safe houses. We managed to track the bastards back to some old Hathor mining site.

You up for showing them how the Headhunters handle things? If so, head over to [LOCATION] and show them that we mean business.


- Stows
d6defd29-bd2a-4dcc-92e6-1e681bcf1b83.descriptionCn:
看来消息已经传开了，我们在斯坦顿的扩张行动已经引起了注意。当地的团伙在派罗跳跃点蹲守，然后尾随我们的飞船袭击我们的安全屋。上次袭击中有几个人幸存下来，成功跟踪袭击者回到了一个老旧的哈索尔采矿站。

你准备好展示猎头帮的处事方式了吗？如果是的话，前往 [LOCATION]，把那里的一切活物清除干净。

斯托斯

cd51a295-54b1-4a2e-9371-c4c9b1d0598c.title: Shut Off Power at [LOCATION]
cd51a295-54b1-4a2e-9371-c4c9b1d0598c.description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [LOCATION] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out
cd51a295-54b1-4a2e-9371-c4c9b1d0598c.descriptionCn:

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

d1843f36-f50d-49c1-9a63-f6db86d2a1d6.title: Shutdown CFP’s Comms
d1843f36-f50d-49c1-9a63-f6db86d2a1d6.titleCn:
关掉繁荣公民的通讯
[猎头帮 - 关闭通讯塔]
d1843f36-f50d-49c1-9a63-f6db86d2a1d6.description:
CFP think they’re safe over at [LOCATION] but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a control terminal at the top that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

Stows out.
d1843f36-f50d-49c1-9a63-f6db86d2a1d6.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民以为他们躲在 [LOCATION] 就安全了，但我们早就给他们准备了大礼。你先过去把他们的通讯塔统统关掉，给我们铺平道路。

塔顶应该有个控制终端，你可以用它来关闭通讯塔。只要搞定这个，他们就别想叫援兵了。到时候我们就好好让那些渣渣知道，这个星系到底是谁的地盘。

大多数前哨站都用同样的系统，所以下次你想确保没人来打扰你的时候，这招就派得上用场了。


斯托斯通讯完毕

fcb9926c-86bf-427e-b14b-13ba4e2594a8.title: Shutdown Xenothreat Comm Towers
fcb9926c-86bf-427e-b14b-13ba4e2594a8.titleCn:
关闭异种威胁的通讯塔
[繁荣公民 - 关闭通讯塔]
fcb9926c-86bf-427e-b14b-13ba4e2594a8.description:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to [LOCATION] and find the towers. At the top is a control panel that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
fcb9926c-86bf-427e-b14b-13ba4e2594a8.descriptionCn:
繁荣公民渴望帮助派罗的人民，而这一切都要从把他们从异种威胁的魔爪中解救出来开始。

我们正在准备一支小队渗透进他们的一个前哨站，但需要有人先行潜入摧毁他们的通讯塔。只要那些塔一瘫痪，他们就无法呼叫增援，我们就能顺利推进计划了。

前往 [LOCATION] 找到通讯塔。塔顶有一个控制面板，可以用来关闭它们。

另外，值得注意的是，大多数前哨站都使用类似的系统，所以你会知道如何关闭通讯塔，而不是在执行其他任务时冒险与增援运输船作战。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

f69bcf4b-3307-4d0c-bf54-55e84025e0ad.title: Silence the Xenothreat
f69bcf4b-3307-4d0c-bf54-55e84025e0ad.titleCn:
让异种威胁闭嘴
[猎头帮 - 关闭通讯塔]
f69bcf4b-3307-4d0c-bf54-55e84025e0ad.description:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to [LOCATION] and climb the comm towers there. Should be a control panel at the top you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.

Stows out.
f69bcf4b-3307-4d0c-bf54-55e84025e0ad.descriptionCn:
我们打算给那些异种威胁的混蛋来点狠的，但得聪明点动手。所以先派你进去，把他们的通讯塔干掉，让他们没法叫援兵。你搞定之后，我们就能神不知鬼不觉地进出。

前往 [LOCATION]，爬上那里的通讯塔，塔顶应该有个控制面板，你可以用它把塔关掉。

其实大多数前哨站都这样，与其等他们援军来烦你，不如直接把通讯塔关了省事。不过话说回来，要是你想敲个钟多引几个异种威胁出来遛遛，我也不拦着。


斯托斯通讯完毕

12d202ef-49cb-445f-a732-57b324f40108.title: Silent Strike
12d202ef-49cb-445f-a732-57b324f40108.titleCn:
无声突袭
[猎头帮 - 伏击 LRT]
12d202ef-49cb-445f-a732-57b324f40108.description:
Any interest in taking out a [TARGET] for us?

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by [LOCATION] soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss 3 Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows
12d202ef-49cb-445f-a732-57b324f40108.descriptionCn:
有兴趣帮我们解决掉 [TARGET] 吗？

应该不会太麻烦。我们已经踩好点了，发现他们很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。你只需要藏在附近的辐射云里，就能打他们个措手不及。

目标可能是单枪匹马或带着几个帮手，都是单座战机但空战能力不俗。等交火开始后，我们会派些人手过去支援。

你要是能把这事儿办成了，我会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为报酬。

- 斯托斯

091c4628-7eb7-454c-b73e-09b1145949aa.title: Small Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
091c4628-7eb7-454c-b73e-09b1145949aa.titleCn:
小批量科瓦莱什货物需要追回
[科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 简单 无战斗]
091c4628-7eb7-454c-b73e-09b1145949aa.description:
Hiya,

I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.

This is obviously bad for a number of reasons, and not just because I had to spend 20 minutes getting yelled at. Can you head over to [LOCATION] and see what happened? The original contract called for a ship that could carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers so make sure you've got that and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

Once you've got the cargo, can you make sure it's delivered to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]? Thanks a bunch.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
091c4628-7eb7-454c-b73e-09b1145949aa.descriptionCn:
你好，

我有个客户一早上都在给我发消息，问他们本该收到的那批货去哪儿了。我查了下货物状态，结果发现它正孤零零地停在太空中间一动不动。

这事儿明显很糟，原因不止一个，尤其我还被骂了整整 20 分钟。你能去 [LOCATION] 那儿看看到底出了啥状况吗？原合约要求用一艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，所以你得确保自己有这个运载能力，还得配个重型牵引光束。

等你拿到货后，记得把它送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯哈，多谢啦！

[SIGN_OFF]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

4c894c31-9f32-48a4-8e94-28a879eb174a.title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
4c894c31-9f32-48a4-8e94-28a879eb174a.titleCn: 小批量采矿订单：萨达瑞晶
4c894c31-9f32-48a4-8e94-28a879eb174a.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
4c894c31-9f32-48a4-8e94-28a879eb174a.descriptionCn:
合约：采矿订单
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
我们的一支勘探小队近期确认，位于尼克斯星系基格小行星带中，设有 QV 碎岩站的小行星内部蕴藏一种稀有矿石“萨达瑞晶(Sadaryx)”。

然而，由于这些站点难以抵达，且作业本身风险极高，我们现面向外部采矿队伍招募执行开采任务。

目前尚无法确定萨达瑞晶矿石在站点内的具体分布位置，但建议优先从天然矿物富集的洞穴区域入手。若运气极佳，你甚至可能在仓储区发现由旧时 QV 作业组开采并留下的晶体矿藏。

条款*：
你的船员需进入 QV 碎岩站，采集指定的萨达瑞晶，并将其运送至位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。

此项任务需配备装有采矿附件的多功能工具，并具备基础的手动采矿技能。

我方勘探小队报告称，这些站点可能已被不法分子渗透，请务必谨慎行事。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

9982357b-88b4-4f81-b6ae-3446e15cfb77.title: Small Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials
9982357b-88b4-4f81-b6ae-3446e15cfb77.titleCn: 小批量采购订单：手工开采矿石
9982357b-88b4-4f81-b6ae-3446e15cfb77.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."
9982357b-88b4-4f81-b6ae-3446e15cfb77.descriptionCn:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM]

技术预览测试：
完成此任务以获取 Volt 武器的蓝图。在本次测试中，这些蓝图包含若干插槽，可接受不同材料以获得不同的属性调整。

[LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的 mobiGlas 日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。如果你需要复习如何获取这些材料，也可以顺便阅读第一部分《采矿基础 #1：基本概述》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[MULTITOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。"

6357945d-2e51-426f-b183-9c6f84c6a88b.description: Have the pieces to build useful ship for people who like to sneak then fight. Take F8C ship and make even better. Have put what Wikelo will need to build for you. Now you decide. Bye.
6357945d-2e51-426f-b183-9c6f84c6a88b.descriptionCn: 为那些喜欢先偷袭再战斗的人建造有用的船。乘坐 F8C，做得更好。已经放了维科洛给你做好的东西。现在你来决定。再见。

da19d1a7-be72-4fea-803e-880d97ffdbe3.title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
da19d1a7-be72-4fea-803e-880d97ffdbe3.titleCn:

[兑换 - 战神 离子光 维科洛鬼祟版]
da19d1a7-be72-4fea-803e-880d97ffdbe3.description: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.
da19d1a7-be72-4fea-803e-880d97ffdbe3.descriptionCn: 星际战斗机离子光好飞船，但它可以更鬼鬼祟祟，对吧？当你射击他们时让不是你朋友的感到惊讶。我帮你做这个。我需要正确的东西，然后我可以给你。带来给我。再见

ab52c274-a29e-4730-a311-917a271917a8.description:
Want to shoot long away and stay hiding. But it snowing? Wikelo have gun for you.

Bring things. I give.

Bye.
ab52c274-a29e-4730-a311-917a271917a8.descriptionCn:
想要远距离射击并且保持隐藏。但是下雪了？维基洛有枪给你。

带东西来。我给你。

再见

b01b5254-7c99-4273-a67a-3b2432b9b6dc.title: Space Patrol
b01b5254-7c99-4273-a67a-3b2432b9b6dc.titleCn:
空域巡逻
[猎头帮 - 巡逻 MRT]
b01b5254-7c99-4273-a67a-3b2432b9b6dc.description:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available?

All you need to do is head to the location marker on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it.

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip as thanks.

Stows out.
b01b5254-7c99-4273-a67a-3b2432b9b6dc.descriptionCn:
本地金主需要关于咱们地盘的最新情报。不清楚他们在找什么，但我可不打算问太多。我的任务是找个愿意跑一趟、扫描这些地点的人。你有空吗？

你只需要前往 HUD 上的位置标记，进行扫描，如果一切正常，就继续前往下一个点。 如果遇到任何问题，自行解决就行。

这差事听着不赖吧？另外，为了表示感谢，我会给主承包商额外 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

0337e122-6643-4a48-a405-01fd1706b45a.title: Special Recovery Operation
0337e122-6643-4a48-a405-01fd1706b45a.titleCn:
特别回收行动
[繁荣公民 - 取回货物 ERT]
0337e122-6643-4a48-a405-01fd1706b45a.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  [LOCATION] in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
0337e122-6643-4a48-a405-01fd1706b45a.descriptionCn:
我本不该让别人冒这么大的风险，但眼下情况特殊。

我们的飞行员在运送一批关键货物时，遭到了一伙不法分子的袭击。无论如何，绝不能让他们得手。

鉴于袭击者规模庞大，单凭你一人无法完成任务。你必须带上一支技术过硬的队伍，前往 [LOCATION]，击溃这批不法分子并夺回货物。请确保队伍中至少有一人驾驶的飞船能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱，并配备一把 重型牵引光束。

倘若奇迹发生、你真能把这批货物抢回来，请将其运至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。

这要求确实很高，但若你能成功，我本人及整个组织都将对你深表感激。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

b6f42d8b-41be-453d-9368-e856fe577c8e.title: Splintering the Alliance
b6f42d8b-41be-453d-9368-e856fe577c8e.titleCn:
分裂那个联盟
[沃恩 - 刺杀 人民联盟 LRT]
b6f42d8b-41be-453d-9368-e856fe577c8e.description:
I can’t imagine you’ll have much trouble with this, even if it is marginally more challenging than your previous contract. Head to [LOCATION] and take care of People’s Alliance member by the name [TARGET]. My informants tell me they may have an escort or two with them. Nothing you can’t handle, of course.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
b6f42d8b-41be-453d-9368-e856fe577c8e.descriptionCn:
我敢肯定你完成这个任务应该不会遇到太大困难，尽管它可能比你之前的合约稍微复杂一些。前往 [LOCATION]，“照顾”一下那个名叫 [TARGET] 的人民联盟成员。我的线人告诉我，他们可能会有一个或两个护卫。当然，这对你来说不是问题。

此致，
沃恩

55057858-d185-4b9e-b78e-95bc53b5c641.title: Stand Our Ground
55057858-d185-4b9e-b78e-95bc53b5c641.titleCn:
坚守阵地
[猎头帮 - 巡逻 VHRT]
55057858-d185-4b9e-b78e-95bc53b5c641.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.

Stows out.
55057858-d185-4b9e-b78e-95bc53b5c641.descriptionCn:
有些人不爽咱们在这儿混，专门派小队搞咱们的船。敢不敢去几个据点让他们明白——猎头帮可不是吓大的？

从 HUD 上的位置标记开始侦查，完事带你去点其他几个火药桶。出发前最好把家伙事儿备齐。我建议你多带点弹药，再拉上两个朋友一起参与巡逻。

给猎头帮办成这事儿的话，我保证让主承包商多拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 当外快。

- 斯托斯

e498b836-8df6-4674-8500-68b746669b63.title: Standard Cargo Recovery Op.
e498b836-8df6-4674-8500-68b746669b63.titleCn:
标准货物取回行动
[埃克哈特 - 取回货物 MRT]
e498b836-8df6-4674-8500-68b746669b63.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can salvage a messy situation. A client's trusted pilot apparently wasn't so trustworthy and made off with a shipment. But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.

The abandoned ship is located at [LOCATION] and will need a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the goods. A ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to.

Once recovered, deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
e498b836-8df6-4674-8500-68b746669b63.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：取回货物
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

正在寻找一名能妥善处理混乱局面的靠谱承包人。一位受到客户的信任飞行员显然并不值得信赖，竟携带一批货物潜逃了。不过万幸的是，我们的追踪器显示这批货目前处于静止状态，正等着被取走。只要我们行动得当，还有机会及时解决此事。

那艘被抛弃的飞船位于 [LOCATION]，需配备重型牵引光束才能搬运货物。必须使用能装载 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的飞船。另外别忘了，那个叛变的飞行员原本打算把货卖给某些不法分子，他们很可能会找上门来。

成功取回之后，请将其送至 [DESTINATION] 处的货运电梯。

c9654159-acbc-4e5d-8a2c-2db20dd499a7.title: Still Looking for Work?
c9654159-acbc-4e5d-8a2c-2db20dd499a7.description:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.

One of our clients needs support at [LOCATION] where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late.

Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
c9654159-acbc-4e5d-8a2c-2db20dd499a7.descriptionCn:
由于公司重组，福克斯韦尔有一些急需填补的新职位空缺。福克斯韦尔知道你之前曾对这类工作表示过兴趣，我们想知道你是否愿意再次尝试一份合约。

我们的一位客户在 [LOCATION]需要支援，那里的安保部队难以应对不法分子的入侵。前往那里，帮助当地部队在问题失控之前解决它。

成功完成这份合约，福克斯韦尔将很乐意为你提供更多工作机会。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

9bb5529b-54ed-4f46-a37d-634836687ac6.title: Stock Taking
9bb5529b-54ed-4f46-a37d-634836687ac6.description:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at [LOCATION].

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION], then we can sort your payment.

A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.
9bb5529b-54ed-4f46-a37d-634836687ac6.descriptionCn:
我不想给你啰嗦细节，你只需要知道，我们的一个货运员遭到袭击，现在我们的货物正放在 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯上。

怎么把货物拿出来就看你了，但如果在这个过程中顺便解决掉几个竞争对手，我也不会抱怨。一旦你拿到货物，就把它送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯上，然后我们可以给你发报酬了。

带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

88e2b07c-a3e2-40d1-b219-13e06aff1784.title: Stop Attack at [LOCATION]
88e2b07c-a3e2-40d1-b219-13e06aff1784.titleCn:
阻止对 [LOCATION] 的攻击
[猎头帮 - 地点保卫 VHRT]
88e2b07c-a3e2-40d1-b219-13e06aff1784.description:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at [LOCATION], along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto.

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.
88e2b07c-a3e2-40d1-b219-13e06aff1784.descriptionCn:
我们需要的不仅是能进行空中缠斗的人，还要能招募其他人加入猎头帮的事业。我们的行动中心位于 [LOCATION]，所有进出那里的飞船都遭到了敌对势力的袭击。我们急需支援。

说实话，那边的情况很棘手，敌人的火力很猛。所以你得确保物资充足，再找几个信得过的朋友跟你一起飞。等你组好队伍，出发过去，如果那边有任何突发情况，我会及时通知你。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我打算给完成任务的主要承包人额外奖励 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high-profile client decided to tour Nyx system but got jumped by hostile ships around [LOCATION].

Sounds like they’re overwhelmed. Any chance you could head to their location and provide support?

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

680f936a-8877-4210-a259-e0295e37b9d2.title: Stop Attack on Ship
680f936a-8877-4210-a259-e0295e37b9d2.titleCn:
阻止对飞船的攻击
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 碎刃帮 MRT]
680f936a-8877-4210-a259-e0295e37b9d2.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity member who’s new to Nyx took out their ship to tour the system, and ran right into trouble. Based on their comms, it sure sounds like they ventured into Shattered Blade territory, got caught, and are now trying to escape.

They’re putting up a decent fight, but don’t know how long they’ll last without support. Could you go to their aid at [LOCATION] before it’s too late?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
680f936a-8877-4210-a259-e0295e37b9d2.descriptionCn:
一位刚到尼克斯的繁荣公民组织新成员，开着自己的飞船出来游览星系，结果直接撞上了麻烦。根据他们的通讯记录来看，这肯定是在碎刃帮的地盘上惹了事，被抓住了，现在正试图逃跑。

他们抵抗得还不错，但如果没人支援，也不知道能撑多久。你能在事情无法挽回之前赶到 [LOCATION] 去支援他们吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

da99eba1-7365-45dc-94e8-52dbcba867e7.title: Stop Deadly Ship Attack
da99eba1-7365-45dc-94e8-52dbcba867e7.titleCn:
阻止致命的飞船攻击
[埃克哈特 - 保卫飞船 VHRT]
da99eba1-7365-45dc-94e8-52dbcba867e7.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Despite our warnings, a client decided to fly to [LOCATION]. Unsurprisingly, they just dropped a rescue beacon in the area, so we’re looking for a contractor to get on site, assess the situation, and hopefully rescue the client.

We warned them that extremely dangerous and well-equipped outlaws often strike ships there. That’s exactly what I assume happened here, so make sure you plan accordingly.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
da99eba1-7365-45dc-94e8-52dbcba867e7.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

尽管我们发出了警告，但一位客户还是决定飞往 [LOCATION]。不出所料，他们刚刚在该地区释放了一个求救信号，因此我们正在寻找一位承包商前往现场，评估情况，并希望能救出客户。

我们之前就警告过他们，那里经常有装备精良的不法分子袭击飞船。我认为这里发生的情况正是如此，所以请务必做好相应的准备。

报酬将在合约顺利完成后支付。

b5e32df0-1928-42da-896c-737f08b86f9c.title: Stop Gang From Destroying Fuel Tanks
b5e32df0-1928-42da-896c-737f08b86f9c.titleCn:
阻止帮派破坏 [OBJECTS]
[猎头帮 - 保护可摧毁实体 HRT]
b5e32df0-1928-42da-896c-737f08b86f9c.description:
Got word from some allies of ours over at [LOCATION] that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their [OBJECTS].

This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 6 Council Scrip.

- Stows
b5e32df0-1928-42da-896c-737f08b86f9c.descriptionCn:
从 [LOCATION] 的盟友那儿收到消息，说他们正遭到袭击。之前有过交手的帮派想先摧毁他们的 [OBJECTS]，好把地盘抢过去。

这帮人全是些粗鲁的家伙，但来者不善，他们打架也是一把好手。要想不让他们把那边炸个稀巴烂，可得费点功夫。你甚至可以考虑带些帮手过来。

这事儿办漂亮了，我会主承包商发 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

这帮人全是些粗鲁的家伙，但来者不善，他们打架也是一把好手。要想不让他们把那边炸个稀巴烂，可得费点功夫。你甚至可以考虑带些帮手过来。

这事儿办漂亮了，我会主承包商发 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

bfe98ee6-1f93-423e-b93a-a6c3b38c3563.title: Stop Gang From Destroying Fuel Tanks
bfe98ee6-1f93-423e-b93a-a6c3b38c3563.titleCn:
阻止帮派破坏 [OBJECTS]
[猎头帮 - 保护可摧毁实体 HRT]
bfe98ee6-1f93-423e-b93a-a6c3b38c3563.description:
Got word from some allies of ours over at [LOCATION] that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their [OBJECTS].

This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 6 Council Scrip.

- Stows
bfe98ee6-1f93-423e-b93a-a6c3b38c3563.descriptionCn:

4683f665-83d3-4d4a-a26b-5e66a7e0658a.titleCn:
在 [LOCATION] 阻止对手攻击
[猎头帮 - 保护实体并护航 HRT]
4683f665-83d3-4d4a-a26b-5e66a7e0658a.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at [LOCATION]. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the [OBJECTS] there.

I need you and whatever crew you can muster on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any friendly ships that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  4 Council Scrip.

- Stows
4683f665-83d3-4d4a-a26b-5e66a7e0658a.descriptionCn:
有个小帮派一直像根刺扎在我们这儿，那帮混蛋刚在 [LOCATION] 伏击了几个朋友。看样子他们正拼命想毁了那里的 [OBJECTS]。

我要你带上所有你可以召集的船员立刻赶去现场，阻止这些混蛋把一切都炸飞，还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这事办得漂亮的话，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯
