df059c6e-1ad6-4d2a-8e1a-d27bcf46cc1d.title: Stop Rivals from Launching Heist
df059c6e-1ad6-4d2a-8e1a-d27bcf46cc1d.titleCn:
阻止竞争对手发起抢劫
[猎头帮 - 轰炸/破坏服务器 VHRT]
df059c6e-1ad6-4d2a-8e1a-d27bcf46cc1d.description:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to [LOCATION] and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out
df059c6e-1ad6-4d2a-8e1a-d27bcf46cc1d.descriptionCn:
人们什么时候才能明白，他们不能在猎头的地盘上随心所欲？这些白痴正在策划一项大工程，还以为我会让他们逍遥？绝对不可能。

我想让你飞往 [LOCATION]，摧毁他们的燃料罐和数据服务器。让他们看看猎头们对他们的真实看法。

让我们看看他们在那之后还能怎么做。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

679fd34c-a20e-47cf-bf5c-eb713e283510.title: Stop Savage Shattered Blade Attack
679fd34c-a20e-47cf-bf5c-eb713e283510.titleCn:
停止碎刃帮野蛮人的攻击
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 碎刃帮 ERT]
679fd34c-a20e-47cf-bf5c-eb713e283510.description:
One of our convoys got caught in a bad situation and is in desperate need of help. The Shattered Blade launched a brutal attack on our ships in an area that we thought was safe. That convoy is mainly carrying supplies and new recruits. From the comms I’m receiving, they’re putting up a hell of a fight but might not last much longer.

If available, we need you at [LOCATION] ready to go toe-to-toe with some serious forces.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
679fd34c-a20e-47cf-bf5c-eb713e283510.descriptionCn:
我们的一支舰队陷入了危急情况，急需援助。碎刃帮在我们认为安全的区域对我们船只发动了残酷的攻击。这支运输舰队主要运送的是物资和新兵。根据我收到的通讯，他们确实拼死抵抗了，但可能撑不了多久了。

如果你有空的话，我们需要你赶到 [LOCATION]，准备迎战一些来势汹汹的敌人。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

0edd9119-2e67-4141-8a0a-c20703158c8e.title: Stop Shattered Blade Attack
0edd9119-2e67-4141-8a0a-c20703158c8e.titleCn:
阻止碎刃帮的攻击
[埃克哈特 - 保卫飞船 碎刃帮 VLRT]
0edd9119-2e67-4141-8a0a-c20703158c8e.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re getting comms from a client who accidentally disturbed a Shattered Blade deal and are now under attack. Last update I got placed their ship near [LOCATION].

Looking for a contractor who can provide dogfighting support for our client.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
0edd9119-2e67-4141-8a0a-c20703158c8e.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们收到了一位客户的通讯，他们不小心破坏了一笔与碎刃帮的交易，现在正遭到攻击。我得到的最新消息是，他们的飞船就在 [LOCATION] 附近。

我们正在寻找一位能够为我们的客户提供空战支援的承包商。

报酬将在合约顺利完成后支付。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

3786138a-edb9-4c03-922d-9e87674e3b5e.title: Stopping the Competition
3786138a-edb9-4c03-922d-9e87674e3b5e.titleCn:
遏制竞争
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 MRT]
3786138a-edb9-4c03-922d-9e87674e3b5e.description:
Feels like everyone wants a piece of our pie these days. Scouts are reporting that [LOCATION] is crawling with some new gang who've got it in for us.

So let's show them why you don't mess with us. Take out their fuel stores and leave them stranded.

That oughta send a message.

-Stows out
3786138a-edb9-4c03-922d-9e87674e3b5e.descriptionCn:
最近感觉谁都想来分我们一杯羹。侦察兵报告说 [LOCATION] 那边窜出来一帮新帮派，专门跟我们过不去。

那咱们就让他们知道为啥不该惹我们。端掉他们的燃料贮藏，把他们搁浅。

这绝对能给他们长点记性。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

5cc2e2ad-cd00-47b4-bfeb-7d9588ffc501.title: Strategic Bombing
5cc2e2ad-cd00-47b4-bfeb-7d9588ffc501.titleCn:
战略轰炸
[互安防务 - 战术打击群]
5cc2e2ad-cd00-47b4-bfeb-7d9588ffc501.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing:
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.

They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have two power relays activated. These will be your targets as they cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective.

Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.

Good luck,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
5cc2e2ad-cd00-47b4-bfeb-7d9588ffc501.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：碎刃帮
装备规格：战斗级飞船/军械
任务简报：
当地资产显示，碎刃帮的残余势力正试图重建他们的一座空间站，互安正在招募飞行员去阻止这件事。

他们虽然把基础炮台防御重新上线了，但目前只激活了两座能源中继器，这些就是你们的攻击目标。因为能量武器对它们无效，你们得带上实弹武器或军械才能奏效。

要是让这座空间站重新启用，碎刃帮就能借此在这个星系重新站稳脚跟，我们绝不能让他们得逞。

祝好运，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

ceb21809-cd73-49d5-9905-a63f97609be0.title: Stuck Ling Shipment Pending Delivery
ceb21809-cd73-49d5-9905-a63f97609be0.titleCn:
受困的玲家快递货运待交付
[玲家快递 - 取回货物 超级困难 无战斗]
ceb21809-cd73-49d5-9905-a63f97609be0.description:
Hey,

Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.

Can you fly out to [LOCATION] and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.

Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send confirmation to the client.

Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
ceb21809-cd73-49d5-9905-a63f97609be0.descriptionCn:
嘿，

真够背的，我们刚拿下这辈子最大的一单，结果运输船引擎直接卡死了。他们拼了命修，但看样子还是没戏了.

你能飞去 [LOCATION] 帮我们把货带回来吗？这事儿真挺关键的，客户得看到我们跟那些大厂一样靠谱。

顺便说下，这单货量不小，你得开艘能装下 [MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱的大船，再带上一个重型牵引光束才搬得动。等你把货挪到自己船上，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，我们立马给客户发确认。

考虑到现状，谁能干完这个活，我们给的钱绝对比市场价高不少。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

eae3334f-310a-4213-88e5-b84d248cc083.title: Suit Up Take Off
eae3334f-310a-4213-88e5-b84d248cc083.titleCn:
穿搭好再起飞
[兑换 - 顺风 飞行服 统御迷彩]
eae3334f-310a-4213-88e5-b84d248cc083.description: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.
eae3334f-310a-4213-88e5-b84d248cc083.descriptionCn: 飞船拥有巨大的窗户，任何人都能看见你飞行。你必须看起来最好看。维科洛为你准备了非常好的飞行服。进行交易，带给我需要的东西，维科洛就送你这套飞行服。如果你还没有蓝图，也会一起给。

20f88811-570c-4e99-90f1-8af4909f8ef3.title: Supply Order: Sadaryx Focus Lenses
20f88811-570c-4e99-90f1-8af4909f8ef3.titleCn: 供货订单：萨达瑞晶聚焦透镜
20f88811-570c-4e99-90f1-8af4909f8ef3.description:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

TERMS*:
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using Sadaryx crystals and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION] for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
20f88811-570c-4e99-90f1-8af4909f8ef3.descriptionCn:
合约：制造订单
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
倘若您恰巧因其他工作需前往基格小行星带的任意一个 QV 碎岩站，舒宾星际公司非常乐意委托您顺带获取一批难以获取的采矿激光聚焦透镜。

条款*：
尽管部分聚焦透镜或可从 QV 碎岩站的仓储区回收，但您很可能仍需利用萨达瑞晶，并借助站点内的透镜制造器自行生产。尽管该矿石稀有，但这些碎岩站通常蕴藏可直接用带采矿附件的多功能工具开采的萨达瑞晶矿石。

请将获取到的透镜运送至位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处，以供后续处理。

据承包商反馈，这些站点可能已被不法分子渗透，请务必保持警惕。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

6cda8854-d25d-4919-8d3e-c01a9c7009cb.title: Support Client Under Attack
6cda8854-d25d-4919-8d3e-c01a9c7009cb.titleCn:
支援遭受袭击的客户
[埃克哈特 - 保卫飞船 LRT]
6cda8854-d25d-4919-8d3e-c01a9c7009cb.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of our clients got the brilliant idea to test their dogfighting skills in a real world scenario. Doesn’t sound like it’s going well, because they comm’d us asking for some support.

Head to [LOCATION] and help clean up the mess they created.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
6cda8854-d25d-4919-8d3e-c01a9c7009cb.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们的一个客户想出了一个“绝妙”的主意，想在真实现实场景中测试他们的空战狗斗技能。听起来情况不太妙，因为他们已经向我们求救了。

前往 [LOCATION]，帮助他们收拾烂摊子。

报酬将在合约顺利完成后支付。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

510ebed9-4d34-4174-8dd6-15e87635533c.title: Support Ship Under Attack
510ebed9-4d34-4174-8dd6-15e87635533c.titleCn:
支援遭受攻击的飞船
[繁荣公民 - 保卫飞船 碎刃帮 VLRT]
510ebed9-4d34-4174-8dd6-15e87635533c.description:
Received an emergency comm from a ship saying that the Shattered Blade are harassing them. Believe the pilot got their attention by getting a little too close to their territory. The pilot admitted that they don’t have a lot of combat experience, so I’m not sure how much longer they can hold out.

Could you head to [LOCATION] now to help them survive the attack?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
510ebed9-4d34-4174-8dd6-15e87635533c.descriptionCn:
收到一艘飞船的紧急通讯，说碎刃帮正在骚扰他们。看来是飞行员太靠近他们的地盘，引起了对方注意。飞行员自己也承认战斗经验不足，所以我不确定他们还能撑多久。

你能现在就去 [LOCATION] 帮助他们顶住这次攻击吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfd8a72e-ebde-4a88-a787-544e34632eb4.title: Surprise Party
cfd8a72e-ebde-4a88-a787-544e34632eb4.titleCn:
惊喜派对
[猎头帮 - 伏击 VLRT]
cfd8a72e-ebde-4a88-a787-544e34632eb4.description:
Some numskull flying a [TARGET] was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.

There’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.
cfd8a72e-ebde-4a88-a787-544e34632eb4.descriptionCn:
有个二五仔开着 [TARGET] 刺探咱们行动。上次轰走时警告过，结果这货又换地方继续偷窥。既然听不懂人话，那就送份“大礼”。

他们在 [LOCATION] 附近辐射云经常出没。关引擎藏好搞突袭最合适——有时候单飞，有时候带几架小飞机。第一波得靠你，不过咱在附近安排了支援船收尾。

如果你还需要点额外的动力，任务结束后主承包商还能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 。

- 斯托斯

a953c754-e864-4732-903e-a82db5df5271.title: Surprise Party
a953c754-e864-4732-903e-a82db5df5271.titleCn:

3fb7df8f-e1ee-4557-9105-5ab137abdf33.title: Suspect Apprehension Certification
3fb7df8f-e1ee-4557-9105-5ab137abdf33.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
3fb7df8f-e1ee-4557-9105-5ab137abdf33.descriptionCn:
嗨，

希望你不介意，但我知道你在赏金猎人工会的情况，并想看下你有没有兴趣和我们北境之岩服务团队签订合约，我们是星系内评价最高的私人安保公司之一。

如果你有的话，首先需要你去完成一份临时嫌犯逮捕合约。与其说是评断，其实更像是次机会，来确保我们能有良好的共事关系。

你要找的嫌犯名叫 [TARGET]。他们可是出了名的难以捉摸，所以对你来说会有些困难。

希望尽快收到你的消息，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

69fbad01-0ca8-4910-8c03-d0f73895df00.title: Sweep and Clear Location
69fbad01-0ca8-4910-8c03-d0f73895df00.description:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at [LOCATION]. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit.

I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
69fbad01-0ca8-4910-8c03-d0f73895df00.descriptionCn:
正在寻找愿意在 [LOCATION] 清理垃圾的人。看来一个帮派未经业主许可就驻扎在那里。所以他们雇佣我们以我们认为合适的方式将他们赶出去。

如果我是你，我会带上充足的弹药。我估计他们不会自愿离开。

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

f0462a38-f7ef-4ad6-9bf8-cceb6704d1b1.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
f0462a38-f7ef-4ad6-9bf8-cceb6704d1b1.titleCn: 清理一些繁荣公民的聚集地
f0462a38-f7ef-4ad6-9bf8-cceb6704d1b1.description:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGET]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
f0462a38-f7ef-4ad6-9bf8-cceb6704d1b1.descriptionCn:
我收到了判官的消息，要求我们夺回一些被繁荣公民控制的前哨站。他们有点生气，他们认为繁荣公民在这个星系中占据的地盘太多，同时还觉得这让猎头帮显得很软弱。

在 [LOCATION] 附近发现了几个可以清扫的目标。更妙的是，那里安保负责人是 [TARGET]。不确定你是否听说过他们，但上个月他们干掉了几名平民，所以这简直是双赢的局面。我们不仅能夺回一些领土，还能教训一个欠揍的人。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

d15bbff1-08f4-422a-8677-72a413cacd31.title: Tactical Strike
d15bbff1-08f4-422a-8677-72a413cacd31.titleCn:
战术打击
[猎头帮 - 伏击 VHRT]
d15bbff1-08f4-422a-8677-72a413cacd31.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.
d15bbff1-08f4-422a-8677-72a413cacd31.descriptionCn:
有些人就是见不得咱们好。有线报说几艘次主力舰带着护航队在搞咱们。先下手为强总比等着挨揍强。

发现他们的 [TARGET] 经常经过 [LOCATION] ——这地方天生就是打埋伏的料。边边上的辐射云能藏住你和带来的帮手。

丑话说前头：这活儿不轻松。但赏金绝对对对得起卖命钱。活干完主承包商就能拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

再说了，天知道那些残骸里能捞出什么宝贝。

- 斯托斯

24ac3c24-ed16-43f5-bb1c-626f0261fcb5.title: Tactical Strike Group Needed
24ac3c24-ed16-43f5-bb1c-626f0261fcb5.titleCn:
需要战术打击群
[互安防务 - 战术打击群]
24ac3c24-ed16-43f5-bb1c-626f0261fcb5.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing:
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site.

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will need  ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station and ultimately get boots on the ground to save their pilot.

Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will need a variety of ship types to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
24ac3c24-ed16-43f5-bb1c-626f0261fcb5.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：碎刃帮
装备规格：打击群
任务简报：
我们收到消息，一艘名为宁静号的人民联盟安保飞船意外发现碎刃帮藏匿于一个旧的 QV 采矿站中。细节尚不明确，但一旦抵达现场，我们将为你连接到当地资产。

互安防务正在寻找一支团队介入并保护宁静号及其人员。根据与宁静号船长的讨论，你将需要实弹武器和爆炸物来突破该空间站的防御，并最终派遣地面部队前往营救其飞行员。

招募额外的飞船以支援你执行此任务至关重要。你需要多种类型的飞船，以便在太空和地面的多个作战区域之间保持平衡。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

6be5ec49-82a9-43e8-9688-ff5e88011e37.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
6be5ec49-82a9-43e8-9688-ff5e88011e37.titleCn:
消灭繁荣公民的燃料供应
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 繁荣公民 LRT]
6be5ec49-82a9-43e8-9688-ff5e88011e37.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life.

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet.

Go to [LOCATION] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out
6be5ec49-82a9-43e8-9688-ff5e88011e37.descriptionCn:
似乎我每天醒来都免不了听到我的人抱怨繁荣公民让他们的生活有多困难。

最终我们会把那些自以为是的“好人”从这个星系赶出去，但我现在就想要一点安静。

去 [LOCATION] 毁掉繁荣公民在那里的燃料储备。这样至少能让他们暂时不来干扰我们。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

ada151a3-41e3-4050-8bd4-3a2741cd87c2.title: Take Outlaws at [LOCATION] Offline
ada151a3-41e3-4050-8bd4-3a2741cd87c2.titleCn: 让 [LOCATION] 的不法分子下线
ada151a3-41e3-4050-8bd4-3a2741cd87c2.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at [LOCATION] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity.

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion.

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
ada151a3-41e3-4050-8bd4-3a2741cd87c2.descriptionCn:
我们得知在 [LOCATION] 的不法分子开始招募新成员以期对繁荣公民发起袭击。

为了在局势失控之前有所缓和，我们希望你能失效他们的发电机，阻止他们的扩张。

成功完成这项任务可能会拯救很多生命。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

3f935c05-ad23-41df-9c74-fb900e917960.title: Taking back from the Headhunters
3f935c05-ad23-41df-9c74-fb900e917960.description:
We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to [LOCATION] and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters.

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by [TARGET], a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and [TARGET] taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
3f935c05-ad23-41df-9c74-fb900e917960.descriptionCn:
我们目前正在寻找任何合格且有空的安全人员前往 [LOCATION]，夺回被猎头帮占领的繁荣公民设施。

目前占领该前哨站的团伙由 [TARGET] 领导，这个猎头帮成员在对当地居民和繁荣公民志愿者的攻击历史有名。

我们需要确保所有猎头帮成员都被控制，并消灭 [TARGET]。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

37fec822-b34b-4fa3-bd11-793a601073a3.title: Taking Back Our Goods
37fec822-b34b-4fa3-bd11-793a601073a3.titleCn:
拿回我们的货
[死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 HRT]
37fec822-b34b-4fa3-bd11-793a601073a3.description:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at [LOCATION] so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need a heavy-duty tractor beam to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

-Twitch
37fec822-b34b-4fa3-bd11-793a601073a3.descriptionCn:
几个不知天高地厚的暴发户半路伏击了我的运输队。追踪器显示咱们的船还停在 [LOCATION]，你赶紧去把货捞回来，得靠重型牵引光束把东西从船上拖走。

我打赌那帮揍咱们的人还蹲在那儿等着。拿上武器，还有你兄弟，要是能就帮我给他们来上几发。

货拿到手，就直接送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我这边给你结账。

- 刺痛

cbb6e53a-ff56-440d-b35c-0756d437ef74.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
cbb6e53a-ff56-440d-b35c-0756d437ef74.titleCn: 摧毁一个异种威胁藏身处
cbb6e53a-ff56-440d-b35c-0756d437ef74.description:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGET]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGET] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGET] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
cbb6e53a-ff56-440d-b35c-0756d437ef74.descriptionCn:
我们有个丰厚的任务，适合任何想要赚大钱的强硬人士。在 [LOCATION] 那里，有一片由一个叫 [TARGET] 的家伙控制的异种威胁地盘。如果你在这个星系待得够久，可能听说过 [TARGET]，或者至少见过他们的手段。这帮杂种总是喜欢在他们走过的地方留下尸体。

无论如何，判官想要把这个区域清理干净，这意味着你得攻击所有三个集群，杀掉你找到的每一个异种威胁。杀得够多，[TARGET] 就藏不住了。

把他们全都解决了，咱们请你喝一杯。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

228ed7e4-ebdb-48b2-9f8e-3f395e27a76b.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
228ed7e4-ebdb-48b2-9f8e-3f395e27a76b.titleCn: 处理掉一些异种威胁的垃圾
228ed7e4-ebdb-48b2-9f8e-3f395e27a76b.description:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
228ed7e4-ebdb-48b2-9f8e-3f395e27a76b.descriptionCn:
刚刚得到了我的判官的批准，可以开始对异种威胁进行反击。我一直在盯着他们控制下的 [LOCATION] 附近的一些地方。

我会给你要攻击的目标，你只需杀掉你找到的所有人就行。真希望我能亲自去，听起来很有趣。

- 斯托斯

fa27d7cb-065b-4049-9a5d-12b2c8c22408.title: Taking what’s ours
fa27d7cb-065b-4049-9a5d-12b2c8c22408.titleCn:
拿回我们的东西
[猎头帮 - 取回货物 LRT]
fa27d7cb-065b-4049-9a5d-12b2c8c22408.description:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at [LOCATION] but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.
fa27d7cb-065b-4049-9a5d-12b2c8c22408.descriptionCn:
我刚截下一艘运货的船，就在 [LOCATION] 那边，但咱自己人飞船装不下，东西堆那儿了。想赚点快钱不？赶紧过去把货弄走，现在那儿说不定已经蹲着几个打捞的了，小心点。

别忘了带个重型牵引光束，那玩意儿沉得要命。

弄完直接拉到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，剩下的交给我们。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

e2876be4-a6c7-48bf-a615-a15425c6158b.title: Taking what’s ours

61134fca-1af9-48dc-802b-1886b8269ca3.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
61134fca-1af9-48dc-802b-1886b8269ca3.description:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts.

We've also gotten word that [TARGET] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up.

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
61134fca-1af9-48dc-802b-1886b8269ca3.descriptionCn:
需要一些喜欢暴力的优秀士兵去攻击位于 [LOCATION] 附近的异种威胁藏身处。如果你有兴趣，我会给你详细信息，但你需要清除两个独立的藏身点。

我们也得到了消息，[TARGET] 正在那附近徘徊。如果你干掉足够多的异种威胁混蛋，他们会露面。

当他们露面时，给他们一枪。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

2f9663f3-ed47-446a-ab0e-ec60526059d3.title: Target at [LOCATION]
2f9663f3-ed47-446a-ab0e-ec60526059d3.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGET] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGET] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
2f9663f3-ed47-446a-ab0e-ec60526059d3.descriptionCn:
在 [LOCATION] 附近有一个巢穴需要清除，那里被一些侵占者占领了。我们对他们大多数人不感兴趣，但有消息传回来，他们正在庇护 [TARGET]，这个家伙有着偷窃猎头帮战利品的悠久历史。是时候解决他们了。

据说 [TARGET] 在一艘船上，但可能依靠基地的防御来保护自己，所以要小心。杀了他们，就能拿到报酬。

你知道的，老规矩。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

1d48bcd0-53d0-4356-9f2b-d05d92c6ac3e.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
1d48bcd0-53d0-4356-9f2b-d05d92c6ac3e.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
1d48bcd0-53d0-4356-9f2b-d05d92c6ac3e.descriptionCn:
事情是这样的，猎头帮想要扩大他们的人才库，现在有几个职位空缺，欢迎任何有胆量的人来应征。

有个家伙名叫 [TARGET]，觉得自己很聪明，从在星系中运输的货船那里偷走货物。我们要求他们支付一部分利润作为运营的许可税。当 [TARGET] 回应时，他们非常无礼。

我们追踪到他们的飞船在 [LOCATION]，需要将他们解决掉。你应该知道，他们很聪明，知道紧靠一些盟友就不会孤立无援。

完成这个任务后，我们将考虑让你参与未来的猎头帮工作。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

6d8aed76-262d-4fe6-9eee-9caee05dad14.title: Target: XenoThreat Attack Group
6d8aed76-262d-4fe6-9eee-9caee05dad14.titleCn:
目标：异种威胁攻击群
[福克斯韦尔 - 异种 攻击伊德里斯]
6d8aed76-262d-4fe6-9eee-9caee05dad14.description:
We have a fix on a XenoThreat Idris with fighter support at [LOCATION]. Their comms discipline's lousy. According to the radio chatter, the Commander's on board the Idris. Can't remember the last time we had such a strong fix on him. This could be a chance to decapitate the whole operation.

Want in?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
6d8aed76-262d-4fe6-9eee-9caee05dad14.descriptionCn:
我们在 [LOCATION] 锁定了一艘带有战斗机支援的异种威胁伊德里斯。他们的通讯纪律极差。根据他们无线里叽叽喳喳讲的，指挥官就在该伊德里斯上。我都记不清上次如此精准锁定他是什么时候了。这可是个一举捣毁整个组织的好机会。

要加入吗？

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

9edb93c0-c11a-46cb-9349-8ccae56a5c59.title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson
9edb93c0-c11a-46cb-9349-8ccae56a5c59.titleCn:
给繁荣公民上一课
[猎头帮 - 多目标轰炸 繁荣公民 LRT]
9edb93c0-c11a-46cb-9349-8ccae56a5c59.description:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves.

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to [LOCATION] and really mess the place up.

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out
9edb93c0-c11a-46cb-9349-8ccae56a5c59.descriptionCn:
每天看起来繁荣公民都在这里试图拉拢更多人加入他们那可怜的事业，这让像我们这样辛勤工作的人生活得更艰难。

我想他们需要一个提醒，告诉他们谁才是真正的掌控者。去 [LOCATION] 那儿，好好把那个地方给搅个天翻地覆。

没有什么比一些财产损失更能传达这个信息了。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

82bbea18-d52b-48bb-b537-9c072f29e283.title: Terminate UEE Threat: [TARGET]
82bbea18-d52b-48bb-b537-9c072f29e283.titleCn:
终结 UEE 的威胁：[TARGET]
[互安防务 - 击杀飞船 VHRT 多波次]
82bbea18-d52b-48bb-b537-9c072f29e283.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: [LOCATION]
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Heavy Gun-Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by [TARGET] has been planning a major strike against vital UEE infrastructure. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.

Gather a suitable amount of support craft and head to the engagement site. There you will have to engage with various squadrons before their leader will deem the situation dire enough to directly lead their forces. It is critical that they be neutralized in order to ensure the attack is stopped.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
82bbea18-d52b-48bb-b537-9c072f29e283.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：[LOCATION]
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：重型炮艇
任务简报：一支由 [TARGET] 率领的不法分子舰队正密谋对重要 UEE 基础设施发动大规模袭击。互安防务已受命在袭击实施前予以遏制。

请集结足够数量的支援舰艇，前往交战区域。您需先击溃多支敌方编队，其首领才会判定局势危急，进而亲自率队参战。务必将其彻底消灭，方能确保此次袭击被彻底阻止。

此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守相关星系的法律。

aabd440e-cbf5-4136-adcf-6b9ca783ac80.title: Terrorist [TARGET] to be Neutralized
aabd440e-cbf5-4136-adcf-6b9ca783ac80.titleCn:
恐怖分子 [TARGET] 该被消灭
[互安防务 - 击杀飞船 LRT]
aabd440e-cbf5-4136-adcf-6b9ca783ac80.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has identified more outlaws who are planning an operation against UEE interests from within Nyx. Your mission will be to neutralize this potential threat before they can enact their plans.

Travel to [LOCATION] and dispatch the leader of these outlaws, [TARGET] without hesitation. We have scouted a small number of ships, but our report suggest these are competent pilots - bringing back up is advised.

Remember that eliminating these outlaws not only serves the people of Nyx, but the UEE too.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
aabd440e-cbf5-4136-adcf-6b9ca783ac80.descriptionCn:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安防务更多打算从尼克斯内部对UEE利益发动行动的不法分子。你的任务是在他们实施计划前，彻底消除这一潜在威胁。

前往 [LOCATION]，毫不犹豫地清除这些不法分子的头目 [TARGET]。我们侦察到少量飞船，但报告指出这些飞行员实力不俗，建议带上支援。

记住，铲除这些不法分子不仅服务于尼克斯的民众，也是为了维护 UEE 的利益。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

318bc17e-1b97-4ba5-a527-0c81076ef811.title: Test Armor
318bc17e-1b97-4ba5-a527-0c81076ef811.titleCn:
测试护甲
[兑换 - 帕拉蒂诺护甲 I 型]
318bc17e-1b97-4ba5-a527-0c81076ef811.description: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.
318bc17e-1b97-4ba5-a527-0c81076ef811.descriptionCn: 带来给我护甲和其他东西并且我给你特殊测试护甲。最初版本。非常特别。带来我就给。再见。

49e03834-2e9c-bebb-87cd-3840679d4a96.title: They Will Be Missed
49e03834-2e9c-bebb-87cd-3840679d4a96.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TARGET] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [LOCATION], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
49e03834-2e9c-bebb-87cd-3840679d4a96.descriptionCn:
一名叫做 [TARGET] 的资深安保人士马上就要在从天而降的暴力之中和他的职业生涯告别了。他们目前驻扎在 [LOCATION]，并且不会很好对付。恐怕你需要费一番功夫才能引他们出来了。

我推荐击杀足够多的手下，他们就别无选择只能亲自出来迎战你。当然了，一旦他们决定露面，事情就很好办了。

你真诚的，
沃恩

494d970a-a73e-af8d-155e-ab608cf65e92.title: They Will Be Missed
494d970a-a73e-af8d-155e-ab608cf65e92.description:
A security officer by the name of [TARGET] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [LOCATION] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms.

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TARGET] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
494d970a-a73e-af8d-155e-ab608cf65e92.descriptionCn:
一位名叫 [TARGET] 的安保官员急需提前退休。他们目前和许多同僚驻派在 [LOCATION]。

请随意发挥你的暴力天赋，但只有 [TARGET] 死了你才能得到信用点和我的感谢。

你真诚的，
沃恩

74ed61ad-2742-4998-9e0b-88655040169f.title: Time to roll on CFP
74ed61ad-2742-4998-9e0b-88655040169f.description:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  [LOCATION] and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.
74ed61ad-2742-4998-9e0b-88655040169f.descriptionCn:
寻找那些手指发痒的人，我们打算在 [LOCATION] 对一些繁荣公民采取行动，然后把它占为己有。不过，你得聪明地处理这件事。主前哨站周围有一堆边远前哨站，所有的都有安保，所以你应该先清除这些边远前哨站，再攻打主基地。

不过，如果你想直接跳进深处然后抵挡所有增援，那就看你自己了。只要能完成任务就行。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

bafaff08-53b0-49de-88fa-1e47525a6734.title: Time to Teach a Lesson
bafaff08-53b0-49de-88fa-1e47525a6734.titleCn:
是时候上一课了
[埃克哈特 - 伏击 LRT]
bafaff08-53b0-49de-88fa-1e47525a6734.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular [TARGET]. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good.

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by [LOCATION] on the regular, which has an emission cloud that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the [TARGET] could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip for the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
bafaff08-53b0-49de-88fa-1e47525a6734.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：飞船伏击
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们的客户一直收到匿名威胁，试图勒索他们。经过我们一番调查，终于追查到一名驾驶 [TARGET] 的家伙，就是他干的。客户希望我们赶在对方金盆洗手之前，彻底解决掉这个敲诈犯。

根据我们的评估，目标并不难对付。他经常经过 [LOCATION]，那里有一片辐射云，正适合你关掉飞船、潜伏待机。目标有时独来独往，但更多时候会有一两艘单座飞船护航。你发动伏击时务必谨慎，否则 [TARGET] 可能会溜走——我们可不能放跑他。一旦动手，我们会通知附近其他承包商赶来支援。

合约完成后立即付款。客户还会额外奖励主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

4cd6d0e4-dd24-446f-9160-e8127d89bb47.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
4cd6d0e4-dd24-446f-9160-e8127d89bb47.titleCn:
聪明反被聪明误
[零比特 - 回收黑匣子 MRT]
4cd6d0e4-dd24-446f-9160-e8127d89bb47.description:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION].

-Bit Zeros
4cd6d0e4-dd24-446f-9160-e8127d89bb47.descriptionCn:
这次我们自作聪明，结果翻车了。人嘛，总得有点梦想对吧？我们本来想把一批加密数据藏进飞船黑匣子，运到咱们的数据据点。为了骗过敌人，还特意在船上堆满“值钱货”当诱饵。结果这招太灵了——东西是唬住人了，可也引来了不该来的人。货全被抢光了，唯独漏了黑匣子。坏消息是，现在那艘船周围全是不法分子，跟蜂窝似的。

那黑匣子里的数据对他们屁用没有，但我们非得拿回来。你要是能帮我们搞到手，分你一大笔，这买卖不亏吧？

去 [LOCATION] 把事儿办了，然后把飞行记录仪送到 [DESTINATION]。

- 零比特

这次我们自作聪明，结果翻车了。人嘛，总得有点梦想对吧？我们本来想把一批加密数据藏进飞船黑匣子，运到咱们的数据据点。为了骗过敌人，还特意在船上堆满“值钱货”当诱饵。结果这招太灵了——东西是唬住人了，可也引来了不该来的人。货全被抢光了，唯独漏了黑匣子。坏消息是，现在那艘船周围全是不法分子，跟蜂窝似的。

那黑匣子里的数据对他们屁用没有，但我们非得拿回来。你要是能帮我们搞到手，分你一大笔，这买卖不亏吧？

去 [LOCATION] 把事儿办了，然后把飞行记录仪送到 [DESTINATION]。

- 零比特

511b35e2-8dd8-46d7-9ee3-3bb173db4bb3.title: Top Tier Operator Needed
511b35e2-8dd8-46d7-9ee3-3bb173db4bb3.titleCn:
需要顶尖行家
[埃克哈特 - 飞船护航 ERT]
511b35e2-8dd8-46d7-9ee3-3bb173db4bb3.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This contract should only be considered by the most capable of pilots. A highly valued client is currently under attack at [LOCATION] and requires immediate extraction. They’re sitting in the hangar ready to leave, but are unable to move until the hostile ships in the area have been neutralized.

I don’t see the outlaws stopping any time soon and our client’s reporting they’re packing high-grade weaponry on their ships. This will be a test of your skill as much as your endurance. Assemble whoever you need and head there immediately to assist them.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
511b35e2-8dd8-46d7-9ee3-3bb173db4bb3.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：护航飞船
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

这份合约只应考虑由最出色的飞行员来执行。目前有一位非常重要的客户在 [LOCATION] 遭到攻击，需要立即撤离。他们已经待在机库里准备出发，但在该区域的敌对飞船被消灭之前无法行动。

我不认为那些不法分子会很快停止行动，而且我们的客户报告说他们的飞船上配备了高级武器。这不仅是对你耐力的考验，也是对你技能的考验。召集你需要的人，立即前往那里协助他们。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

5f54c243-3985-4509-85c1-e5e99665a7f6.title: Track Down [TARGET]
5f54c243-3985-4509-85c1-e5e99665a7f6.description:
Looking to execute a bounty on [TARGET]. We’ve learned that they’re currently hiding out with some confederates at [LOCATION].

I’d be prepared to deal with the lowlifes hanging around [TARGET], but our only real concern is that you land the target.


Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
5f54c243-3985-4509-85c1-e5e99665a7f6.descriptionCn:
我们准备执行对 [TARGET] 的赏金。我们得知他们目前与一些同伙藏身于 [LOCATION]。

我建议你准备好应对围绕在 [TARGET] 附近的低等生物，但我们唯一真正关心的是你能否击倒目标。


马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS:
NOTES: Based on an assessment of your developing abilities, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn your Tracker Beginner's Permit.

This permit would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend Low-Risk Targets (LRT). These criminals traditionally fly smaller ships but typically have a few escorts which makes them more challenging.

To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a LRT ranked criminal by the name of [TARGET] last seen at [LOCATION].

In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

7dfd619c-9977-4788-80bb-5671d221c342.title: Trade Council Scrip for Favors?
7dfd619c-9977-4788-80bb-5671d221c342.titleCn:
用堂会凭证换人情？
[兑换 - 维科洛人情]
7dfd619c-9977-4788-80bb-5671d221c342.description:
If you want other way to get favors from Wikelo, have thing for you. Wikelo have need for scrip given out by Council group. Wikelo not part of thief souli, but has business from time to time.

If you bring scrips to [DESTINATIONS], will trade for favor.

Bye.
7dfd619c-9977-4788-80bb-5671d221c342.descriptionCn:
想要用其他方式获取人情？听好了。维科洛正在收购堂会组织发放的凭证。维科洛不当小偷，但偶尔也得和他们做生意。

把凭证带到 [DESTINATIONS] 来，可以兑换成人情。

再见。

f6717a7c-115e-4e27-8efe-ec8e01b56487.title: Trade Merc Scrip for Favors?
f6717a7c-115e-4e27-8efe-ec8e01b56487.titleCn:
用雇佣兵公会凭证换人情？
[兑换 - 维科洛人情]
f6717a7c-115e-4e27-8efe-ec8e01b56487.description:
Wikelo has another way to get favors if you interested.

Your Mercenary souli has scrip metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to [DESTINATIONS], will trade for favor.

Bye.
f6717a7c-115e-4e27-8efe-ec8e01b56487.descriptionCn:
维科洛有另一种获取人情的方法，如果你感兴趣的话。

你们雇佣兵像人情一样使用一种金属凭证，但用的是维科洛新项目急需的特殊金属。

把凭证带到 [DESTINATIONS] 来，可以兑换成人情。

再见。

8743632c-fac2-4b7c-ae11-a48e683f11fa.title: Trade Worm Parts for Favors?
8743632c-fac2-4b7c-ae11-a48e683f11fa.titleCn:
用蠕虫部位换人情？
[兑换 - 维科洛人情]
8743632c-fac2-4b7c-ae11-a48e683f11fa.description:
Have new way to get favors from Wikelo. Hear much about worm things in radiation storms. Made up of many interesting parts that Wikelo find use for.

If you bring parts to [DESTINATIONS], will trade for favor.

Bye.
8743632c-fac2-4b7c-ae11-a48e683f11fa.descriptionCn:
有跟维科洛获取人情的新方法。听说过很多关于辐射风暴中的蠕虫生物的事。它们由许多维科洛能用得上的有趣部分组成。

如果你把东西带到 [DESTINATIONS]，可以用它们来换取人情。

再见。

6dc85d45-cb88-400f-aabf-dd6c7b9eeb32.title: Trainee Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
6dc85d45-cb88-400f-aabf-dd6c7b9eeb32.titleCn:
需要 [RANK] 级别运输工承接
[CARGO_GRADE] 直达 货物运输
[红风物流 - 一对一货运]
6dc85d45-cb88-400f-aabf-dd6c7b9eeb32.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
6dc85d45-cb88-400f-aabf-dd6c7b9eeb32.descriptionCn:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员来负责从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯转运废料到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你有一艘能处理最大尺寸为 [MAX_SCU] 的集装箱的飞船，这应该没什么问题。也别把你最干净的飞船带来。

不过也有好的一面，当不法分子看到你运送的东西时，他们很可能会对你放手一马。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

a37c4dca-a6cc-4136-a71a-69ddd45dffc1.title: Trapping a Rat
a37c4dca-a6cc-4136-a71a-69ddd45dffc1.titleCn:
困住“老鼠”
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 VHRT]
a37c4dca-a6cc-4136-a71a-69ddd45dffc1.description:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.

Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at [LOCATION]. If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out
a37c4dca-a6cc-4136-a71a-69ddd45dffc1.descriptionCn:
我有个收拾某个卑鄙小人的打算，需要你搭把手。

有个客户赖账，现在居然决定彻底耍赖不付钱了。我收到消息，这货正躲在 [LOCATION] 那儿。你要是能把他们的燃料罐给炸了，他们除了重新考虑自己糟糕决定之外别无选择。

不过千万别小瞧这号混蛋。他们虽然蠢，但也不傻，你懂我意思吧？听说那地方到处都是飞船和炮塔，除非你是脑子进水的大白痴，否则肯定得带点帮手去才行。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

80a7c19b-3856-434e-846d-e2966df891d6.title: Treat yourself to a fight
80a7c19b-3856-434e-846d-e2966df891d6.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGET] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
80a7c19b-3856-434e-846d-e2966df891d6.descriptionCn:
又有一个帮派试图出手，想要占领一些领地。他们失败了，但猎头帮可不会忘记。我们已经拿下了大部分人，但最后一个成员名叫 [TARGET] 最近被发现正在 [LOCATION] 附近飞行。

他们很可能孤注一掷，所以在战斗中别小看他们。

完成后你会收到报酬。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

39b8b980-0092-46cf-83a5-0b68cd5e273f.title: Tricky Ambush
39b8b980-0092-46cf-83a5-0b68cd5e273f.titleCn:
棘手的伏击
[埃克哈特 - 伏击 HRT]
39b8b980-0092-46cf-83a5-0b68cd5e273f.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a [TARGET] which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the [TARGET] is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft.

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an emission cloud that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
39b8b980-0092-46cf-83a5-0b68cd5e273f.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：飞船伏击
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

寻找一位能招募副手协助伏击的靠谱承包商。目标是一艘 [TARGET]，这个目标已经参与了几次针对我们最重要客户的行动。彻底消灭它之后将大大减轻我们客户的麻烦。虽然 [TARGET]是我们的主要目标，但它通常会带着大量的护卫舰只（包括大型飞船）出行。

我们得到消息，这个团伙很快会经过 [LOCATION]。你有没有可能加快速度赶到那里？那个地方有一片辐射云，你可以利用它让飞船停下来并藏起来。等他们经过时，你就能占尽上风。

合约完成后立即付款。客户知道这活儿不好干，所以额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证作为奖金，直接给主承包商。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

3b4eefca-9480-4fd6-9afa-ac5898e39414.title: Turf War
3b4eefca-9480-4fd6-9afa-ac5898e39414.description:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.
3b4eefca-9480-4fd6-9afa-ac5898e39414.descriptionCn:
我们的一位法官打听到了异种威胁试图侵入我们领土的风声。 看起来他们正试图抢夺 [LOCATION]。 我们不想让这帮神经病在该星系中获得更多的立足点，因此我们将采取一些措施来让他们退缩。

我们希望你狠狠的教训一下他们。 直到整个地点都变成墓地之前，不要放松。 一旦他们的尸体准备好入土，我们就会向您发送报酬。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

1141c381-b38d-47af-b8eb-9b8a35985a8e.title: Turn Things to Favor
1141c381-b38d-47af-b8eb-9b8a35985a8e.titleCn:
东西换人情
[兑换 - 维科洛人情]
1141c381-b38d-47af-b8eb-9b8a35985a8e.description:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out favors, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to [DESTINATIONS] and will trade for favor.

Bye.
1141c381-b38d-47af-b8eb-9b8a35985a8e.descriptionCn:
也许维科洛没有你想要的东西（这很奇怪，但没关系）。老商会会发放 人情，这是证明你为我工作的好方式。收集足够的人情，等我有你想要的东西时再来交换。

把东西带到 [DESTINATIONS]，我会用人情来交换。

再见。

4d29fdec-214f-ebb0-ef3b-eaa6fe55ef8f.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
4d29fdec-214f-ebb0-ef3b-eaa6fe55ef8f.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [LOCATION] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TRANSITNAMESHORT] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [LOCATION] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.
4d29fdec-214f-ebb0-ef3b-eaa6fe55ef8f.descriptionCn:
您马上就要完成本教程了。接下来就该起飞了！

既然您已经处理完了 [LOCATION] 的事务，那么是时候离开城市了——接下来还会离开这颗星球。请前往 [TRANSITNAMESHORT] 乘坐穿梭机，这些穿梭机可以带您前往 [LOCATION] 各地。不过当前您的目的地是空港，在那里会有一艘铁砧航天的 C8 双鱼座临时供您使用。

这艘方正小巧的探索船是艘很棒的新手船，非常适合想要展翅高飞的新手驾驶员们使用。

这艘方正小巧的探索船是艘很棒的新手船，非常适合想要展翅高飞的新手驾驶员们使用。

4100207e-d415-6136-fec0-c1aa7377e6aa.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
4100207e-d415-6136-fec0-c1aa7377e6aa.description:

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

4a46f42a-2a96-2b94-6233-490d5e7febbd.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
4a46f42a-2a96-2b94-6233-490d5e7febbd.titleCn: 教程 - 你的第一次出行
4a46f42a-2a96-2b94-6233-490d5e7febbd.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.
4a46f42a-2a96-2b94-6233-490d5e7febbd.descriptionCn:
干得漂亮！

在完成了教程的第一部分后，您现在应该对基础移动控制、自身饥渴状态管理、还有一些mobiGlas的核心功能——即合约管理和日志都有所了解了。

接下来的部分将会帮您熟悉一下 [LOCATION]，并带您去逛一下 [LOCATION] 的武器店 [STORENAME]。

您可以使用联合地球信劵（UEC）在这些商店中进行购物。在星际公民的阿尔法测试阶段，我们会使用名为aUEC（阿尔法联合地球信劵）的货币。这是一种专门用于测试游戏内经济和平衡系统的临时货币。

46d8f3d1-d185-4ee4-bff7-060ecbb37a85.title: Tutorial - Your First Steps
46d8f3d1-d185-4ee4-bff7-060ecbb37a85.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space.

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.
46d8f3d1-d185-4ee4-bff7-060ecbb37a85.descriptionCn:
恭喜您，迈出了探索宇宙的第一步！

在接下来的教程里，您将会学习如何在太空中以及在地面徒步探索宇宙。

首先我们会帮您熟悉一些基础移动操作，并在您仍身处“胶囊公寓”（或是住宅）中时熟悉一下mobiGlas的使用方法。请跟随 您的 HUD（抬头显示）上的目标与提示来继续完成本任务。

c55c9f61-84d9-4180-8715-eab2fe524deb.titleCn:
升级的无畏
[兑换 - 无畏 维科洛工作版]
c55c9f61-84d9-4180-8715-eab2fe524deb.description: If you are looking for Intrepid ship that more intrepid. Wikelo can help. Bring things and you will get special touches on ship by Wikelo and pretty new coat to it. Bye.
c55c9f61-84d9-4180-8715-eab2fe524deb.descriptionCn: 你找比无畏飞船更无畏的船吗。维科洛能帮忙。带上你的东西，你的船维科洛给你特别照顾。还有新外观，漂亮得很。再见。

75e1adf8-3ad2-4c41-8026-40464a0de1f1.title: Urgent - Ship Under XenoThreat Attack
75e1adf8-3ad2-4c41-8026-40464a0de1f1.titleCn:
紧急 - 飞船遭到异种威胁攻击
[福克斯韦尔 - 异种 保卫飞船]
75e1adf8-3ad2-4c41-8026-40464a0de1f1.description:
A distress beacon came in from [LOCATION] about a ship under attack from XenoThreat. The pilot reports that their shields are failing and they can't outrun the attackers.

The ship's a [SHIP], but the pilot's Human, which  according to XenoThreat's twisted way of thinking, makes them a traitor to Humanity and a target for their hate.

We're looking for operators to head out there and do some good.

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
75e1adf8-3ad2-4c41-8026-40464a0de1f1.descriptionCn:
来自 [LOCATION] 的求救信标显示，一艘飞船正遭到异种威胁的攻击。飞行员报告称，其护盾即将失效，且无法摆脱追兵。

该飞船是一艘 [SHIP]，但驾驶员是人类。在异种威胁那扭曲的思维中，这使其被视为人类的叛徒，从而成为他们仇恨的目标。

我们正在寻找行动人员前往该处，做点好事。

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

82e38ec9-3066-4aac-9363-608a4d67383c.title: URGENT FLEET REFUEL
82e38ec9-3066-4aac-9363-608a4d67383c.titleCn:
紧急舰队补油
[旅者联合 - 燃料补给 多飞船 MRT]
82e38ec9-3066-4aac-9363-608a4d67383c.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a big one. An entire little fleet of ships all burned out of fuel at the same time. Impressive coordination and lack of planning at the same time.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and  [QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum , and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
82e38ec9-3066-4aac-9363-608a4d67383c.descriptionCn:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次是个大单子。整支小型舰队的飞船同时燃油耗尽。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按氢燃料每 SCU [FUELRATE] aUEC 和量子燃料每 SCU [QTFUELRATE] aUEC 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

435f61ae-433e-9d9c-28f7-a6f6b8530895.title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
435f61ae-433e-9d9c-28f7-a6f6b8530895.description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [LOCATION] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard.

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters.

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
435f61ae-433e-9d9c-28f7-a6f6b8530895.descriptionCn:
一位行政客户刚刚向我们发出求救信号，他们的 890 跃动在 [LOCATION] 被拦截并被不法分子登上了船。因为船上存了一些比较敏感的私人数据，所以他们更希望能私下处理这个问题。

你的首要任务是把不法分子以最快的速度清理掉，这样一支救援小组就能派遣过去把船返还给船主。让这些非法之徒控制这艘船的时间越长，它被抢走的可能性就越大。为了能更快速的解决问题，我建议你组织一个特勤小组来执行此任务。

需要注意的一点是，船上所有幸存的船员都在船上的私人安全部队的保护下坐救生艇安全逃离了。不过，现在船上的状况仍然无法确定，为了以防万一，执行任务的时候请务必留意是否还有友军，以免误伤。

还有，如果可能的话，我们的客户会“非常乐意”看到你能把飞船内的数据保护下来不被盗走。如果你能成功阻止这些机密数据以远程传输的方式被盗走，会有一笔非常丰厚的额外奖金等着你。

如果换作是我的话，我会尽全力完成这位客户的要求让他满意。

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

0ada3f08-3f76-46ec-96e2-fc0f856b8eeb.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
0ada3f08-3f76-46ec-96e2-fc0f856b8eeb.titleCn:
UWC 正在招募加油员
[旅者联合 - 燃料补给 入门]
0ada3f08-3f76-46ec-96e2-fc0f856b8eeb.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refuelling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refuelling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.

A Club member has run out of fuel at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and  [QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum . As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called ""Refueling Protocols"" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

嘿！

我是来自旅者联合俱乐部的 DD。

UWC 在全 UEE 范围内提供维修、补给和加油服务。碰巧我们正在寻找新的合作伙伴，只要你的飞船配备了加油设备。如果你拥有燃料吊舱，并且喜欢被人热情迎接，那么 UWC 可能很适合你来。

如果你觉得这不错，那我手头正好有一个正在运行的信标你可能喜欢。

如果你确实喜欢它，那么给你一个提醒：出发前务必确保燃料吊舱已满。

Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit

Once accepted, head over to the old QV Planet Services Logistics station and we’ll be in touch.

Deacon Tobin

016fd75d-9d75-4a91-9f34-303e43fd9eee.titleCn:
验证罪犯的死讯：[TARGET]
[霍克罗 - 寻找尸体 ERT]
016fd75d-9d75-4a91-9f34-303e43fd9eee.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP70001
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
In need of a highly competent operator for a special assignment. A highly dangerous outlaw that has been evading local authorities for some time has been reported to have been involved in a large-scale ship battle, resulting in their supposed death. Our client wishes to confirm that they have been neutralized.

Contract Investigator Actions:
We require you to head to [LOCATION] locate [TARGET]’s body and confirm their death.

Additional Notes:
Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.
016fd75d-9d75-4a91-9f34-303e43fd9eee.descriptionCn:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP70001
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
我们需要一名能力出众的调查员来执行一项特殊任务。据报告，一名一直逃避当地当局的极端危险的不法分子参与了一场大规模的飞船战斗，据信已经死亡。我们的客户希望确认此人确实已被消灭。

合约调查员的行动：
你需要前往 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGET] 的尸体并确认其死亡。

补充说明：
鉴于现场可能存在极具攻击性和危险性的敌对势力，建议进行充分的准备。请做好相应的武装准备，并考虑带上其他技术娴熟的飞行员一同前往。

989ee6ef-1323-4b03-844d-c9b1c48a9201.title: Verify Deceased Criminal: [TARGET]

989ee6ef-1323-4b03-844d-c9b1c48a9201.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP70001
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

In need of a highly competent operator for a special assignment. A highly dangerous outlaw that has been evading local authorities for some time has been reported to have been involved in a large-scale ship battle, resulting in their supposed death. Our client wishes to confirm that they have been neutralized.

Contract Investigator Actions:
We require you to head to [LOCATION] locate [TARGET]’s body and confirm their death.

Additional Notes:
Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.

案件文档 #MP70001

我们需要一名能力出众的调查员来执行一项特殊任务。据报告，一名一直逃避当地当局的极端危险的不法分子参与了一场大规模的飞船战斗，据信已经死亡。我们的客户希望确认此人确实已被消灭。

你需要前往 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGET] 的尸体并确认其死亡。

740afbe2-c8a2-442e-b9dc-3261c33f0851.title: VIP Client Needs Protection
740afbe2-c8a2-442e-b9dc-3261c33f0851.titleCn:
VIP 客户需要保护
[埃克哈特 - 飞船护航 HRT]
740afbe2-c8a2-442e-b9dc-3261c33f0851.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In need of a contractor who can report in now. A client has found themselves in hot water over at [LOCATION] and a protection detail to get away from an asteroid base. They’ve reported multiple, well-armed hostile ships meaning you’ll need a crew of your own to deal with them. Based on the client’s account, these attackers seem highly motivated so they will likely not back down easily.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
740afbe2-c8a2-442e-b9dc-3261c33f0851.descriptionCn:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：护航飞船
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

急需一名能立刻报道的承包商。一位客户在 [LOCATION] 遇上了麻烦，需要护送离开小行星基地。他们报告称有数艘装备精良的敌对飞船，因此你必须组建团队来应对。根据客户描述，这些攻击者动机强烈，很可能不会轻易退缩。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

9c39b45d-0824-40af-adf0-f4ea54617ced.title: Vital Resources Needed For Research
9c39b45d-0824-40af-adf0-f4ea54617ced.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: saldynium, jaclium, and carinite.

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
9c39b45d-0824-40af-adf0-f4ea54617ced.descriptionCn:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏三种对实验至关重要的资源：烁迪银, 杰金, 和 科力晶 而受阻。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

尽管我们尚未进行彻底扫描，但我们的团队坚信，哈索尔已经废弃得轨道激光平台建造在这些资源浓度较高的区域之上。重新激活这些轨道激光平台可能是获取我们所需资源的最佳希望。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

67855b20-0a46-4464-87c1-bc6fcbf412ce.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
67855b20-0a46-4464-87c1-bc6fcbf412ce.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TARGET] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
67855b20-0a46-4464-87c1-bc6fcbf412ce.descriptionCn:
你知道我们是谁，你知道我们在做什么。星系有点拥挤，所以我们在寻找一些优秀的士兵来帮助我们在这里立足。

如果你愿意，也不介意弄脏手，我们有办法证明你具备我们所需要的素质。

82a0d506-def3-4ab5-b0e0-8833c7102f34.titleCn:
想要北极星吗？需要点特别的东西。
[兑换 - 北极星点数]
82a0d506-def3-4ab5-b0e0-8833c7102f34.description:
Wikelo need large amounts of quantainium and is willing to give you nice Polaris in exchange but also know many humans not have much space, so you trade as you go. Wikelo will you Polaris bits if you want trade quantainium. Work like favors. Help Wikelo remember how much you give.

Bring quantainium to [DESTINATIONS] and will trade for bits.

Bye.
82a0d506-def3-4ab5-b0e0-8833c7102f34.descriptionCn:
维科洛需要大量量子矿物，愿意用很棒的北极星交换，但也知道人类大多没有足够的空间，所以可以分批次交易。只要你想要北极星，维科洛就愿意用北极星点数来换量子矿物。就像人情。帮维科洛记住你给了多少。

把量子矿物送到[DESTINATIONS]，就能换沉点数

再见。

8d7849fe-85c5-4c63-9754-a71bae57792f.title: Want Taurus ship
8d7849fe-85c5-4c63-9754-a71bae57792f.titleCn:
想要金牛座飞船
[兑换 - 金牛座 维科洛战争版]
8d7849fe-85c5-4c63-9754-a71bae57792f.description: Wikelo came across plans to build Constellation Taurus ship. Nice ship, but Wikelo make a little better. Prettier too. If you want, bring stuff.
8d7849fe-85c5-4c63-9754-a71bae57792f.descriptionCn: 维科洛偶然得到了造金牛座的计划。这船不错，但维科洛能造得更好，还更漂亮。如果你有兴趣，可以带点材料过来。

f2b6ac4d-2cc7-44b8-a798-8d6feda8d174.title: Wanted: [TARGET]
f2b6ac4d-2cc7-44b8-a798-8d6feda8d174.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TARGET]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all.

We've gotten word that [TARGET] was spotted flying near [LOCATION] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
f2b6ac4d-2cc7-44b8-a798-8d6feda8d174.descriptionCn:
我们终于得到了许可，可以干掉 [TARGET] 了。自从他们几年前来到这个星系以来，他们一直让我们头疼，现在是时候彻底解决他们了。

我们得知 [TARGET] 最近在 [LOCATION] 附近飞行，判官希望现在就处理这件事。

bb8df7e6-c453-4320-8f48-0e7bd6eb5a07.description:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named [TARGET] just came out of hiding and was spotted at [LOCATION].

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure [TARGET] doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.
bb8df7e6-c453-4320-8f48-0e7bd6eb5a07.descriptionCn:
事情是这样的，我们刚收到消息，一个名叫 [TARGET] 的异种威胁大佬刚刚现身，并在 [LOCATION] 被发现。

猎头帮已经渴望把这个家伙送进地府好几个月了，所以我们对前哨站发起了攻击，但判官希望确保 [TARGET] 不会溜走，因此想用你作为保障。

在战区里应该很难击杀他，但如果你成功，我们会支付报酬。

14335426-0b72-4819-bfcb-f43b735cd22e.title: Wasting Their Stockpile
14335426-0b72-4819-bfcb-f43b735cd22e.titleCn:
耗尽他们的囤货
[猎头帮 - 轰炸 HRT]
14335426-0b72-4819-bfcb-f43b735cd22e.description:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at [LOCATION]. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out
14335426-0b72-4819-bfcb-f43b735cd22e.descriptionCn:
听着，猎头帮从不把时间浪费在鸡毛蒜皮的报复上，但我也绝不会任由这种胡闹继续下去。

有个混蛋干掉了我不少船员，还到处吹嘘这事。我听说那个没脑子的家伙还在 [LOCATION] 囤积了大量量子燃料。我想看看当你飞过去把他们建的一切烧成平地时，他们该怎么应对这真正的“发火”。哦对了，就凭他们在那儿聚集的火力，你一个人飞过去可不明智，最好带上团队一起行动。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

94bdfda2-a4d9-4d1a-877b-68518eedf320.title: What is Terrapin?
94bdfda2-a4d9-4d1a-877b-68518eedf320.titleCn:
水龟是啥？
[兑换 - 水龟 医疗 维科洛拯救者版]
94bdfda2-a4d9-4d1a-877b-68518eedf320.description:
Wikelo not know this Human word but ship is very useful when things go danger. If you want, can give new version of it. Maybe more useful?

You fly and tell. Bye.
94bdfda2-a4d9-4d1a-877b-68518eedf320.descriptionCn:
维科洛不知道这个人类词语，但这艘船在危险时刻非常有用。如果你想要，可以给你个新版的。也许更有用？

你去飞一下然后告诉我。再见。

758e6b6a-f89e-4721-ae9e-1ec27d7b2f97.title: Where Wolf? Here Wolf
758e6b6a-f89e-4721-ae9e-1ec27d7b2f97.titleCn:
狼在哪？狼在这
[兑换 - 狼式 维科洛鬼祟版]
758e6b6a-f89e-4721-ae9e-1ec27d7b2f97.description: If you want to be quiet and surprise people, this is the Wolf you want. Wikelo mod it to be extra stealth. Trade you for it when you bring me the items I want.
758e6b6a-f89e-4721-ae9e-1ec27d7b2f97.descriptionCn: 如果你想安静地吓别人一跳，这就是你要的狼式。维科洛给它做了额外隐秘的改装。你带齐我要的东西，我就跟你交换。

028d7a46-bd97-4e32-a5bf-0b1775f05e1c.title: Wikelo Arrive to System
028d7a46-bd97-4e32-a5bf-0b1775f05e1c.description:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at [DESTINATIONS].

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.
028d7a46-bd97-4e32-a5bf-0b1775f05e1c.descriptionCn:
你好，我是维科洛。最近加入你们的星系，非常高兴来到这里。在 UEE 待了很长时间，我很乐意再待久一点。

我有一个地方，可以把其他东西变成新东西。

另外。完成之后。如果想要做更多。有许许多多东西能制作，在我的简陋小店。来，查看漂亮海报。然后决定想要我造什么。

我需要一个人来给我带来有用的东西来完成我正在进行的项目。你有清单，请去获取。我在 [DESTINATIONS]。

我会为你的帮助给你物品。

再见。

c63d9c5a-5e25-49da-8254-b78706abea86.title: Wikelo Navy F7
c63d9c5a-5e25-49da-8254-b78706abea86.titleCn:
维科洛海军 F7
[兑换 - F7C-M Mk II 维科洛版]
c63d9c5a-5e25-49da-8254-b78706abea86.description: Know how much you Humans like Navy so Wikelo have one now. If you want Wikelo version of F7 mk2, bring me things and you are in. Very funny. Bye.
c63d9c5a-5e25-49da-8254-b78706abea86.descriptionCn: 知道你们人类有多喜欢海军，所以维科洛现在也搞了一艘。如果你想要维科洛版的 F7 MK2，带点东西来找我。就行了。很有乐趣。再见。

af73f9c7-0ee9-4ccd-bc15-d4e69e025371.title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
af73f9c7-0ee9-4ccd-bc15-d4e69e025371.titleCn: 擦除繁荣公民的数据农场
af73f9c7-0ee9-4ccd-bc15-d4e69e025371.description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen.

Head to [LOCATION] and destroy their data storage.

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out
af73f9c7-0ee9-4ccd-bc15-d4e69e025371.descriptionCn:
原来那些繁荣公民的家伙一直在收集我们的情报。他们打算切断我们的几个收入来源，让我们血本无归。我们可不能让这种事发生。

去 [LOCATION] 摧毁他们的数据存储。

这应该能让他们明白，不该插手不该管的事。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

9b1a4f9d-82e0-4127-94d4-5eb30e685616.description:

fa6e1cd2-870f-4b37-89c2-abfa1331fb5b.description:

5efa10c8-f019-43f7-ba17-1f715c585b0b.titleCn:
异种威胁 = 发大财
[零比特 - 飞船抢劫 异种威胁 HRT]
5efa10c8-f019-43f7-ba17-1f715c585b0b.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat.

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c
5efa10c8-f019-43f7-ba17-1f715c585b0b.descriptionCn:
你知道谁可能值得被狠狠揍一顿吗？异种威胁。

我们从一个服务器上获取了一些情报，里面有他们即将开展的所有行动的细节，只要价钱合适，我们就可以把一艘装满优质货物的异种威胁飞船的确切坐标发给你。

这是我们掌握的一点信息，这样你就知道我们不是在开玩笑。异种威胁把这艘飞船藏在一个锁住的小行星基地机库里，只能通过站内的电梯进入。我们没法为你打开机库门，但已经调整了安全协议，这样你就可以在机库的控制台上覆盖锁定。

有兴趣吗？

因为听说那里有个重磅人物，名叫 [TARGET]，在异种威胁的指挥体系中占有一席之地，我们想把他干掉。其他的异种威胁杀了就算额外收获，但他才是你的主要目标。

b0f04a54-0cd4-4aff-b711-0f803f0bee7a.title: XL Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials
b0f04a54-0cd4-4aff-b711-0f803f0bee7a.titleCn: 超大批量采购订单：手工开采矿石
b0f04a54-0cd4-4aff-b711-0f803f0bee7a.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on Daymar and Aberdeen. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
b0f04a54-0cd4-4aff-b711-0f803f0bee7a.descriptionCn:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM]

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻找能够完成另一份稀有材料采购订单的合作伙伴。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

只有少数已知地点可以获取这些材料，主要来自位于戴马尔和阿伯丁的现已解散的哈索尔集团遗址。我们建议前往平台校准设施（PAF），尝试重启其轨道激光平台（OLP），以获取行星地表下的材料。

提醒一下，由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[MULTITOOL]。

3baf0632-0c91-433e-b91a-04f1f73b6b70.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
3baf0632-0c91-433e-b91a-04f1f73b6b70.titleCn: 黄色级别合约：伏击一个外行
3baf0632-0c91-433e-b91a-04f1f73b6b70.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy?

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a [TARGET]. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that [LOCATION] is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
3baf0632-0c91-433e-b91a-04f1f73b6b70.descriptionCn:
想帮我们对付坏蛋吗？

我们被雇来追捕一名驾驶 [TARGET] 的不法分子。这应该不太难，因为他们每天都走同样的飞行路线。这让他们成为了绝佳的伏击目标。我分析了路线，认为 [LOCATION] 是发动攻击的理想地点。在那里有一片辐射云，正好可以隐藏你的飞船信号，等着他们经过。

如果你感兴趣，工作很简单。前往指定地点，藏起来，关闭动力，然后等他们飞过。有时他们会单独行动，但他们通常会带着其他单座飞船。对于专业人士来说，这应该不算太难。此外，我们附近还有增援力量，随时准备出动，一旦情况升级就可以支援你。

搞定这事儿，我们就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

1be171aa-8747-46cf-9c0b-f4ba47874e4a.description:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.

Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a [TARGET] and will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.

Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
